cohort_description: BMT CTN 1703: NIH/NHLBI-funded multicenter phase 3 RCT randomizing adults to PTCy-Tac-MMF (experimental) vs Tac-MTX (standard) for GVHD prophylaxis after RIC allogeneic PBSC HSCT from HLA-matched/7-8 mismatched related or unrelated donors. 37 US centers, 431 randomized, enrollment Jun 2019-Jun 2021. Companion phase 3 trial to BMT CTN 1801 (Progress II).
overlap_notes: Cohort 1002. Related publications include Abedin S 2024/2025 (age >=70 post-hoc) and Shaffer 2024 (cohort 1008, separate MUD/MMUD trial - not the same cohort). Note: BMT CTN 1703 is the cohort here; Bolanos-Meade 2023 NEJM is the primary publication for all infection and GVHD outcomes at 1 year.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry analysis of patients reported between 2012 and 2017 receiving first allogeneic HCT for AML, ALL, or MDS, restricted to centers reporting both HaploCy and SibCNI; three arms (HaploCy haploidentical+PTCy, SibCy matched sibling+PTCy, SibCNI matched sibling+CNI-based prophylaxis). Excludes UCB, unrelated donors, single-mismatch related, and T-cell manipulation (CD34 selection, ex vivo TCD, ATG, alemtuzumab).
overlap_notes: Same patient cohort as Papanicolaou GA et al. 2024 (study_id 8). Goldsmith 2021 is primary publication for CMV outcomes; Papanicolaou 2024 is primary publication for IFI outcomes per outcome-specific override.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 583 consecutive adult patients undergoing allo-HCT for hematologic malignancies at H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center between January 2012 and December 2018. Includes haplo (n=75) and 8/8 MUD (n=508) recipients receiving MAC (n=223) or RIC (n=360); none received ATG. Primary analysis stratified by GVHD prophylaxis into 4 groups: haplo-PTCy, MUD-PTCy, Tac/MTX, Tac/Sir.
overlap_notes: Single-center Moffitt cohort; possible patient overlap with other Moffitt PTCy publications outside this pilot but no overlap with the 9 other pilot studies.

cohort_description: Adults undergoing alloHCT at University of Freiburg between 2015-2022, T-cell replete PBSCT, stratified by donor type and GvHD prophylaxis into 4 groups: haplo/MM+PTCy, MRD/NoATLG, MUD+ATLG Grafalon 30 mg/kg, MM+ATLG Grafalon 30 mg/kg. All received CSA + mycophenolate sodium. Inborn errors of immunity excluded.
overlap_notes: Single-center Freiburg cohort; no known overlap with other pilot papers.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective trial of PTCy/Tac/MMF (NCT02294552, enrolled 2013-2015) vs historical control of consecutive PBSC unrelated donor transplants (2010-2013) with ATG/Tac/MTX or MMF at First St. Petersburg State Medical University (Pavlov). Adults with AML/ALL.
overlap_notes: Same institution (Gorbacheva Memorial/Pavlov) as Moiseev 2017 and Moiseev 2025 but distinct PBSC cohort focused on AML/ALL; no overlap with other pilot papers.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of consecutive adults undergoing allogeneic HCT at Hospital Clinic de Barcelona between January 2014 and March 2021. Multiple Salas publications report on overlapping subsets of this cohort. This 2022 BSI paper is the index publication for bloodstream infection outcomes.
overlap_notes: Hospital Clinic de Barcelona PTCy program cohort. Related Salas publications include Salas 2022 (Improving Safety and Outcomes), Salas 2022 (PTCY-TK for older adults), Salas 2023 (MDS CMWP), Salas 2024 (multiple). primary_for_cohort=partial: this paper is primary for BSI only.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry cohort of adult recipients undergoing initial MUD (8/8) or single HLA locus MMUD (7/8) HCT for AML, ALL, or MDS with either PTCy- or CNI-based GVHD prophylaxis, reported between January 2017 and June 2021. Total N=10,025 (1,681 PTCy-MUD; 7,272 CNI-MUD; 613 PTCy-MMUD; 459 CNI-MMUD).
overlap_notes: Distinct CIBMTR cohort from Goldsmith/Papanicolaou (cohort 1001). Shaffer cohort focuses on MUD vs MMUD comparisons (not Haplo vs Sib). Different time window (2017-2021) and donor types.

cohort_description: Australasian Bone Marrow Transplant Recipient Registry (ABMTRR) national retrospective cohort of patients aged 65 or older receiving peripheral blood haploidentical HSCT for AML or MDS in Australia and New Zealand between January 2010 and July 2020. 11 centers contributed; universal use of PTCy GVHD prophylaxis; no ATG; predominantly RIC with FluCyTBI 'Baltimore' regimen. N=44 (30 AML, 14 MDS).
overlap_notes: Some patients may overlap with ANZHIT 1 prospective Australian haplo cohort (Moore et al. 2023, Blood Adv) referenced for relapse rate consistency, but ANZHIT 1 is not restricted to older patients.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 78 consecutive adult patients undergoing T cell-replete PTCy-based haploidentical related donor HCT at Medical College of Wisconsin (MCW) between April 2012 and April 2018. All received uniform GVHD prophylaxis with PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF. Patients stratified into 3 groups based on severity of cytokine release syndrome (CRS) by Lee et al. criteria: grade 0-1 (n=41), grade 2 (n=27), grade 3 (n=10). Primary aim was to evaluate CRS severity as a predictor of infection risk and mortality after haploHCT.
overlap_notes: Single-center MCW haploHCT cohort. No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry analysis of 596 adult classic Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL) patients undergoing first NMA/RIC allo-HCT between 2008 and 2016, comparing T cell-replete related donor haploidentical with PTCy (n=139) vs MSD with CNI-based GVHD prophylaxis (n=457). MSD recipients could receive ATG or alemtuzumab (14%); ex vivo graft manipulation excluded. Distinct from CIBMTR cohort 1001 (AML/ALL/MDS) and 1008 (MUD/MMUD) — Hodgkin lymphoma-specific.
overlap_notes: Authors note some overlap with patients in Kanate 2016 (Blood) and Ghosh 2016 (J Clin Oncol) CIBMTR analyses of lymphoma patients receiving haplo or MSD between 2008 and 2013, but extended to 2016 and excluding in vivo T-cell depletion overlap. cHL-only subset distinct from broader CIBMTR cohorts 1001 and 1008.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 78 consecutive adult ALL patients (median age 51, range 19-68) diagnosed between 2017 and 2023 at Catholic Hematology Hospital, Seoul St. Mary's Hospital, undergoing haploidentical donor HCT in CR1 or CR2. Two regimen groups: (i) FMTBI group (n=26, since 2023) receiving fludarabine 150 mg/m2 + melphalan 100 mg/m2 + TBI 400 cGy with ATG 4.5 mg/kg + PTCy 60 mg/kg (30 mg/kg x 2 days), followed by tacrolimus + MMF; (ii) FB historical control (n=52, 2017-2022) receiving fludarabine 150 mg/m2 + busulfan 9.6 mg/kg with ATG 6 mg/kg, followed by tacrolimus + methotrexate. PBSC graft in all. May overlap with Ahn J 2024 BMT (study_id 21) which studied the same institutional FM vs FB conditioning comparison.
overlap_notes: Likely shares FB historical control patients with Ahn J 2024 (study_id 21), which compared FM vs FB conditioning in adult ALL at same institution. Consolidator to confirm overlap and assign final cohort_id.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 159 patients undergoing allogeneic HCT for high-risk AML (n=120) or high-risk MDS (n=39) at the Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, University Health Network, Toronto, Canada, between January 2014 and July 2017. Donors: matched related (33%), HLA 10/10 unrelated (36%), HLA 9/10 unrelated (19%), haploidentical (12%). 99% PBSC. ATG+PTCy used in 69 patients (43%), other GvHD prophylaxis (alemtuzumab+CsA, MMF+CsA, MTX+CsA, ATG+CsA+MTX, ATG 7.5 mg/kg) in 90 patients (57%). Related Princess Margaret group publications include Prem 2019, Deotare 2018, Law 2018, Salas 2019.
overlap_notes: Possible patient overlap with Prem 2019 (Princess Margaret MUD/MMUD), Law 2018 (Princess Margaret haplo), Salas 2019 (Princess Margaret AML); all share institution and overlapping enrollment years.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective phase II trial (NCT00800839) at MD Anderson Cancer Center of post-CY as sole GVHD prophylaxis after RIC Bu/Flu (Bu AUC 4000 micromolar-minute, Flu 40 mg/m2 x4 days, CY 50 mg/kg d+3/+4) for adults age 6 months-75 yrs with hematological malignancies and HLA-A/B/C/DR matched related or unrelated donors. MUD recipients initially received ATG (4 mg/kg d-3 to -1); protocol amended to remove ATG after 34th patient. Enrolled Nov 2008-Jul 2011 (N=49). Matched cohort analysis vs contemporaneous Tac/MTX controls (N=37 matched controls) drawn from MDACC departmental database, matched on age, diagnosis, disease status, donor type, graft source, ATG use; RIC consisted of Bu/Flu or Flu/Mel.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts. Single-center MDACC phase II trial.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 16 pediatric patients (median age 6 yrs, range 1-17) with benign hematological disorders (thalassemia n=10, severe aplastic anemia n=5, congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II n=1) who underwent 10/10 HLA-matched related (n=2) or unrelated (n=14) HSCT using PBSC graft with PTCy + cyclosporine + MMF GVHD prophylaxis between March 2022-July 2024 at Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram, India.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts; new single-center pediatric series.

cohort_description: German Registry for Stem Cell Transplantation (DRST), a subset of the EBMT database for German patients. Adult patients receiving first allo-HSCT for malignant hematologic disease between 2010 and 2020. Compares haploidentical transplants with PT-CY (n=487) vs 10/10 MUD transplants with ATG-based GVHD prophylaxis (n=7050). Includes all hematologic malignancies (AML 41.9%, MDS/MPN 23.7%, NHL 9.4%, ALL 8.4%, MM 6.0%, SecAL, CLL, CML, AL, HL). Multi-center: 55 German transplant centers. Arslan 2023 (study 33) reports on related DRST cohort; partial cohort overlap likely.
overlap_notes: Likely overlaps with Arslan 2023 (study 33), which uses the same DRST registry. The 2023 paper appears to be the precursor/sister analysis. May represent superset/overlap with study 33.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 74 adult patients undergoing MSD or fully matched MUD (10/10) allo-HSCT at USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center between 2015 and 2023 (Methods state 2015-2022, abstract states 2015-2023). Patients receiving haploidentical or mismatched-unrelated (>=1 mismatch) transplants were excluded. Three GVHD prophylaxis groups: MTX/TAC (n=25), PTCy/MMF/TAC (n=40), and single-agent PTCy (n=9). MTX/TAC and PTCy/MMF/TAC cohorts received PBSC; PTCy-alone received BM.
overlap_notes: Single-center USC Norris cohort; no known overlap with other cohorts in the map.

cohort_description: Single-center (now merged from 2 Amsterdam academic centers: AMC location A and VUMC location B) retrospective cohort of 185 consecutive adult patients with hematological malignancies who underwent 10/10 MUD non-myeloablative HSCT between January 2014 and December 2021. ATG group (n=95, treated at location A) received ATG rabbit 2 mg/kg days -8 to -5 + flu/TBI2Gy with ciclosporin + MMF prophylaxis. PTCy group (n=90, 86 at location B + 4 at location A) received cyclophosphamide 14.5 mg/kg days -6 and -5 + flu/TBI2Gy + PTCy 50 mg/kg days +3 and +4 + ciclosporin. Graft source PBSC in 99%. Likely shared cohort with Aydin 2022 (study_id 40) covering infections/viral reactivations in same Amsterdam MUD population.
primary_publication_overrides: Aydin 2023 primary for GvHD/survival/relapse/NRM; Aydin 2022 likely primary for infections/viral reactivations
overlap_notes: Likely overlaps with Aydin 2022 (study_id 40) - same Amsterdam single-center MUD HSCT cohort

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective Spanish GETH (Grupo Español de Trasplante Hematopoyético y Terapia Celular) cohort of 132 consecutive adult patients undergoing MUD or 9/10 mMUD allogeneic HSCT for hematological malignancies across 4 centers: Hospital Gregorio Marañón Madrid (center A), Hospital Regional Universitario Málaga (center B), Institut Català d'Oncologia Badalona Barcelona (center C/D?), Hospital Universitario y Politécnico La Fe Valencia. 72 PTCy patients (transplanted 2013-2018 at 3 centers) and 60 ATG patients (transplanted 2010-2018 at 2 centers). May share patients with Bailen 2019 (study 42, Madrid single-center MUD/mMUD PTCy) and Bailen 2022 (study 44, GETH MUD AML PTCy vs haplo). Cohort overlap with the Kwon/Bailen Madrid group needs adjudication at consolidation.
overlap_notes: Probable patient overlap with Bailen 2019 (study 42, Madrid Gregorio Marañón single-center MUD/mMUD PTCy series) and Bailen 2022 (study 44, GETH HLA-identical AML PTCy). Subagent proposal for Madrid_single_center label was rejected because paper is explicitly multicenter (4 GETH centers). Final cohort_id and overlap mapping to studies 42/44 to be resolved at consolidation.

cohort_description: GETH-TC (Grupo Espanol de Trasplante Hematopoyetico y Terapia Celular) Spanish multicenter retrospective cohort of 229 adult patients undergoing first allo-HSCT for AML using PTCY with additional immunosuppression between 2013 and 2019. Two donor strata: MSD/MUD arm (n=99 from 3 centers; 38 MSD + 61 10/10 or 12/12 MUD) and haploidentical arm (n=130 from 20 centers). PBSC predominant (89%). Heterogeneous PTCy schedules and adjunct IS in MSD/MUD (PTCy+3+4/CNI/MMF, PTCy+3+5/CNI, PTCy+3+4/Sir/MMF). No patient received ATG.
overlap_notes: GETH-TC Spanish multicenter group. Possibly overlapping with other GETH-TC publications (Bento 2025, Fox 2026, Martinez Munoz 2024); donor strata and disease focus differ.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at John Theurer Cancer Center, Hackensack University Medical Center. 54 sequential adult haploidentical (HAPLO) BM/PBSC transplant recipients (Jul 7, 2011-Mar 25, 2014) with PTCy GVHD prophylaxis, vs 59 concurrently treated control URD (matched/mismatched) recipients (Sep 29, 2009-Apr 9, 2014) matched by diagnosis and stem cell source. Hematological malignancies only. URD recipients received CNI-based prophylaxis with ATG-containing conditioning in most patients.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other identified cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 500 adults undergoing alloHCT at Mayo Clinic, Rochester between January 2018 and June 2023. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis: PTCy (n=125) versus MTX-based (n=375). Donor types: MRD 34.8%, MUD 52.6%, HID 10.4%. Study focus: chimerism kinetics (CD3/CD33) and impact on RFS/OS.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts in this MA

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 248 patients with acute leukemia (AML/ALL) without matched sibling donors undergoing alternative-donor allogeneic HSCT at the Hematology, Oncology and Stem Cell Transplantation Research Center, Tehran University of Medical Sciences, between January 2010 and November 2019. Four arms: haploidentical (n=118, PTCy 40mg/kg +3,+4 plus pre-transplant ATG, CSA+MTX), 10/10 matched unrelated (n=91, ATG+CSA+MTX), 9/10 mismatched unrelated (n=21, ATG+CSA+MTX), 9/10 mismatched related (n=18, ATG+CSA+MTX). Myeloablative Bu/Cy conditioning in most patients. Likely overlaps with Barkhordar 2022 (study_ids 50, 51) which report subsets of the haplo and unrelated arms.
overlap_notes: Likely shared cohort with Barkhordar 2022 (study_ids 50, 51) — same single Tehran center, overlapping enrollment window. To be reconciled by consolidator.

cohort_description: EBMT Acute Leukemia Working Party (ALWP) registry. Multiple publications by EBMT ALWP investigators report on subsets of this large multinational registry covering acute leukemia patients receiving allogeneic HCT. Different papers cover non-overlapping or partially overlapping donor strata (MMUD, MSD, MUD, UCB, haplo).
primary_publication_overrides: Baron 2024 is primary for AML CR1 MMUD-PTCy vs dCBT comparison; other EBMT ALWP papers cover different donor strata/outcomes.
overlap_notes: First EBMT ALWP paper extracted in this batch; consolidator will assign final integer cohort_id >= 1010. Other EBMT ALWP papers (Battipaglia 2018/2019, Spyridonidis 2022, Nagler 2024, Paviglianiti 2022) may share registry but typically address non-overlapping donor strata or time windows.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 127 consecutive patients aged >=60 years undergoing first allogeneic HCT for AML or high-grade MDS at the Blood and Marrow Transplant Program at Northside Hospital, Atlanta GA, between August 2005 and December 2015. Three donor strata: MRD (n=37, Tac/MTX), MUD (n=57, Tac/MTX; 2 of 57 were 9/10 mismatched and received pre-transplant rabbit ATG 4.5 mg/kg), and HID/haploidentical with PTCy (n=33, PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,4 + Tac + MMF). UCB excluded. T-cell replete grafts only. Same center/program reports prior publications across all ages and all malignancies (Bashey 2013 JCO; Bashey 2016 BBMT; Solh 2016 BMT) - this subset is AML/MDS aged >=60.
overlap_notes: Same center as Bashey 2013 JCO (ref 12; all ages, all malignancies) and Bashey 2016 BBMT (ref 27) and Solh 2016 BMT (ref 21; post-relapse survival). The Bashey ZA 2018 publication is the index publication for the AML/MDS aged >=60 subset. Consolidator should assess overlap with any other Northside/Atlanta papers in the corpus.

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective cohort of 79 adult patients undergoing first allogeneic HSCT from mismatched unrelated donors (MMUD) at two Turin Metropolitan Transplant Centers (Institute for Cancer Research and Treatment in Candiolo and Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria Ospedale San Luigi, Orbassano) between 2011 and 2019. All received PBSC grafts. Two GVHD prophylaxis platforms stratified by center: ATG-Cy-A-MTX (rabbit thymoglobulin 7.5 mg/kg total + cyclosporine + methotrexate, n=39) at one center, vs PT-Cy-tacrolimus-MMF (PTCy 50 mg/kg d+3,+4 + tacrolimus + MMF, n=40) at the other. No DRB1 mismatches per center policy. Registered ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04598789.

Single-center retrospective cohort of 56 adult patients undergoing unrelated donor (UD) allogeneic HSCT for hematologic malignancies at Hospital Universitario Austral, Pilar, Argentina. Two arms: PTCy + tacrolimus + mycophenolate (n=28, transplanted 08/2015-12/2019) vs historical ATG + tacrolimus + methotrexate (n=28, transplanted 01/2012-07/2015). PTCy dose 50 mg/kg days +3 and +4; rabbit ATG dose varied 7.5-15 mg/kg. Second transplants excluded. 70% fully HLA matched (10/10), 80% MAC conditioning, 96% PBSC graft. Mean age 36.9 years (PTCy 40.7 vs ATG 33.1). Median follow-up 2.3 years.
overlap_notes: Single-center Argentine cohort; no known overlap with other PTCy MA papers.

cohort_description: Single-institution retrospective cohort at UMass Chan Medical School, Worcester MA, of 61 adults aged >=70 years undergoing first allogeneic stem cell transplantation from related or unrelated adult donors between March 16, 2010 and March 20, 2023 (cord blood recipients excluded). Stratified by GvHD prophylaxis: PTCy (n=41, transplanted May 2014-Mar 2023) vs non-Cy (n=20, transplanted Mar 2010-Sep 2018; 18 ATG-based). PTCy group includes related haplo (n=12) and unrelated (n=29; 26 matched + 3 MMUD); non-Cy group 100% 10/10 HLA-matched unrelated. Same cohort as Bhatia 2024 ASCO abstract (study_id 68); 2026 Leukemia Research paper is the full publication.
overlap_notes: Overlaps fully with Bhatia 2024 ASCO abstract (study_id 68). Bhatia 2026 is the journal version; 2024 abstract reports slightly different N (42 PTCy vs 19 non-Cy in abstract vs 41 PTCy vs 20 non-Cy in journal) and somewhat different aGvHD/cGvHD numbers reflecting updated data lock and revised regimen classification.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Institut Paoli Calmettes (IPC), Marseille, France of consecutive patients aged >55 years undergoing allo-HSCT for hematological malignancies between January 2011 and November 2013. Three arms: haplo-ID with PTCy (n=31, NMAC or RIC + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 + CSA + MMF), MRD (n=47, Flu/Bu/ATG 2.5 mg/kg + CSA), and UD (n=63, including 13 with 1-antigen MMUD; Flu/Bu/ATG 2.5 mg/kg + CSA + MMF for MMUD). RIC was identical for MRD/UD; haplo received either NMAC (Cy/Flu/TBI 2 Gy, n=21) or RIC (Cy/Flu/Bu or Thio/Flu/Bu, n=10).
overlap_notes: Single-center IPC Marseille; no other papers in current batch from this exact cohort/age stratum. Possible overlap with later Devillier/Blaise IPC Marseille papers needs adjudication at consolidation.

cohort_description: BMT CTN 1203: multicenter phase 2 RCT (NCT02208037) of three novel GVHD prophylaxis regimens (TAC/MMF/PTCy, TAC/MTX/bortezomib, TAC/MTX/maraviroc) randomized 1:1:1, each compared to a non-randomized contemporary CIBMTR-based TAC/MTX control cohort. Adult patients (age 18-75) receiving reduced-intensity conditioning allo-HCT for acute leukemia, CML, MDS, CLL/SLL, or chemosensitive lymphoma. HLA-matched related 6/6 or unrelated 7/8 or 8/8 donor. Enrolled Nov 2014-May 2016 (trial arms) and Aug 2014-Sep 2016 (controls). 31 US centers in trial + 32 US centers for controls. 273 trial subjects randomized (92 TAC/MMF/PTCy, 89 TAC/MTX/BOR, 92 TAC/MTX/MVC) + 224 contemporary TAC/MTX controls. Primary endpoint: GRFS (graft-versus-host disease relapse-free survival). TAC/MMF/PTCy arm was 'most promising' and led to BMT CTN 1703 phase 3 follow-on. Distinct from BMT CTN 1703 (cohort_id 1002).
overlap_notes: Phase 2 predecessor to BMT CTN 1703 (cohort 1002). No patient overlap with 1703 since 1203 enrolled 2014-2016 and 1703 enrolled 2019-2021.

cohort_description: HOVON-96 trial: Dutch/Belgian multicenter prospective randomized phase 3 trial of PT-Cy plus short-course cyclosporine A (PT-Cy/CsA) vs cyclosporine A plus mycophenolic acid (CsA/MPA) for GVHD prophylaxis after NMA matched (MRD or >=8/8 HLA MUD) peripheral blood alloHSCT. Adults age 18-70 with high-risk hematological malignancies. Enrolled at 6 centers between October 2013 and June 2018. 160 randomized 1:2 (CsA/MPA n=52 vs PT-Cy/CsA n=99 transplanted). All conditioning NMA per Seattle protocol (PT-Cy arm specified; CsA/MPA arm at physician discretion - 79% NMA Seattle). NL2128 in Dutch trial registry.
overlap_notes: First publication for HOVON-96 trial. No known overlap with other extracted cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 97 pediatric and young adult patients (median age 3.6-6 yrs, range 9 mo to 27 yrs) with non-malignant blood disorders and inherited syndromes (hemoglobinopathies 10/97, bone marrow failure syndromes 44/97 [aplastic anemia, Fanconi anemia, Kostmann, Blackfan-Diamond, Shwachman-Diamond], metabolic diseases 35/97 [Hurler/MPS1, osteopetrosis, ALD, Krabbe, MLD, Farber], primary immunodeficiencies 10/97 [WAS, SCID, Chediak-Higashi]) undergoing 118 allogeneic HSCT at R. Gorbacheva Memorial Institute of Children Oncology, Hematology and Transplantation, First St. Petersburg State Pavlov Medical University, between 2005 and March 2018. 21 (18%) repeated transplants for initial graft failure or secondary rejection. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: standard calcineurin inhibitor-based (n=89 HSCT) vs PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4 (n=29 HSCT). Mixed donor types in both arms (MRD/MUD/MMUD/haplo). DIFFERENT cohort from 1007 (Pavlov_StPetersburg_RCT) which enrolled adults with AML/ALL 2013-2015. Same institution but distinct patient population.
overlap_notes: Same institution as cohort 1007 (Moiseev 2016 RCT) but non-overlapping patient population: this cohort is pediatric/young adult non-malignant disorders (hemoglobinopathies, BM failure, metabolic, PID), enrolled 2005-2018, whereas cohort 1007 is adult AML/ALL RCT enrolled 2013-2015. Study 84 may be a near-duplicate paper from same group (per Block 2 assignment notes).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at University of Miami Miller School of Medicine / Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center. 22 consecutive PTCy MMUD recipients transplanted between April 2017 and January 2019; ATG MMUD (n=37) and PTCy haploidentical (n=19) transplanted between January 2015 and July 2018 served as historical controls. Total N=78. Adults with hematologic malignancies (acute leukemia 56%, lymphoma 14%, MDS/MPN 19%, other 10%). Median age 55 yrs. CMV-focused outcome analysis. PTCy MMUD group received primarily BM grafts (91%) while ATG MMUD and PTCy haplo were primarily PBSC. Letermovir prophylaxis available from late 2017, initially in high-risk PTCy MMUD/haplo and ATG >=5 mg/kg.
overlap_notes: May overlap with study_id 85 (Camargo 2021 Lower Incidence of CMV Infection same group).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 80 patients with high-risk AML/MDS undergoing haploidentical allo-HSCT at The Affiliated People's Hospital of Ningbo University, China. Two arms with one-to-one matching: (i) modified ATG-PTCy group (n=40, enrolled Jan 2016-Dec 2020) receiving modified Flu/ATG conditioning (Flu 35 mg/m2 d-9 to -7, Ara-C 3 g/m2 d-9 to -7, Bu 3.2 mg/kg d-6 to -4, Cy 1.8 g/m2 d-5, semustine 250 mg/m2 d-3, ATG 7.5 mg/kg total d-5 to -2) with PTCy 50 mg/kg d+3 + CsA + MMF; PBSC only graft; (ii) ATG-only historical control (n=40, transplanted Jan 2014-Dec 2018) receiving Ara-C 4 g/m2 d-10 to -9, Bu 3.2 mg/kg d-8 to -6, Cy 1.8 g/m2 d-5 to -4, semustine 250 mg/m2 d-3, ATG 10 mg/kg total d-5 to -2, with CsA + MMF + short-course MTX; BM+PBSC graft.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts in this MA. Single-center Chinese cohort (Ningbo).

cohort_description: EBMT Chronic Malignancies Working Party (CMWP) registry retrospective study of 960 adult patients with myelodysplastic neoplasms (MDS) who underwent first allo-HSCT from MUD (10/10) or MMUD (<10/10) between 2012 and 2019 across 92 participating centers, receiving either PTCY-based (n=209) or ATG-based (n=751) GVHD prophylaxis. Excludes alternative donor types, alternative stem cell sources, and ex vivo T-cell depletion. Disease distribution: MDS-EB 53.5%, MDS without EB 24.7%, MDS-AML transformed 21.9%. ATG agents reported in 569/751 patients: Thymoglobulin 53.5% (median 5 mg/kg) and Grafalon 46.4% (median 30 mg/kg). NOTE: Prompt indicated cohort_id 1024 (EBMT_ALWP) but this is MDS (CMWP), not acute leukemia (ALWP); flagged for consolidator to assign distinct cohort ID.
overlap_notes: Distinct EBMT working party (CMWP, not ALWP) from cohort 1024 EBMT_ALWP. Same first author and similar EBMT registry but distinct MDS population. Chalandon 2023 ASH abstract (Blood 142 Supplement 1, 898-900) reports earlier interim analysis on 969 MDS patients (PTCY n=214, ATG n=755) - same cohort, conference abstract only. Chalandon 2024 ASH abstract (Blood 144 Supplement 1, 4894-4896) reports separate MF cohort, different disease.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 473 consecutive adult allo-HSCT recipients who received primary mould-active prophylaxis with voriconazole (n=187) or posaconazole (n=286) at San Raffaele Hospital, Milan, Italy, from January 2015 to December 2022. Most patients (81.6%) received PT-Cy-based GVHD prophylaxis (additional 6.3% PT-Cy plus ATG); 2.1% ATG-only; 9.7% other (predominantly CBT or sirolimus/MMF without PT-Cy). Donor types: MRD 14.8%, MMRD 1.3%, MUD 33.0%, MMUD 12.9%, Haplo 30.7%, CBU 7.4%. Conditioning treosulfan-based throughout (MAC 55.8%, RTC 44.2%) with PT-Cy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 + sirolimus +/- MMF (MMF for non-MRD only). Letermovir routine since March 2019. Risk stratified for IFI by GITMO-adapted criteria into high-risk (n=306) vs non-high-risk (n=167).
overlap_notes: Single-center Milan (San Raffaele). Greco/Oltolini group. Likely partial overlap with other San Raffaele publications using PT-Cy/sirolimus platform (Greco 2021 Transpl Cell Ther reference [27]). Distinct from any other established cohort; institution not previously represented in cohort map.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective non-randomized cohort of 539 patients undergoing HLA-matched (matched related or matched unrelated) allogeneic HSCT for myelofibrosis between 2010 and 2024. Compares two GVHD prophylaxis strategies: ATG (n=427; Thymoglobulin 3.5 mg/kg/day x2 days pre-transplant OR Grafalon 30 mg/kg for matched siblings or 60 mg/kg for MUD x3 days pre-transplant) versus PTCy (n=112; 50 mg/kg/day x2 days post-transplant). Both arms received CSA plus MMF or MTX. Accelerated/blast-phase MF excluded. Contributing centers include Rome (Gemelli), Seattle (Fred Hutch), Essen, Bergamo (Papa Giovanni XXIII), Cleveland Clinic, Nancy (CHRU Brabois), Paris (Saint-Louis), MDACC, Hamburg (UKE), Dana Farber. Senior authorship by Kröger (EBMT CMWP). Likely shares patients with Rathje 2024 BMT (ATG in MF), Robin 2019 (MSD ATG MF), Kim 2025 AJH (PTCy MF), Oechsler 2024 BMT (MF GVHD).
overlap_notes: Likely partial overlap with Rathje 2024 BMT (ATG MF, EBMT), Robin 2019 Haematologica (MSD ATG MF, EBMT), Kim 2025 AJH (PTCy MF), Oechsler 2024 BMT (MF GVHD-relapse). Center overlap with Hamburg (Kröger group), Gemelli Rome, Seattle FHCRC, Bergamo. Cohort_id to be assigned by consolidator.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective analysis from a prospective registry of adult patients (>=18 yrs) with malignant hematologic diseases undergoing allogeneic HSCT from MSD, MUD, or haploidentical donors at Hospital Universitari i Politecnic La Fe, Valencia, Spain, between 2017 and 2022. Data collection extended to September 2023. Uniform GVHD prophylaxis with PTCy + sirolimus + MMF given irrespective of donor type. N=366 (160 MSD, 124 MUD, 82 Haplo). Pre-letermovir era (patients receiving letermovir prophylaxis were excluded). Note: lead author Pedro Chorao based at Spanish institution; cohort_label as specified by prompt though institution is in Valencia, Spain.
overlap_notes: Related Chorao 2026 paper (BSI outcomes) likely shares this cohort. Reference [5] is Montoro 2020 BMT which described the uniform PTCy/sirolimus/MMF platform from this institution and may share earlier patients.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective era comparison at Rutgers Cancer Institute of New Jersey (CINJ), New Brunswick, NJ. PTCy era (April 2016-April 2018) of 49 consecutive MSD/MUD/7-8 MUD adult allo-HSCT recipients (no haploidentical, no UCB) receiving PTCy+Tac+MMF for GVHD prophylaxis, vs prior SIP era (January 2014-April 2016) of 41 patients (after excluding 25 high-DRI patients from original 66) receiving Tac+MTX with ATG/alemtuzumab added for mismatched donors and selected others (42.5% of SIP arm received ATG/alemtuzumab). Hematologic malignancies; PBSC predominant (37/41 in SIP; ~100% in PTCy era). Last day of follow-up 6/30/2020.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other studies in batch; single-institution Rutgers CINJ cohort, distinct from CIBMTR/EBMT/other listed cohorts.

cohort_description: Australasian Leukaemia and Lymphoma Group (ALLG) BM12 Cyclophosphamide after Sibling Donor Allogeneic Stem-Cell Transplantation (CAST) trial. Phase 3, prospective, open-label, randomized trial (ACTRN12618000505202) enrolling adults age 18-70 undergoing peripheral-blood SCT from matched related donors (>=6/6 HLA-A, HLA-B, HLA-DRB1) for acute leukemia (CR1/CR2) or MDS (<20% blasts) after MAC or RIC conditioning. 8 Australian + 2 New Zealand transplant centers. Enrollment April 2019-January 2024. N=134 randomized 1:1 stratified by age (<50 or >=50) and conditioning intensity: 66 to experimental PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + cyclosporin; 68 to standard cyclosporin + methotrexate (15 mg/m2 D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3,6,11). No ATG. PBSC graft for all. MAC subgroup with TBI-based conditioning in experimental arm replaced high-dose Cy with fludarabine.
overlap_notes: Primary publication of ALLG BM12 CAST RCT. No known overlapping publications in current corpus.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective historical control cohort at Institut Paoli-Calmettes (IPC), Marseille, France. 30 consecutive patients receiving 10/10 HLA-matched unrelated donor (MUD) PBSC allo-HCT with PT-Cy GVHD prophylaxis (April 2020-July 2021, predominantly TBF-based conditioning: NMAC 70%, RIC 17%, MAC 13%) vs 64 consecutive historical controls receiving MUD PBSC allo-HCT (2014-March 2020) with FB2 conditioning + Thymoglobuline ATG 2.5 mg/kg D-3,-2 + CSA without G-CSF. PT-Cy arm received PT-Cy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 (reduced to 40 mg/kg if >=65 yr) + CSA + MMF + G-CSF. Note: paper is from IPC Marseille (France), though Belgian Hematology Society and Mont-Godinne and Salus Sanguinis foundations are acknowledged. Possible overlap with Nykolyszyn 2020 (IPC mismatched-UD PT-Cy vs ATG; ref 8) and Pagliardini 2019 (IPC haplo vs UD; ref 4) but those covered different donor strata.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with prior IPC publications (Nykolyszyn 2020 mismatched-UD; Pagliardini 2019 haplo vs UD <60yr) but those covered different donor strata (mismatched-UD or haplo, not 10/10 MUD).

cohort_description: Combined retrospective cohort comparing Princess Margaret Hospital (PMH) MUD HSCT recipients (n=341, 2015-2023) receiving uniform ATG-PTCy-CNI GVHD prophylaxis (rabbit ATG 2 mg/kg total, or 4.5 mg/kg in 62 patients between Aug 2016-Jul 2018, plus PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 plus CNI starting D+5) versus a CIBMTR publicly available dataset (P-5702, Murthy et al., n=520, 2015-2018) of MUD PBSC HSCT recipients receiving CNI-MTX/MMF prophylaxis. Indications: acute myeloid leukemia (82%) and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (18%). All received G-CSF mobilized PBSC. Note: PMH arm partially overlaps with cohort 1013 (Princess Margaret Toronto Michelis) by institution but with different time window and broader acute leukemia inclusion.
overlap_notes: PMH arm (n=341) partially overlaps institutionally with cohort 1013 (Princess Margaret Toronto AML/MDS 2014-2017) but inclusion criteria differ (acute leukemia AML+ALL only, 2015-2023, all received uniform ATG-PTCy-CNI). CIBMTR comparator drawn from P-5702 Murthy 2023 ABO mismatch dataset; may overlap with CIBMTR cohort 1008 (Shaffer 2024 CIBMTR MUD/MMUD) which covers 2017-2021 MUD/MMUD CNI cohort - partial overlap possible.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 75 adult patients (>=18 yrs) undergoing first allo-HSCT for MDS/MPN overlap neoplasms (CMML 64%, MDS/MPN-NOS 31%, MDS/MPN with neutrophilia 5%) at Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, University Health Network, Toronto, between January 2010 and January 2023. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis era: PTCy-based (n=53, predominantly 2016-2023, with 83% receiving ATG+PTCy+CnI and 17% receiving PTCy+MMF+CnI) vs Others (n=22, predominantly 2010-2015, with CnI-MTX-MMF 55%, ATG-CnI-MMF 27%, alemtuzumab-CnI 18%). All PBSC; 83% RIC (Flu/Bu/TBI200); donors: MSD 35%, MUD 45%, MMUD 13%, haplo 7%. Likely shared institutional cohort with other Desai et al. Princess Margaret publications (matched sibling 2024, ATG+PTCy MUD 2025, MF haplo 2024). Distinct disease focus from PrincessMargaret_Toronto_Michelis cohort 1013 (AML/MDS 2014-2017).
overlap_notes: Princess Margaret/UHN Toronto institutional cohort; may have personnel/methodology overlap with other Desai et al. publications but disease population (MDS/MPN overlap) is distinct. Consolidator to verify overlap with broader Princess Margaret cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 413 adult patients undergoing first HSCT for hematologic malignancies with PBSC grafts from matched sibling donors (MSD) at Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, University Health Network, Toronto, between January 2010 and January 2023. Four GVHD prophylaxis groups: Group I CNI+MTX(or MMF) (n=210, predominantly pre-2015), Group II CNI+MTX(or MMF)+ATG (n=34), Group III PTCy+ATG+CNI (n=78), Group IV PTCy+CNI+MMF (n=91). After October 2015 PTCy became standard backbone for all donor types. PTCy dose 50 mg/kg D+3,+4. ATG dose 2 mg/kg total (0.5 mg/kg D-3 + 1.5 mg/kg D-2); between Aug 2016-Jul 2018, 56 patients (47 with PTCy) received 4.5 mg/kg total ATG (0.5+2+2). AML 54.2%, MDS 15.3%, ALL 11.6%, MF 9.4%; median age 56 (IQR 44-63); 48% MAC, 52% RIC; 84.5% TBI. Distinct cohort from 1013 (Michelis AML/MDS 2014-2017, multi-donor), 1042 (PMH+CIBMTR MUD acute leukemia 2015-2023), and 1043 (PMH MDS/MPN 2010-2023). Same Princess Margaret group likely shared institutional cohort.
overlap_notes: Distinct MSD-only PBSC subset; may share institutional patients with PMH cohorts 1013, 1042, 1043 by overlap of dates but distinct donor stratum (MSD only).

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective matched-pair cohort at Ludwig-Maximilians University Munich, comprising University Hospital Munich-Grosshadern and Klinikum Augsburg. Adults (>=18 years) with high-risk AML (primary refractory/relapsed, secondary, or ELN intermediate-high/adverse genetics) undergoing first allogeneic SCT between January 2009 and July 2016 following sequential conditioning. Total eligible: 41 haplo-SCT and 166 HLA-matched SCT recipients; 34 matched pairs analyzed. Haplo arm received PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF after FLAMSA-based (n=17) or clofarabine-based (n=17) sequential conditioning. HLA-matched arm (9 MRD, 21 10/10 MUD, 4 9/10 MUD) received ATG + cyclosporine + MMF after FLAMSA-based sequential conditioning. Stem cell source: PBSC in 34/34 HLA-matched and 22/34 haplo; BM in 12/34 haplo. Matched on disease stage, ELN genetic risk, and age (+/-5 yr).
overlap_notes: Two closely related LMU centers (Munich-Grosshadern + Augsburg) with shared treatment protocols. Same group has reported prior pilot studies on sequential conditioning haplo-SCT (Tischer 2013 Ann Hematol). May overlap with other Schmid/Tischer LMU publications.

cohort_description: Joint EBMT Lymphoma Working Party (LWP) and CIBMTR Lymphoma Working Committee retrospective registry analysis of adult (>=18 years) DLBCL patients undergoing first NMC/RIC allogeneic HCT between 2008 and 2015. Four donor groups: PTCy-based haploidentical (n=132; with or without CNI+MMF), HLA-matched sibling donor (MSD, n=525; CNI-based without ATG/alemtuzumab in vivo TCD), 8/8 MUD with in vivo TCD using ATG or alemtuzumab (MUD TCD+, n=403), and 8/8 MUD without in vivo TCD (MUD TCD-, n=378). Total N=1438 across 206 centers (24 haplo, 86 MSD, 45 MUD TCD+, 51 MUD TCD-). Reporting registry split: CIBMTR 879 (61%), EBMT 559 (39%). CIBMTR cohort restricted to US/Canada to avoid duplicate counting with European EBMT patients. Distinct from EBMT_ALWP (cohort 1024) which covers acute leukemia; this is a DLBCL-specific EBMT Lymphoma WP + CIBMTR collaboration. Patients receiving ex vivo graft manipulation (e.g., CD34 selection) excluded.
overlap_notes: Joint EBMT LWP + CIBMTR Lymphoma WC registry analysis. Distinct from EBMT_ALWP cohort 1024 (acute leukemia). Distinct from EBMT_CMWP cohorts 1035 (MDS) and 1037 (myelofibrosis). May share patients with prior EBMT/CIBMTR lymphoma publications (Kanate 2016, Dietrich 2016, Ghosh 2016, Martinez 2017) but those were either Hodgkin or pooled NHL; this is the first DLBCL-specific analysis.

cohort_description: Polish Adult Leukemia Group (PALG) multicenter retrospective cohort spanning three to four Polish transplant centers: Lower Silesian Oncology Center Wroclaw (Dybko), Maria Sklodowska-Curie National Research Institute of Oncology Gliwice Branch (Sobczyk-Kruszelnicka, Giebel), Poznan University of Medical Sciences (Gil), and Medical University of Gdansk (Sadowska-Klasa, Piekarska, added in later Dybko 2024 paper). Adult patients transplanted between 2015 and 2019 with mobilized peripheral blood as sole graft source, from haploidentical or MMUD donors. Dybko 2023 IJMS paper (this study, n=145; PTCy+TAK+MMF n=110 [93 haplo + 17 MMUD] vs CsA+Mtx+ATG n=35 [all MMUD]) is the first publication. Dybko 2024 JCM 'Optimizing Outcomes' (PALG) extends to n=174 by adding Gdansk cohort (PTCy-haplo n=114, PTCy-MMUD n=23, ATG-MMUD n=37). Likely overlapping cohort.
overlap_notes: Dybko 2023 IJMS 'Benefits of PTCy' (this paper) is the index publication. Likely subset of Dybko 2024 JCM PALG paper (n=174, study_id 123/124). Cohort overlap with later PALG-named publications expected; consolidator to adjudicate.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona, Spain. 77 adults with hematological neoplasms transplanted between 2005 and 2017 lacking an HLA-identical donor, comparing single-unit umbilical cord blood transplantation (UCBT, n=47, 1999-2014 era) vs haploidentical-related PBSC transplantation with PTCy (HaploHCT, n=30, since 2013). Common myeloablative conditioning platform thiotepa-busulfan-fludarabine (TBF) used in both arms. UCBT arm: cyclosporine + short prednisone or MMF + ATG rabbit thymoglobulin 4-6 mg/kg. HaploHCT arm: PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + single-agent IV tacrolimus from D+5; all received PBSC. May share patients with Esquirol 2021 (study 134) on severe infections after Sant Pau PTCy transplantation.
overlap_notes: Likely partial overlap with Esquirol 2021 (study 134) which reports severe infections/IRM after Sant Pau PTCy haplo transplantation. The Haplo arm here (n=30) may be subset/overlap with the 134 PTCy cohort.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective Spanish GETH (Grupo Espanol de Trasplante Hematopoyetico) cohort of 236 consecutive adult patients receiving haploidentical HSCT with PTCy GVHD prophylaxis (50 mg/kg D+3,+4) followed by CSA+MMF or tacrolimus, transplanted between November 2013 and November 2018 across 6 GETH centers: Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau Barcelona, Hospital Regional Universitario Malaga, Hospital Gregorio Maranon Madrid, Hospital Clinico Universitario Valencia, Hospital de Bellvitge Barcelona, Hospital Germans Trias i Pujol Badalona. Hematologic malignancies (AML 32%, lymphoma 30% [NHL 17% + HL 13%], MDS 17%, ALL 9%, CML/MPS 5%, CLL 3%, MM 2%). Conditioning: MAC 32% (FluBu, TBF), RIC 68% (FluCyBu2). PBSC 81%, BM 19%. Median age 50 yrs. Median follow-up 37 months. Focused on severe infections and IRM. Likely shares patients with GETH cohorts 1019 (Bailen MUD/mMUD) and 1020 (GETH-TC AML) at Madrid/Malaga/Valencia centers, but distinct cohort definition (all-disease haplo-only with PTCy).
overlap_notes: Possible partial patient overlap at Madrid (Kwon/Gregorio Maranon), Malaga (Pascual), and Valencia (La Fe) centers with GETH cohorts 1019 (Bailen_GETH_MUD_mMUD) and 1020 (GETH_TC_Spanish_multicenter) but distinct donor strata: this paper is haplo-only across 6 centers all-disease 2013-2018. Cohort 1020 is haplo-only across 20 centers AML-only 2013-2019. Cohort 1019 is MUD/mMUD.

cohort_description: Spanish multicenter (8 Spanish EBMT/GETH-TC affiliated institutions including Vall d'Hebron Barcelona) retrospective cohort of 171 consecutive adult patients with lymphoid malignancies (NHL 67%, HL 21%, MM 12%) undergoing RIC allo-HSCT between January 2012 and December 2020. Haploidentical and umbilical cord HSCT were excluded; donors were MRD/MMRD/MUD/MMUD. Two GVHD prophylaxis groups: PTCY 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 (n=82, predominantly 2016-2020) with tacrolimus/cyclosporine or sirolimus +/- MMF vs sirolimus + tacrolimus (SIR/TAC; n=89). ATG used only in SIR/TAC group for MMUD (18.2%). Conditioning included FluBu, FluMel, TBF, TMF, FluCyTBI. Distinct from GETH-TC AML cohort (1020) by disease focus (lymphoid vs AML) and donor strata (non-haplo only vs includes haplo). Lead center: Vall d'Hebron (Fox).
overlap_notes: Possible patient overlap with other GETH-TC lymphoid publications and with Garcia-Cadenas/Salas (Hospital Sant Pau and Vall d'Hebron) lymphoid PTCy series. Distinct from cohort 1020 (GETH-TC AML) by disease.

cohort_description: GETH-TC (Grupo Espanol de Trasplantes hematopoyeticos y Terapia Celular) / EBMT multicenter retrospective cohort of 453 adult patients with hematologic malignancies who underwent first RIC allo-HSCT between January 2012 and March 2022 at 12 GETH-TC/EBMT centers in Spain. Three groups: HAPLO (n=330, all PTCy-based prophylaxis with tacrolimus 45.8%, rapamycin 19.7%, CsA 34.5%), MMUD-PTCy (n=49, 7/8 MMUD with PTCy-based prophylaxis mainly with tacrolimus 77.6%), and MMUD-OTHERS (n=74, 7/8 MMUD with sirolimus/tacrolimus 78.4% predominantly, ATG used in 70%). All RIC. PBSC >96% in all groups. Data extracted from Spanish PROMISE database (part of EBMT registry). Lead institution: Vall d'Hebron, Barcelona. Distinct from cohort 1020 (GETH_TC_Spanish_multicenter, AML only, 2013-2019) by broader disease inclusion (all heme malignancies), longer enrollment window, and different donor strata (haplo + MMUD).
overlap_notes: Multicenter GETH-TC/EBMT (12 centers, Spain). Possible partial overlap with cohort 1020 (GETH_TC AML-only 2013-2019) for the AML subset of MMUD-PTCy and HAPLO arms, but disease scope is broader here. Possible partial overlap with cohort 1019 (Bailen_GETH_MUD_mMUD_multicenter, 4-center MUD/mMUD 2010-2018) for MMUD subset. Lead author MLF at Vall d'Hebron (Barcelona); study 136 may share Vall d'Hebron subset. Consolidator should adjudicate overlap with cohorts 1019, 1020 and any Vall d'Hebron-led submissions.

cohort_description: BMT CTN 1101: NIH/NHLBI-funded multicenter phase 3 RCT (NCT01597778) randomizing 1:1 adults age 18-70 with chemotherapy-sensitive acute leukemia (AML/ALL/biphenotypic/T-cell) in remission or lymphoma (Hodgkin/NHL/follicular/mantle cell/large cell) to double unrelated umbilical cord blood (dUCB, n=186) vs HLA-haploidentical bone marrow (haplo-BM, n=182) transplantation after reduced-intensity conditioning (Cy/Flu/TBI 200 or 300 cGy for dUCB; Cy/Flu/TBI 200 cGy for haplo-BM with PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4). GVHD prophylaxis: dUCB arm received cyclosporine + MMF; haplo-BM arm received PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF. 33 US centers, enrolled June 2012 to June 2018, 368 randomized (90% of planned 410 accrual; trial closed early for slow accrual). Primary endpoint: 2-year PFS (no significant difference). Secondary endpoints favored haplo-BM: lower NRM (11% vs 18%, P=.04) and higher OS (57% vs 46%, P=.04).
overlap_notes: Distinct from BMT CTN 1703 (cohort 1002), BMT CTN 1203 (cohort 1030). Parent BMT CTN protocol #1101.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 237 consecutive adult patients undergoing allogeneic HSCT at Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS, Rome, Italy, from December 2017 to December 2020. Almost all for hematologic malignancies (AML 43%, MPN 23%, MDS 11%, ALL 13%, NHL 7%, HL 1%, AA 2%). Stem cell sources predominantly matched unrelated (43%) and haploidentical (32%) donors. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: triple PTCY-based (CsA + MMF + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4; n=188) used uniformly from April 2019 onward, vs triple MTX-based (CsA + MMF + MTX; n=43) used predominantly before April 2019. Severe aplastic anemia patients excluded from PTCy. Study primary focus: hemorrhagic cystitis (HC) risk factors with attention to age, gender, prostatic hyperplasia.
overlap_notes: First paper for this single-center cohort in current batch.

cohort_description: Disease-specific multicenter retrospective cohort of 156 consecutive patients with severe aplastic anemia (SAA) who underwent MSD-HSCT (n=39) or haploidentical HSCT (n=117) between November 2016 and October 2020 at four transplant centers in Southwest China: (1) Xinqiao Hospital, Army Medical University, Chongqing (lead center); (2) Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences & Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital, Chengdu; (3) 920th Hospital of Joint Logistics Support Force, Kunming; (4) Second Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University. All patients received living-relative donor grafts (siblings, parents, or adult children); 1-6 HLA loci mismatched for haplo. Mixed conditioning regimens (FLU/CY/ATG or BU/CY/ATG) and mixed GVHD prophylaxis (ATG-based, PT-CY-based, or ATG+MSCs). Excludes MUD. Median follow-up 26.5 months. Date of last follow-up April 30, 2022.
overlap_notes: Lead author group at Xinqiao Hospital Chongqing has prior SAA haplo publications (Gao L 2014 BMT ref 35; Gao L 2016 J Hematol Oncol ref 36; Zeng 2018 Sci Rep ref 30 - large Chinese SAA study from same group). Possible partial overlap with these earlier publications for the Xinqiao subset of patients, but the present study has a distinct 2016-2020 enrollment window and 4-center multicenter design.

cohort_description: Cell Therapy Transplant Canada (CTTC) prospectively maintained Canada-wide registry retrospective multicenter cohort of 385 adults (>=18 yrs) who received haploidentical donor (HID) HCT for hematologic malignancies at 11 Canadian transplant centers between January 1, 2016 and August 28, 2023. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: ATG-PTCy (n=148, all conducted at Princess Margaret Hospital Cancer Centre [PMHCC], Toronto; ATG 4.5 mg/kg days -3 to -1 + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CNI [cyclosporin or tacrolimus] from D+5) vs PTCy-only (n=237, from other Canadian centers; PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + MMF + CNI from D+5). Excluded: non-malignant disease, cord blood, no follow-up data. Diseases: AML 51%, MDS 18%, ALL 15%, lymphoma 8%, MPN 8%. May partially overlap with PMHCC cohorts 1013 (Michelis high-risk AML/MDS 2014-2017), 1042 (PMH-CIBMTR MUD 2015-2023), and 1043 (PMH MDS/MPN); however this is a distinct multicenter CTTC-wide haploidentical-only cohort. Largest Canadian real-world HID HCT experience to date.
overlap_notes: ATG-PTCy arm (n=148) entirely from Princess Margaret Hospital and likely overlaps temporally with PMHCC publications by Law 2018, Salas 2021 (refs 21, 22). Partial overlap possible with PMH-based cohorts 1013, 1042, 1043 for haploidentical subset patients; consolidator to adjudicate.

cohort_description: Single-centre retrospective observational cohort of 21 adult patients (>=18 yrs) with relapsed/refractory Hodgkin lymphoma who received an allogeneic stem cell transplant at the Juravinski Cancer Centre, Hamilton, Ontario, Canada between 1 January 2016 and 29 February 2024. All had prior ASCT (100%) and a median of 4 prior treatment lines (range 3-6); 90% prior BV exposure, 62% prior PD-1 inhibitor exposure. Donor types: 17 (81%) related haploidentical, 4 (19%) matched unrelated. All PBSC. 95% NMA conditioning Flu/Cy/TBI 200; 5% RIC Flu/Mel. GVHD prophylaxis: 18 (86%) PTCy/tacrolimus/MMF; 3 (14%) ATG/CNI/MMF. One patient received two haploidentical alloSCT — second transplant censored from analysis. Reports to CIBMTR.

Single-center retrospective observational cohort of 131 consecutive adult (>=18 years) T-cell replete allogeneic HSCT recipients at Hospital Clinic Universitario de Valencia / INCLIVA Health Research Institute, Valencia, Spain, transplanted between January 2020 and March 2024. Predominantly PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis (97%: Pt-Cy/Sir-MMF n=123 [94%], Pt-Cy/CsA-MMF n=4 [3%]). Donor types: matched related 30.5%, matched unrelated 26%, mismatched unrelated 17.6%, haploidentical 24.4%, mismatched related 1.5%. Conditioning: RIC 83.2%, MAC 16.8%. Stratified for analysis by AdV surveillance strategy: routine monitoring (n=77, high-risk: haploidentical, HLA-mismatched, or unrelated HLA-matched) vs symptom-based testing (n=54, low-risk MRD). Paper focus is on adenovirus DNAemia surveillance vs monitoring strategy, not on PTCy vs comparator. Distinct from cohort 1038 (Chorao Hospital Universitari La Fe Valencia 2017-2022) which is the other Valencia hospital. Could overlap with Bailen GETH 1019 (Hospital La Fe Valencia) only if shared center, but this paper is from Hospital Clinic Valencia (INCLIVA) which is a separate Valencia institution.
overlap_notes: Hospital Clinic Universitario Valencia (INCLIVA) - distinct from Hospital Universitari i Politecnic La Fe Valencia (cohorts 1019 Bailen GETH, 1038 Chorao). Piñana/Solano/Navarro/Gimenez group.

cohort_description: Prospective Italian multicenter epidemiological survey (CYTOALLO GITMO-AMCLI Survey, NCT04412811) of 1310 consecutive allo-HSCT recipients (adults and pediatric) from 42 GITMO transplant centers (~60% of allo-HSCTs performed in Italy during the study period) between 1 January 2021 and 31 March 2022. Patients followed for 1 year post-transplant. Heterogeneous mix of underlying diseases (acute leukemia 59.2%, MDS, MPN, lymphoma, aplastic anemia, others), donor types (MRD 21.4%, MMRD 4.0%, haplo 25.7%, MUD 30.2%, MMUD 18.1%), conditioning intensity (MAC 65%, RIC 24.3%, NMA 10.8%), and GVHD prophylaxis platforms (PTCy 40.9%, ATG/alemtuzumab in vivo TCD 39.2%). Stratified ONLY by letermovir primary prophylaxis (LET-PP): 879 received LET-PP (all HCMV-seropositive recipients except pediatric) vs 431 did not (mix of HCMV R- and pediatric R+ ineligible). PTCy is reported as a covariate within each LET-PP stratum but outcomes are NOT separated by PTCy vs non-PTCy use. No PTCy vs comparator contrast structure.
overlap_notes: GITMO-sponsored prospective survey; distinct from any EBMT/CIBMTR registry cohorts. NCT04412811.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort from the Oslo University Hospital (OUS) HSCT registry of 421 adult (>=18 years) patients with hematologic malignancy who underwent first allo-HSCT at OUS between 2005 and 2019 and were alive without relapse at 2 years post-transplant. OUS is the Norwegian national referral center performing the majority of allo-HSCT in Norway. Diseases: AML 50%, MDS/MPN 18%, lymphoma 16%, ALL 7%, CML 4%, CLL 3%. Donors: MRD 26%, 10/10 MUD 60%, 9/10 MMURD 11%, haplo 3%. PBSC 74%, BM 26%. Conditioning: MAC 54%, RIC 46%. GVHD prophylaxis: CsA/Tac alone 2%, CsA+MTX 77%, CsA+MMF 1%, CsA+sirolimus 15%, PTCy (with CsA+MMF, haplo only) 4% (n=17). ATG (thymoglobulin 4 mg/kg in 10/10 MUD or 6 mg/kg in 9/10) in 19% (n=81). Cohort restricted to 2-year survivors out of original 1000 transplanted. Median follow-up 6.2 yrs (2.0-16.1). Study focus: long-term outcome and risk factors for late death in 2-year survivors; no PTCy-vs-comparator stratification reported.
overlap_notes: Related publication: Ali MM, Gronvold B, et al. Clin Lymphoma Myeloma Leuk 2021;21(9):598-605 (ref 34, same OUS Department of Hematology group, ATG addition in MUD PBSC HSCT). Likely shared institutional cohort but with different time window/inclusion criteria. Should be reconciled at consolidation.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective phase II trial (NCT01315132) at Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia of a myeloablative 2-step HLA-matched related donor HSCT approach. N=46 adults (ages 25-65) with hematologic malignancies (AML 39%, MDS 15%, Ph+ ALL 11%, Ph- pre-B ALL 11%, NHL 13%, CMML 7%, MPD 2%, CML-blast crisis 2%) enrolled 2008-2018. Conditioning: 12 Gy TBI. Step 1: unmanipulated DLI containing fixed dose of 2 x 10^8/kg CD3+ cells (day -6); step 2: CD34-selected PBSC graft (day 0). GVHD prophylaxis: PTCy 60 mg/kg/day x 2 days (days -5 and -4 relative to graft) + tacrolimus + MMF. 42/46 had 8/8 MSD; 4/46 had haploidentical relative with 0-1 mismatch in GVH direction. Median follow-up 63 months.
overlap_notes: Distinct from Grosso 2011 Blood (2-step haploidentical phase 1/2) and Grosso 2015 BBMT (2-step haploidentical update). This is the first prospective trial of the 2-step approach in HLA-matched related donor HSCT.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective observational cohort of 61 consecutive adult and pediatric patients (median age 35 yrs, range 4-62) with hematological malignancies (AML 52.5%, ALL 29.5%, MDS 16.4%, MPAL 1.6%) who underwent first haploidentical HSCT from related donors with Bu-Cy myeloablative conditioning at Luoyang Central Hospital, Zhengzhou University, Luoyang City, China, between January 2019 and December 2024. Conditioning: cytarabine 4 g/m2 d-10/-9, busulfan 3.2 mg/m2/d d-8 to -6, cyclophosphamide 1.8 g/m2/d d-5/-4, semustine 250 mg/m2 d-3. Two arms: (i) reduced-dose ATG-PTCy (n=30, rabbit ATG Thymoglobulin 7.5 mg/kg total = 2.5 mg/kg d-4 to -2 plus PTCy 20 mg/kg/d d+3 and d+4) vs (ii) standard-dose ATG (n=31, rabbit ATG 10 mg/kg total = 2.5 mg/kg/d d-5 to -2). All received CSA + short-course MTX (d+1,+3,+6,+11) + MMF. Graft source PBSC alone (52.5%) or PB+BM (47.5%).
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts. Single-center Luoyang Central Hospital data.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective matched-pair analysis at Department of Medicine III, Ludwig-Maximilians-University (LMU) University Hospital Munich, Germany. Eligible were patients aged >=18 yrs with refractory or relapsed B or T cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) undergoing NMC or RIC allo-HSCT between 2000 and 2017. Three groups (16:16:16 matched pairs from a parent pool of 36 haplo recipients) by donor type and GVHD prophylaxis: (i) Haplo with sequential clofarabine-based cytoreduction followed by RIC Flu/Mel + PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF, BM-predominant graft (69%); (ii) HLA-matched related donor (MRD) with CNI-based prophylaxis (CNI-MMF 81%, CNI-MTX 6%, Sirolimus-MMF 13%, no ATG); (iii) HLA-matched unrelated donor (URD) 8/8 or 10/10 with CNI-MMF (94%) or Sirolimus-MMF (6%) plus ATG 10-20 mg/kg BW IV daily x3 days. Matching criteria: age (+/-5 yr), disease status, lymphoma classification, ECOG/KPS. 88% active disease at conditioning in each group. Distinct from cohort 1045 (LMU Munich + Augsburg high-risk AML sequential 2009-2016) by disease focus (NHL vs AML) and enrollment window (2000-2017 vs 2009-2016). Same Munich group authors (Fraccaroli, Prevalsek, Tischer) as cohort 1045 and Zoellner 2015 sequential clofarabine paper.
overlap_notes: Same LMU Munich institution as cohort 1045 (Doppelhammer 2019 / Fraccaroli 2018 AML), but distinct NHL cohort; minimal patient overlap unlikely as different disease groups.

cohort_description: Joint EBMT and CIBMTR retrospective registry analysis of 1942 adult patients (>=18 years) undergoing first allogeneic HCT for mature T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (PTCL-NOS, AITL, ALCL) between 2008 and 2018. Four donor/GVHD-prophylaxis cohorts: posttransplant cyclophosphamide-based haploidentical (haplo-PTCy, n=237; PTCy with or without CNI and MMF), HLA-matched sibling donor (MSD, n=911; CNI-based without ATG/alemtuzumab in vivo TCD), 8/8 MUD with in vivo TCD using ATG or alemtuzumab (MUD TCD+, n=468), and 8/8 MUD without in vivo TCD (MUD TCD-, n=326). Eligible donors: MSD, 8/8 allele-matched MUD, or haploidentical related donors. Ex vivo graft manipulation excluded. CIBMTR cohort limited to US/Canada to avoid duplicate EBMT counting. 23 patients overlap with prior EBMT ALCL study and 144 with prior CIBMTR AITL study; haplo-HCT patients excluded from both prior studies. Distinct from EBMT_ALWP (cohort 1024, acute leukemia), CIBMTR_HaploCy_SibCy_SibCNI (1001, AML/ALL/MDS), CIBMTR_HL_HaploPTCy_MSDCNI (1011, Hodgkin), and EBMT_CIBMTR_DLBCL_LWP (1046, DLBCL) — this is mature T-cell lymphoma-specific.
overlap_notes: 23 patients overlap with prior EBMT ALCL allo-HCT study (ref 34); 144 overlap with prior CIBMTR AITL allo-HCT study (ref 35); haplo-HCT patients excluded from both prior studies.

cohort_description: Japanese Data Center for Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (JDCHCT) Transplant Registry Unified Management Program 2 (TRUMP2) nationwide retrospective cohort of 7,499 adult patients (aged >=16 years) with hematologic disease undergoing first UCBT or PTCy-haplo between 2014 and 2020. Three groups stratified by donor source and cord blood CD34+ cell count: PTCy-haplo (n=1142, haploidentical PBSC/BM with PTCy + tacrolimus/CSA + MMF predominant; 93.8% PBSC, 6.2% BM); UCB-H (n=3185, single-unit UCBT with CD34+ cell count >=0.84 x 10^5/kg; median 1.12 x 10^5/kg); UCB-L (n=3172, single-unit UCBT with CD34+ cell count <0.84 x 10^5/kg; median 0.63 x 10^5/kg). Mixed disease (AML/ALL/MDS/lymphoma/MM/CML), mixed conditioning (MAC vs RIC). 715 cases with missing DRI/cytogenetics data excluded from original 8506 identified. Median CD34+ cell count in PTCy-haplo arm was 42.6 x 10^5/kg (cord blood ~40-60x lower CD34+ doses). Earlier preliminary version reported as ASH 2023 abstract (Harada 2023, study_id 171).
overlap_notes: Study 171 (Harada 2023 ASH abstract) is the preliminary conference abstract of this same cohort; same N=7499, same 1142/3185/3172 arms, same findings. Study 170 (Harada 2025 TCT full paper) is the primary publication for this cohort. Potential partial overlap with other JDCHCT/TRUMP2 publications (e.g., Sugita 2022 BMT haplo vs CBT, Wada 2022 Transplantation, Jo 2024 ALL, Konuma 2023 TCT GVT, Konuma 2020 AJH, Atsuta 2013 Haematologica) which draw on different time windows or disease subsets from the same national Japanese registry.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective Spanish cohort of 283 adult allo-HSCT recipients at 4 Spanish institutions, comparing haploidentical with PTCy (n=118; PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+5) vs historical other transplant modalities (n=165; MRD n=76, MUD n=62, MMRD/MMUD n=27). Haplo recipients enrolled January 2016 to December 2018 at HCUV Valencia (n=63), HRUM Malaga (n=16), HCUS Salamanca (n=30), HGUGM Madrid (n=9). Historic comparator cohort drawn from HCUV (n=137, May 2012-June 2018) and HRUM (n=28, January 2016-February 2018). Primary focus: CMV DNAemia incidence, kinetics, and outcomes by donor type. Plasma CMV monitoring with real-time PCR (Abbott or Affigene). Possible partial overlap with GETH cohorts 1049 (Esquirol haplo PTCy infections, includes Malaga/Madrid/Valencia centers 2013-2018) but distinct study population (includes non-haplo arms and CMV-focused).
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap on haplo arm with GETH_Esquirol_haplo_PTCy_infections (cohort 1049) for HRUM Malaga and HGUGM Madrid centers 2016-2018 timeframe; HCUV Valencia and HCUS Salamanca are distinct centers.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective comparative cohort of 116 consecutive adult patients undergoing MRD or 10/10 MUD allo-HCT at Mayo Clinic, Jacksonville, FL between January 2018 and January 2021. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms based on physician discretion: PTCy-Siro (CNI-free, n=29: PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 + sirolimus from D+5 [4 mg PO load then 2 mg PO daily, target trough 6-14 ng/mL]) vs Tac-MTX (standard, n=87: tacrolimus 0.02 mg/kg/day IV from D-1, target trough 10-15 ng/mL to D+30 then 5-10 ng/mL + MTX 15 mg/m2 D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3, +6, +11). MRD 31%, MUD (10/10) 69%; PBSC 94.8%, BM 5.2%; MAC 32.8%, RIC 67.2%. Median follow-up 1.1 years (range 0-1.8). Primary endpoints: cumulative incidence of grade II-IV aGVHD and cGVHD.
overlap_notes: Single-center Mayo Jacksonville cohort; distinct from Mayo Rochester cohorts (1022 Baranwal). No known overlap with other study_ids in this batch.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 225 adult patients (>=18 yrs) who underwent allo-HSCT for hematologic malignancy at University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) between 2012 and 2016. Three cohorts: Cohort A (n=94) 8/8 HLA-matched related (MRD, 84%) or unrelated (MUD, 16%) donor HSCT with calcineurin inhibitor-based GVHD prophylaxis (no PTCy); Cohort B (n=103) 8/8 HLA-matched related (2%) or unrelated (98%) donor HSCT with 1 dose PTCy (50 mg/kg D+3) + tacrolimus + MMF; Cohort C (n=28) haploidentical donor HSCT with 2 doses PTCy (50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4) + tacrolimus + MMF. Primary endpoint: D+100 cumulative incidence of CMV infection. CMV viremia threshold >500 IU/mL by Roche cobas qPCR; testing initiated D+7 weekly to D+100, then every 2 weeks until IS taper completed.
overlap_notes: Possible overlap with Jamy 2021 Am J Hematol phase II trial of 1-dose PTCy in MUD HSCT (ref 9 in this paper) and Jamy 2016 Blood abstract on immune reconstitution post-PTCy (ref 20). Likely overlapping/same single-center UAB cohort for Cohort B.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Department of Hematology, Shanghai General Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. 127 patients aged >=55 years with myeloid malignancies (AML 77.2%, MDS 21.3%, CMML 1.5%) undergoing allo-PBSCT between September 2016 and November 2023. Two arms by donor type: Haplo-PBSCT (n=87) and MUD/MSD-PBSCT (n=40; 21 MSD + 19 MUD). All 87 haplo and 18/40 MUD/MSD received uniform low-dose ATG (rabbit ATG 2.5 mg/kg/d x 2 days, total 5 mg/kg) + low-dose PTCy (single dose 50 mg/kg on d+3) + CsA + MMF for GVHD prophylaxis. 22/40 MUD/MSD received ATG 2.5 mg/kg/d x 2d + MTX + CsA + MMF (no PTCy). All received RIC (busulfan 3.2 mg/kg/d x 2d + fludarabine 30 mg/m2/d + cytarabine 1-1.5 g/m2/d x 5d + TBI 3 Gy on d-1). 100% PBSC grafts. Letermovir available since August 2022 (36 patients). Reference: Jia Y et al. Annals of Hematology 2025; 104:1857-1866.
overlap_notes: Shanghai General/Shanghai Jiao Tong group has prior publications on low-dose ATG/PTCy regimen (Yang 2019 BMT; Xu 2021 BMT; Li 2023 Front Immunol) in younger haploidentical recipients - potential partial cohort overlap with prior single-center reports for the haplo arm patients transplanted 2016-2023. This 2025 paper is the first to focus specifically on older (>=55) myeloid malignancy subset.

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective cohort of 128 adult recipients of HLA-mismatched unrelated donor (MMUD) allogeneic HCT for high-risk hematologic malignancies at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) and University of Miami Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center (UM SCCC) between 2010 and 2020. Eligible donors mismatched at >=1 locus among HLA-A, HLA-B, HLA-C, HLA-DRB1; HLA-DQB1 mismatches not used as inclusion criterion. Two GVHD prophylaxis groups: ATG (n=46, rabbit ATG 5-7.5 mg/kg pre-transplant + tacrolimus + short-course MTX 5-15 mg/m2 IV D+1,+3,+6,+11) vs PTCy (n=82, cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg IV D+3,+4 + MMF 10-15 mg/kg PO/IV TID D+5 to D+35 + tacrolimus n=41 or sirolimus n=41 from D+5). PTCy group includes 30 subjects from prospective trial NCT02793544. PTCy group had more highly mismatched (>1 locus) donors (30.5% vs 2.2%) and more BM grafts (50% vs 26%). 58% racial/ethnic minorities. Excludes HLA-matched donors, mismatched related donors, and ex vivo graft manipulation.
overlap_notes: Two-center collaboration MSKCC + UM Sylvester. PTCy subcohort overlaps with NCT02793544 prospective trial (30 of 82 PTCy subjects). Shaffer/Shaw 15-MMUD NMDP phase 2 study (ref 12) likely overlaps with NCT02793544 subjects.

cohort_description: Japanese Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (JSTCT) nationwide registry analysis via the Transplant Registry Unified Management Program (TRUMP). 1999 adult patients (age >=16) with acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) undergoing PTCy-haplo (n=330) or single-unit umbilical cord blood (UCB, n=1669) transplantation between 2013 and 2021. PTCy-haplo arm: 95.5% (n=315) received PBSC grafts; 79.8% TBI-based conditioning; 50.6% MAC. UCB arm: single-unit UCB; 54.8% MAC. Distinct from prior Sugita 2022 BMT (Sugita J et al., comparable Japanese cohort but heterogeneous diseases) and Wada 2022 Transplantation (single-center Kyoto cohort) referenced as ref 7 and 11. Designed by Adult ALL Working Group of JSTCT. Distinct disease focus (adult ALL only) from other JSTCT/TRUMP cohorts.
overlap_notes: Possible patient overlap with Sugita J 2022 BMT (mixed-disease JSTCT haplo vs UCB) and Wada F 2022 Transplantation (Kyoto single-center). This 2024 paper is ALL-specific and is the primary publication for ALL outcomes in this registry stratum.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 78 adult patients undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation at Medicana International Izmir Hospital, Izmir, Turkey, between January 2022 and June 2024. Three donor strata: myeloablative-related (n=38, 48.7%), myeloablative-unrelated (n=26, 33.3%), and haploidentical (n=14, 17.9%). PTCy was administered to 49 patients (62.8%): all 14 haploidentical, all 26 MUD, and 9 of 38 related donor recipients. The remaining 29 (37.2%) — all related donor recipients — did not receive PTCy. All patients received cyclosporine + MMF from D-1; PTCy schedule was 50 mg/kg/day on D+3 and D+5 (non-standard timing). ATG given to 27 (34.6%; 26 MUD + 1 related). Conditioning predominantly fludarabine/melphalan (88.5%) or treosulfan/melphalan (11.5%). Diseases: AML 45.9%, ALL 14.2%, MDS 9% (paper states 13 patients = 16.7% likely), MM 10.3%, lymphoma 5.1%, others. GVHD graded by IBMTR system.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts in the map; new single-center cohort from Izmir, Turkey.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center (FHCC), Seattle, of 738 consecutive CMV-seropositive adult (>=18 yrs) first allogeneic HCT recipients between 1 July 2015 and 31 December 2021. Two cohorts defined by date of routine letermovir prophylaxis implementation (Oct 2018): pre-LTV (Jul 2015-Sep 2018, n=376) and post-LTV (Oct 2018-Dec 2021, n=362). Patients on broad-spectrum antivirals on day of HCT excluded. Stratified ONLY by LTV era, NOT by PTCy use; PTCy is reported as a baseline covariate (10.4% pre-LTV, 21.3% post-LTV) but outcomes are not separated by PTCy vs non-PTCy. Cohorts include heterogeneous donor types (matched related, MUD, mismatched related/haplo, mismatched unrelated, UCB) and GVHD prophylaxis regimens. Primary outcome: HHV-6 reactivation and encephalitis. No PTCy vs comparator contrast structure. Comparable to cohort 1058 (CYTOALLO_GITMO_AMCLI) in design.
overlap_notes: FHCC single-center cohort; may overlap with other Fred Hutch publications (e.g., Perchetti 2023 BMT letermovir breakthrough, Hill 2017/2018/2019/2022 dsDNA virus studies). Cohort defined by CMV-seropositive first allo-HCT 2015-2021.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry analysis of 917 adult (>=18 yrs) lymphoma patients (Hodgkin and NHL) undergoing first RIC/NMA conditioning haploidentical or HLA-matched URD (8/8 allele level HLA-A,-B,-C,-DRB1) allo-HCT between 2008 and 2013. Three groups: haploidentical (n=185) with PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis (predominantly Tac/MMF/PTCy n=175); URD without ATG (n=491) with CNI-based prophylaxis; URD with ATG (n=241) with CNI-based prophylaxis. Haplo recipients received Flu/Cy/2 Gy TBI conditioning and predominantly BM grafts (93%); URD recipients received Flu+alkylator and/or 2 Gy TBI and predominantly PB grafts (94% URD-noATG, 91% URD-ATG). Ex vivo graft manipulation excluded. Median follow-up of survivors ~3 years. Distinct from CIBMTR cohort 1001 (AML/ALL/MDS), 1008 (MUD/MMUD acute leukemia), 1011 (HL only), and 1046 (DLBCL only EBMT-CIBMTR). Lymphoma Working Committee mixed histology (DLBCL, FL, MCL, T/NK, HL).
overlap_notes: Distinct from other CIBMTR cohorts (1001 AML/ALL/MDS; 1008 MUD/MMUD acute leukemia; 1011 HL; 1046 DLBCL EBMT-CIBMTR). Lymphoma WP mixed histology.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 168 AHSCT procedures (157 unique patients) performed at Grenoble Alpes University Hospital, France, between January 2014 and January 2018. Data extracted from the EBMT ProMISe database via Société Francophone de Greffe de Moelle et de Thérapie Cellulaire (SFGM-TC). All hematologic disease/AHSCT recipients (acute leukemia ~65%, MDS ~17%, MPN ~6%, lymphoma ~10%, aplastic anemia ~2.4%). Donor mix: MSD 29%, MUD 41%, MMUD 14%, haploidentical 15%. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis: 49 patients received post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4, used for haploidentical and 9/10 mismatched unrelated donors) versus 119 patients received non-PTCy prophylaxis. Conditioning: MAC 30%, RIC 70%. Patients with early death (<30 d) or engraftment failure excluded. Primary analysis: risk factors for BK virus-associated hemorrhagic cystitis. Outcomes reported by BKV-HC status (cases vs controls), not separately by PTCy vs non-PTCy arm.
overlap_notes: Single-center Grenoble cohort; no known overlap with other cohorts in this batch. Data sourced from EBMT ProMISe but this is local center data only, not the broader EBMT registry.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cross-sectional cohort of 40 adult patients with high-risk hematologic malignancies undergoing HLA-matched (HLA-A, -B, -C, -DRB1, -DQB1) sibling donor allogeneic stem cell transplantation between 2016 and 2020, followed at a single SCT center in Istanbul, Turkey (Istanbul Medeniyet University local ethics approval). Two GVHD prophylaxis groups: PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 with MESNA + tacrolimus 0.03 mg/kg/day from D+5 (target 5-15 ng/mL for 3 months) + MMF 45 mg/kg/day D+5 to D+28 (n=15); vs MTX 15 mg/m2 D+1 then 10 mg/m2 D+3,+6,+11 + calcium folinate D+2,+4,+7,+12 + cyclosporine A 1.8 mg/kg/day from D+5 (target 200-400 ng/mL for >=6 months) (n=25). Fludarabine/busulfan conditioning for myeloid malignancies; fludarabine/TBI for lymphoid malignancies. All received CMV prophylaxis with ganciclovir and valaciclovir.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 127 consecutive adult patients with hematologic malignancies or aplastic anemia undergoing first allogeneic HSCT with T-cell-replete HLA-haploidentical donor (haplo-HSCT, n=59) or matched unrelated donor (UD-HSCT, n=68) with ATG at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Sao Paulo, Brazil, between 2010 and 2018. Patients with primary immunodeficiency, inflammatory bowel disease, and second allogeneic transplants excluded. Haplo arm: NMA (Cy/Flu/TBI200), RIC (Mel140/Flu/TBI200), or MAC (Bu/Flu or Thio/Bu/Flu) conditioning + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + tacrolimus + MMF. UD arm: MAC (Bu/Flu, Bu/Cy, Cy/TBI, or Eto/Cy/TBI), RIC (Flu/Mel or Bu/Flu) or NMA (Cy/Flu) conditioning + rabbit ATG (Sanofi Genzyme) 5 mg/kg total + methotrexate + CNI. Pre-letermovir era. May share patients with Kerbauy MN 2023 paper on immune reconstitution from same institution.
overlap_notes: Likely shares patients with Kerbauy MN 2023 (study_id 200, immune reconstitution PTCy vs ATG paper) from same Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Sao Paulo, Brazil.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center (CSMC) Blood and Marrow Transplant Program, Los Angeles, CA, of 351 adult patients undergoing first allogeneic HSCT with matched donor (MRD or MUD) cell source from bone marrow (BM) or peripheral blood stem cells (PBSC) between January 2010 and March 2024. Haploidentical and mismatched-related donors excluded. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis era: pre-2016 non-PTCy era (N=252, Tac/MTX-based standard) vs post-2016 PTCy era (N=99, PTCy + tacrolimus + mycophenolate). Disease mix: AML (37%), ALL (27%), MDS/MPD (9%), NHL (8%), HL (5%), MPN (4.6%), CML (3.4%), SAA (2.8%), MM (2.6%), CLL (1.1%). Median follow-up 10.6 yr (non-PTCy) vs 4.4 yr (PTCy). Note: paper title's prompt header was incorrectly described as Korean MSD-only; actual cohort is US Cedars-Sinai matched donor (MRD+MUD) BM+PBSC.
overlap_notes: Index publication. May share some patients with CIBMTR registry analyses that include CSMC as contributing center.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 42 consecutive patients with myeloid neoplasms (AML in CR1, MDS, CML chronic phase) undergoing myeloablative (busulfan 3.2 mg/kg IV D-7 to -4 + cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg IV D-3 to -2) MSD PBSCT at Division of Hematology, Faculty of Medicine Siriraj Hospital, Mahidol University, Bangkok, Thailand, between January 1, 2010 and December 31, 2013. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms based on year of transplantation: MTX/CSA standard (n=21, transplanted 2010-2011) vs PTCy/ATG calcineurin-inhibitor-free (n=21, transplanted 2011-2012). PTCy/ATG arm: rabbit ATG thymoglobulin 2.5 mg/kg/day IV D-3 to -2 (total 5 mg/kg) + cyclophosphamide 50 mg/m2 IV D+3, +4. MTX/CSA arm: CSA 3 mg IV q12h from D-1 (trough 200-400 ng/ml for 3 months) + short-course MTX 15 mg/m2 IV D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3, +6, +11. Outcomes evaluated March 1, 2019. Median FU 71 months.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts in this MA. Single Siriraj Hospital Bangkok publication.

cohort_description: Two-center Spanish GETH retrospective cohort of 107 consecutive adult patients undergoing HLA-identical sibling donor (MSD, 10/10) HSCT for hematologic malignancies. PTCy group (n=57) transplanted between April 2014 and December 2017 at 2 centers (Hospital Gregorio Maranon Madrid [center A, n=19] and Hospital Regional de Malaga [center B, n=38]) received PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+5 + CsA from D0 (38 patients, 65%) or PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CsA from D+5 + MMF (19 patients, 35%). CsA-MTX historical control group (n=50) transplanted between March 2010 and November 2015 at center A only. PBSC graft 91% (97/107). MAC/RIC mixed. Distinct cohort from Bailen 2019 (study 42, single-center Madrid MUD/mMUD PTCy) and Bailen GETH multicenter MUD/mMUD cohort 1019 (different donor stratum, MSD only here).
overlap_notes: Madrid (Gregorio Maranon) + Malaga centers. Shares Madrid center with Bailen GETH cohorts (1019) but distinct donor stratum (MSD only). Possible patient overlap with other GETH-TC Spanish multicenter publications by Kwon/Bailen group; adjudicate at consolidation.

cohort_description: Multicenter European retrospective registry cohort of 317 patients (296 adults, 21 pediatrics <12 yrs) who underwent first allo-HSCT during the year 2017 at six transplant centers: University Hospital Regensburg (Germany, n=62), University Hospital Dresden (Germany, n=96), Mannheim University Hospital (Germany, n=25), University Clinical Centre Gdansk (Poland, n=40), University Hospital Centre Zagreb (Croatia, n=69), and St. Anna Children's Hospital Vienna (Austria, n=4). Joint analysis within the German-Austrian-Swiss registry expanded by EUROGRAFT (COST cGvHD Integrated European Network) centers. Stratified by GvHD prophylaxis: Standard (CNI + MTX/MMF) n=115, ATG-based n=135, PTCy-based n=60, Other n=7. Donor types: HLA-matched sibling 20.5%, unrelated 66.2%, haploidentical 13.2%. cGvHD diagnosis per 2014 revised NIH criteria. Median follow-up 943 days (range 0-1962). Adult at-risk cohort (reached day 100 without prior relapse/TRM/2nd tx) n=249. Funding from Novartis Pharma AG.
overlap_notes: May overlap by single-center contribution with other Regensburg (Grube/Wolff), Dresden (Middeke), Gdansk (Piekarska/Sadowska-Klasa), or Zagreb publications restricted to 2017 transplants; centers also contribute to EBMT registry.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective real-world cohort of 130 patients with aplastic anemia (AA) undergoing haploidentical HSCT across 7 transplantation centers in Hubei Province, China (Tongji Hospital, Union Hospital, Wuhan No. 1 Hospital, Yichang Central People's Hospital, Jinzhou Central Hospital, Xiangyang Central Hospital, First People's Hospital of Jinzhou) between January 2013 and June 2021. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: modified PTCy (mPTCy, n=55) with Flu/Bu/Cy/ATG conditioning + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 (2018-2019) or D+3,+5 (2020-2021) + tacrolimus + MMF; vs G-CSF/ATG 'Beijing protocol' (n=75) with Bu/Cy/ATG conditioning (total Cy 200 mg/kg) + CsA + MMF + MTX. Graft predominantly G-CSF-mobilized BM+PB. Disease: SAA, NSAA, VSAA, SAA-PNH. Conducted on behalf of the Aplastic Anemia Group of Hubei Province.
overlap_notes: Tongji Hospital site has prior publication (Li Y 2021, Transplant Cell Ther 27:331.e1-331.e7, reference 13 in this paper) which evaluated TBI-free mPTCy regimen in AA at this institution; the mPTCy arm here partially overlaps with that single-center cohort but this 2022 paper expands to 7 centers in Hubei Province.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 580 adult patients undergoing allogeneic HSCT for hematologic disorders at the Blood and Marrow Transplant Center of Taipei Veterans General Hospital, Taiwan, between 2003 and 2023. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis and donor type: PTCy group (n=80, exclusively haploidentical donors; PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4 + anti-calcineurin + MMF from D+5; predominantly NMAC/RIC 90%) vs CsA + short-course MTX group (n=500, predominantly MSD n=220, MUD n=263, MMUD/UCB n=17; predominantly MAC 65.4%). All received antifungal prophylaxis (CsA+scMTX: fluconazole 82.4%, echinocandin 16.8%; PTCy: echinocandin 53.8%, fluconazole 43.8%).
