High CMV seroprevalence area (recipient IgG+ >95%, donor IgG+ 85%). Primary focus: invasive fungal disease (IFD) by EORTC/MSG criteria.
overlap_notes: Liu 2016 (J Microbiol Immunol Infect 49:567-574, ref 18) is a prior IFD report from the same center (Taipei VGH) - likely earlier-era subset of this cohort. No other identified PTCy-MA papers from this institution.

cohort_description: Two-center (Singapore General Hospital and National University Hospital Singapore) retrospective cohort of 121 consecutive adult patients with relapsed/refractory lymphoma (B-NHL 34%, T-NHL 31%, NKTL 20%, HL 15%) undergoing allo-HSCT between 2003 and 2022. Donor types: MSD 45%, MUD 29%, haploidentical 19%, cord blood 7%. 86% RIC, 14% MAC. 27% had prior auto-HSCT. GVHD prophylaxis was CNI plus MTX or MMF; ATG given to all MUD recipients; PTCy was used in only 15 of 23 haploidentical recipients (the rest used ex vivo alpha-beta T-cell depletion). No PTCy vs comparator stratification; outcomes (PFS/OS/NRM/aGVHD) reported only by donor type, conditioning intensity, lymphoma subtype, disease status, and era. CMV reactivation NOT reported as an outcome despite mention of letermovir prophylaxis adoption since 2017. Single-arm descriptive cohort relative to the PTCy MA scope: PTCy is not the cohort defining intervention and no PTCy-stratified outcomes are reported.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with prior cohorts in the consolidator map.

cohort_description: BMT CTN 1301: NIH/NHLBI-funded multicenter phase III randomized trial (NCT02345850) comparing two calcineurin inhibitor-free chronic GVHD prevention strategies versus standard tacrolimus/methotrexate after myeloablative HLA-matched HCT for acute leukemia (AML/ALL/biphenotypic/acute undifferentiated) or MDS. Three arms: (1) ex vivo CD34-selected T-cell-depleted PBSC graft without additional immunosuppression (CliniMACS CD34 Reagent System); (2) unmanipulated bone marrow graft followed by PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4 as SINGLE-AGENT prophylaxis (no CNI, no MMF); (3) unmanipulated bone marrow graft with tacrolimus (target 5-15 ng/mL >=90 days post-HCT) + methotrexate 15 mg/m2 IV D+1 then 10 mg/m2 IV D+3,+6,+11 (control). 26 US and German centers. Enrolled September 2015-June 2018. 346 randomized (114 CD34, 114 PTCy, 118 Tac/MTX); 327 transplanted (104 CD34, 109 PTCy, 114 Tac/MTX); 300 treated per protocol. Patients age <=65 with acute leukemia in CR/CRi or MDS <5% blasts; HLA-matched (8/8) related or unrelated donors. Stratified randomization by donor type and age. Primary endpoint: 2-year CRFS (composite of moderate-severe cGVHD, relapse, survival).
overlap_notes: BMT CTN 1301 is distinct from BMT CTN 1703 (cohort 1002, RIC) and BMT CTN 1203 (cohort 1030, RIC 4-arm phase 2). 1301 is MAC HLA-matched, three-arm RCT focused on CNI-free strategies including CD34-selection.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 39 adult (>=18 yrs) patients with hematologic malignancies (AML 26, ALL 6, MDS 2, CML 1, PMF 1, HL 1, MM 1, biphenotypic acute leukemia 1) undergoing T-cell replete HLA-haploidentical HSCT with post-transplant cyclophosphamide GVHD prophylaxis at the Department of Hematology, Faculty of Medicine, Hacettepe University, Ankara, Turkey, between 2015 and 2022. Patients with benign hematologic disorders (e.g. aplastic anemia) excluded. Donor proximity: sibling 17, parent/child 19, cousin/nephew 3. HLA compliance 5/10-8/10. Conditioning: Busulfan-Fludarabine-Thiotepa (n=27, TBF), Busulfan-Fludarabine-ATG (n=10), other (n=2). All patients received PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CsA + MMF (n=36) or other PTCy-containing prophylaxis (n=3).
overlap_notes: Single-center Hacettepe Ankara cohort. No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts. Single-arm descriptive; protocol-excluded but tracked for PRISMA.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf (UKE), Germany of 599 adult patients undergoing first allogeneic stem cell transplantation with myeloablative conditioning (MAC) and peripheral blood stem cells (PBSC) between 2005 and 2019. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: ATLG (Grafalon, Neovii) at 30 mg/kg (related donor) or 60 mg/kg (unrelated donor) fractionated d-4 to -1 (n=476; 34% received 30 mg/kg, 66% 60 mg/kg) vs PTCy 50 mg/kg/day d+3 and +4 (n=123) combined with calcineurin inhibitor (tacrolimus for unrelated/haploidentical, cyclosporine for related) and mycophenolate mofetil for mismatched transplants. Diseases: AML, ALL, CML, MDS, MDS/MPN, HL, NHL, MM, PMF, other AL. Donor mix: ATLG arm 16% MRD/64% MUD/20% MMUD; PTCy arm 25% MRD/11% MMRD/46% MUD/17% MMUD. Median year of transplant 2013 ATLG vs 2015 PTCy. Primary outcome: immune reconstitution (T/B/NK/NKT cell phenotypes) at d+30, +100, +180 by multicolor flow cytometry. Secondary outcomes: infections, viral reactivations, GVHD, relapse, NRM, DFS, OS.
overlap_notes: Hamburg UKE single-center cohort; may overlap with other UKE Hamburg publications (e.g., EBMT CMWP myelofibrosis cohort 1037 includes Hamburg UKE site contribution). Distinct from registry cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort from the Blood and Marrow Transplant Data Repository at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (DFCI), Boston, MA, of 570 adult patients (>=18 yrs) who underwent first allogeneic PBSCT from an unrelated donor (URD; 8/8 or 7/8 HLA-matched at A, B, C, DRB1) between 1 January 2018 and 31 December 2021. From 606 consecutive transplants identified in 570 distinct patients, only the first transplant was included. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: PTCY-based (PTCY/TAC/MMF, n=107) vs TAC-based (n=463 = TAC/MTX 322 + TAC/MTX/Rap 116 + TAC/Rap 25). All received PBSC grafts. Diseases: AML 38.4-39.3%, MDS 24.3-27.6%, ALL 10.4-12.1%, lymphoma 6.5-10.4%, MPN 7.5-7.8%, MDS/MPN, CML, other leukemia. Conditioning: RIC 73% (predominantly Flu/Bu2), MAC 27% (predominantly Flu/Bu4). HLA: 85% 8/8 matched; PTCy arm more 7/8 mismatched (53.3% vs 5.8%). Median follow-up 24.3 months.
overlap_notes: Single-center DFCI cohort, no known overlap with other cohorts in this batch.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 586 adult patients with myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or acute myeloid leukemia (AML) who underwent first allogeneic HCT at Dana-Farber Cancer Institute/Brigham and Women's Hospital between January 1, 2018 and December 31, 2022. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis: PTCY-based (n=184, 31%; cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg days +3 and +4) vs non-PTCY (n=402, 69%; methotrexate + tacrolimus +/- sirolimus). Donor distribution: PTCY group 49% haploidentical, 32% MMUD, 16% MUD, 3% MRD, 0.5% MMRD; non-PTCY group 73% MUD, 20% MRD, 7% MMUD, 0.2% MMRD. Reduced-intensity conditioning predominant (65.2%); Bu/Flu most common regimen overall (79.9%). Median age 63 (range 21-79). Median follow-up of survivors 35 months. Primary outcome: NRM stratified by HCT-CI score categories. Comorbidities prospectively validated by 2 independent chart reviewers.
overlap_notes: May share patients with prior DFCI/BWH publications (e.g., Rambaldi 2021, Little 2022) but those used different time windows or disease subsets; this is the index publication for HCT-CI prognostic analysis in this MDS/AML cohort.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 113 consecutive adult patients with high-risk hematological malignancies undergoing one-antigen HLA-mismatched unrelated donor (MMUD, 9/10) HCT at MD Anderson Cancer Center between 2009 and 2013. Two arms: PTCy group (n=41, including 36 enrolled on MDACC phase II trial NCT01010217 and 5 off-study; PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 + tacrolimus + MMF after fludarabine/melphalan +/- thiotepa or TBI 200 cGy conditioning) versus conventional group (n=72; in vivo TCD with rabbit ATG [n=68] or alemtuzumab [n=2] + tacrolimus + methotrexate after various conditioning regimens including Bu/Flu 37.5%, Flu/Mel 22.2%, Flu/Cy 18.1%). Bone marrow predominant graft (83% PTCy, 63% conventional). Distinct from MDACC_Alousi_PTCy_RIC_PhaseII cohort (1014) which was NCT00800839 (Nov 2008-Jul 2011) using PTCy as SOLE prophylaxis after Bu/Flu RIC for MUD/MRD patients. This Mehta MMUD cohort is a different MDACC trial (NCT01010217) with different conditioning (Flu/Mel) and triple PTCy/Tac/MMF prophylaxis specifically in 9/10 MMUD recipients.
overlap_notes: Some PTCy arm patients (36/41) overlap with MDACC NCT01010217 phase II trial (3-arm: haplo, MMUD/MMRD, MUD). The 9/10 MMUD subset reported here; haplo and MUD subsets reported in companion publications. Conventional arm is non-trial contemporaneous controls. Distinct cohort from 1014 (Alousi NCT00800839, RIC Bu/Flu MUD/MRD, PTCy as sole prophylaxis).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 661 adult patients with hematologic malignancies who underwent first allogeneic HCT between January 2015 and July 2020 at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center (MDACC), Houston, TX. All patients received PTCy 50 mg/kg/day on days +3 and +4 plus tacrolimus with or without MMF as GVHD prophylaxis. Patients with mismatched unrelated donor (MMUD, n=19), umbilical cord blood, or ex vivo/in vivo T-cell depleted grafts were excluded. Three donor strata: haploidentical related (n=275, 96% received PTCy/Tac/MMF), 8/8 or 10/10 HLA-matched unrelated donor (MUD, n=246, 47% PTCy/Tac/MMF + 53% PTCy/Tac), and HLA-identical sibling donor (MSD, n=140, 26% PTCy/Tac/MMF + 74% PTCy/Tac). Predominant diagnoses: AML/MDS (57-75%). Conditioning: MAC (Bu/Flu) or RIC (Flu/Mel-based). Graft source: haplo 66% BM/34% PB; MUD 23% BM/77% PB; MSD 99% PB. Median FU 17-30 months across arms. Same institution as cohort 1014 (Alousi PTCy RIC phase II NCT00800839, 2008-2011) but distinct trial/era; potential partial overlap with other MDACC PTCy publications.
overlap_notes: MDACC single-center 2015-2020 PTCy-based 3-arm comparison. Distinct from cohort 1014 (Alousi PTCy RIC phase II NCT00800839, 2008-2011) by era and design. Possible partial overlap with Mehta 2021 BM vs PB PTCy haplo paper (ref 16) — same haploidentical PTCy MDACC cohort. May overlap with subsequent Mehta MDACC publications.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 964 adult patients undergoing first allogeneic HCT using HLA-matched sibling (MSD, n=412) or matched unrelated (MUD, n=552) donor at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, between January 2015 and July 2020. Excludes manipulated/ex vivo TCD grafts. Four GVHD prophylaxis groups: MUD Tac/MTX/ATG (n=306, all MUD Tac/MTX recipients received rabbit ATG/Thymoglobulin 4 mg/kg total D-3 to D-1), MUD PTCy-based (n=246, PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3/+4 + tacrolimus from D+5, +/- MMF per protocol), MSD Tac/MTX (n=272, no ATG), MSD PTCy-based (n=140, PTCy + tacrolimus +/- MMF). Predominantly myeloid malignancies in PTCy arms (85-90% myeloid vs 59-64% in Tac/MTX); MAC predominant; PBSC predominant. Distinct from cohort 1014 (MDACC_Alousi_PTCy_RIC_PhaseII, 2008-2011 prospective phase II trial NCT00800839, N=86) by larger size, retrospective design, different enrollment era, and broader inclusion (MSD+MUD, MAC+RIC). Likely shares patients with other Alousi-group MDACC publications during 2015-2020 era.
overlap_notes: Distinct from cohort 1014 (MDACC_Alousi_PTCy_RIC_PhaseII, 2008-2011 N=86 phase II trial). Same institution, different cohort era and design. Possible overlap with other MDACC Alousi-group publications during 2015-2020; consolidator to adjudicate.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry dataset of adult patients (>=18 years) with ALL in complete remission undergoing haploidentical (n=373) or MUD (n=913) HCT between 2013 and 2017. Same source dataset as Wieduwilt MJ 2022 Blood Advances (haplo vs sibling/unrelated/cord blood ALL HCT). All haploidentical were T-cell replete with PTCy prophylaxis; all MUD used conventional calcineurin inhibitor-based GVHD prophylaxis. Excludes ATG/alemtuzumab recipients, matched siblings, umbilical cord blood HCT, and MUD HCT with PTCy prophylaxis. Mehta 2023 reports a sub-analysis stratifying by donor age <35 vs >=35 years; primary analysis compares younger haplo (n=187) vs older MUD (n=232). Distinct from CIBMTR cohort 1001 (AML/ALL/MDS HaploCy/SibCy/SibCNI 2012-2017) by being ALL-only and excluding sibling/cord donors, and from cohort 1008 (MUD/MMUD 2017-2021).
overlap_notes: Sub-analysis of CIBMTR ALL dataset originally published in Wieduwilt MJ et al. Blood Advances 2022;6(1):339-357. The full Wieduwilt 2022 cohort also included matched siblings and UCB recipients.

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective observational cohort of 97 adult patients who developed CMV viremia following first allogeneic HSCT performed between 2010 and 2015 at IRCCS San Martino Genoa (center A) and Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli Rome (center B) and were treated with foscarnet as preemptive therapy. Two arms by donor type and GVHD prophylaxis platform: UD (n=30, unrelated donor with ATG 7.5 mg/kg + cyclosporine + MTX, predominantly PBSC) vs HAPLO (n=67, HLA-haploidentical family donor with PT-CY day +3,+5 + cyclosporine + MMF, 100% BM graft). Underlying diseases: AML 38, PMF 14, ALL 13, MDS 8, NHL 6, HL 6, AA 4, CLL 3, CML 3, MPD 1, MM 1. Pre-letermovir era. Cohort is a CMV-foscarnet selected subset (not all transplants performed at these centers).
overlap_notes: Two-center cohort (Genoa San Martino + Rome Gemelli, 2010-2015). Distinct from Gemelli_Rome_Galli_HC (cohort 1053, 2017-2020, focus on hemorrhagic cystitis) by era and selection criteria. Patients selected for CMV viremia + foscarnet treatment - not a transplant denominator cohort. PTCy arm (HAPLO) restricted to BM grafts from Genoa where PT-CY haplo platform was developed (Raiola/Bacigalupo); UD arm includes both centers.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 553 consecutive adult patients undergoing allogeneic HCT at San Martino Hospital, Genoa, Italy between January 1, 2010 and April 30, 2016. Four donor strata: MRD (n=115, CsA+MTX), MUD/MMRD (n=81, CsA+MTX+ATG), single-unit CBT (n=27, CsA+MMF+ATG), and T cell-replete unmanipulated haploidentical bone marrow with high-dose PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+5 + CsA + MMF (n=330, 60%). All received levofloxacin antibacterial prophylaxis. Primary focus: pre-engraftment BSI incidence, risk factors, and 60-day NRM. Bacigalupo/Raiola Genoa group; partial overlap likely with prior Mikulska 2009 BSI publication and Raiola 2013 BBMT haploidentical paper. CBT use declined from 10% (2010-2012) to 1% (2013-2016) while haplo use rose from 42% to 76% over the study period.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with Mikulska 2009 BSI (BBMT 15:47-53) and Raiola 2013 BBMT haploidentical bone marrow PTCy publications from same Genoa group.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 89 adult patients undergoing T-cell-replete haploidentical PBSC transplantation with PTCy + tacrolimus + mycophenolate as uniform GVHD prophylaxis at Barbara Ann Karmanos Cancer Institute / Wayne State University, Detroit, MI, between January 2012 and June 2019. Two arms by conditioning intensity: MAC (n=24; busulfan + fludarabine) vs RIC (n=65; busulfan + fludarabine + low-dose TBI OR fludarabine + melphalan + low-dose TBI). Assignment by physician discretion. Propensity score-based covariate adjustment used.
overlap_notes: Single-center Wayne State/Karmanos haplo-PBSCT cohort 2012-2019. Other Modi/Karmanos publications (e.g. Modi D 2021 PTCy vs Thymoglobulin AML/MDS) likely from same institution; partial overlap possible by institution but different donor strata.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 76 consecutive adult patients with AML (n=59, 78%) or MDS (n=17, 22%) who underwent 7/8 HLA-MMUD allogeneic SCT at Barbara Ann Karmanos Cancer Institute / Wayne State University, Detroit MI, between January 2006 and June 2019. 7/8 mismatch defined as one antigen or allele mismatch at HLA-A, -B, -C, or -DRB1. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: PTcy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + tacrolimus (from D+5) + MMF (D+5 to D+30) (n=25, predominantly transplanted 2014-2020); Thymoglobulin total 4.5 mg/kg in divided doses (0.5 D-3, 1.5 D-2, 2.5 D-1) + tacrolimus (from D-3) + MMF (D-3 to D+30) (n=51, predominantly transplanted 2008-2018). Graft source PBSC 96%; conditioning MAC (Bu/Flu) 46% or RIC (Bu/Flu/TBI 93% of RIC, or Flu/Mel/TBI) 54%.
overlap_notes: First publication for this Karmanos/WSU 7/8 MMUD AML/MDS cohort in the meta-analysis. Modi et al. 2020 Leuk Lymphoma (ref 26) and Ratanatharathorn 2015 BMT (ref 27) describe broader unrelated donor cohorts at same institution but for different donor strata (matched unrelated, not 7/8 MMUD).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 63 adult patients undergoing T-cell replete haploidentical hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for hematologic malignancies at the Division of Hematologic Malignancies and Cellular Therapeutics (HMCT), University of Kansas Medical Center (KUMC), Kansas City, MO. All received uniform GVHD prophylaxis with PTCy + tacrolimus + mycophenolate mofetil. All received weekly EBV PCR monitoring starting D+20 post-transplant, continuing for 6 months after immunosuppression ended or when CD4 count >200. EBV reactivation defined as EBV PCR >1000 copies/mL. Rituximab initiated preemptively if confirmed viral load >1000 copies/mL (up to 4 doses at 375 mg/m2). Disease mix: AML 47.6% (30/63), ALL 12.7% (8/63), MDS 11.1% (7/63), NHL 15.9% (10/63), MPN 3.2% (2/63), HL 3.2% (2/63), other 6.3% (4/63). 59/63 RIC, 4/63 MAC; 35 BM, 28 PBSC. Letter to Editor format with full Methods/Results/Table 1.
overlap_notes: Single institution (KUMC). No known overlap with existing cohorts in cohort_overlap_map.json.

cohort_description: EBMT Transplant Complications Working Party (TCWP) registry retrospective study of 450 adult patients with hematological malignancies (acute leukemia, chronic leukemia, MDS/MPN, lymphoma; plasma cell disorders excluded) receiving first alloHCT from 8/10 HLA-mismatched unrelated donors (MMUD) between 2015 and 2021 across EBMT centers. NOTE: Despite cohort_label including 'MD' (matched donor) per prompt, the actual cohort is 8/10 MMUD (two HLA-A/B/C/DRB1/DQB1 allele mismatches), not matched. GVHD prophylaxis stratified into 2 arms: ATG (n=318) and PTCy (n=132). Excluded: alemtuzumab, ex vivo T-cell depletion, combined ATG+PTCy, neither ATG nor PTCy, cord blood, second autoHCT, plasma cell disorders. PBSC 90.4%, BM 9.6%. 56.2% MAC, 43.8% RIC. Distinct from related EBMT TCWP publications: Penack 2024 Leukemia (10/10 MUD ATG vs PTCy, ref 25) and Penack 2024 Blood Cancer J (9/10 MMUD ATG vs PTCy, ref 6).
overlap_notes: Possible partial cohort overlap with Penack 2024 (10/10 MUD) and Penack 2024 (9/10 MMUD) EBMT TCWP studies by donor-strata; this paper is the 8/10 MMUD-specific stratum. Shared statistical authorship (Abouqateb, Peczynski, Penack). Patients in this analysis are distinct (different HLA-match stratum) but drawn from same EBMT registry and same WP.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at R. M. Gorbacheva Memorial Institute of Children Hematology, Oncology and Transplantation / Pavlov First Saint Petersburg State Medical University. 183 first allogeneic transplant recipients with malignant diseases, all receiving 10/10 HLA-matched bone marrow grafts from related donors (MRD), transplanted 2006-2016. Two arms: single-agent post-transplant cyclophosphamide (saPTCy, n=78, transplanted 2014-2016; PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 as sole GVHD prophylaxis) vs CNI-based historical control (n=105, transplanted 2006-2014; cyclosporine A [31%] or tacrolimus [69%] plus methotrexate [50%] or MMF [50%]). Diseases: AML 49%, ALL 31%, CML 8%, lymphomas 8%, MDS 3%. 27% salvage transplants. DISTINCT from cohort 1007 (Pavlov_StPetersburg_RCT, MUD PBSC 2013-2015, Moiseev 2016 BBMT) and cohort 1032 (Gorbacheva pediatric non-malignant 2005-2018) although same institutional source.
overlap_notes: Same institution as cohort 1007 (Pavlov MUD PBSC) and 1032 (Gorbacheva pediatric/nonmalignant). Different patient population: MRD + bone marrow + malignant adult. Should be assigned a new cohort_id by consolidator.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Stanford University School of Medicine, Division of Blood and Marrow Transplantation & Cellular Therapy. 237 adult patients (>=18 years) with acute myeloid leukemia (AML, n=164) or acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL, n=73) who underwent first myeloablative conditioning (MAC) HLA-matched allogeneic HCT between January 2018 and March 2025. HLA-matched sibling donors (n=96, 41%) or HLA-matched 10/10 unrelated donors (n=141, 59%). All grafts unmanipulated; no T-cell-depleting agent. Two GVHD prophylaxis groups by institutional protocol: PTCy/TAC/MMF (n=46; cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + tacrolimus from D+5 target 5-10 ng/mL + MMF 15 mg/kg q8h D+5 to D+35) vs TAC/MTX (n=191; tacrolimus from D-1 same target + MTX 15 mg/m2 D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3,+6,+11). Center switched from TAC/MTX to PTCy/TAC/MMF during/following the 2023 MTX shortage. MAC: chemotherapy-only 74%, chemotherapy + TBI 26%. PBSC graft 80.6% overall (PTCy 96%, TAC/MTX 77%); BM 19%. Median follow-up PTCy 1.1 yr (IQR 0.7-1.7) vs TAC/MTX 3.3 yr (IQR 1.4-6.1).
overlap_notes: Stanford single-center cohort; not identified in existing 7-cohort set or 9 known clusters. New cohort for this paper. Possible future overlap with other Stanford BMT publications.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective cohort of 129 adult patients (>15 yrs) with acute leukemia (AML/ALL) in CR or MDS undergoing first myeloablative allo-HSCT with PBSC as graft source from MSD, MUD, or MMUD donors at three Spanish institutions between July 2016 and December 2019. Haploidentical recipients excluded. Two GVHD prophylaxis platforms by center: (i) CD34+ selected ex vivo T-cell depletion (TCD) using CliniMACS CD34 Reagent System + rabbit ATG 2.5 mg/kg/d D-3 and D-1 (total 5 mg/kg) for engraftment, no post-transplant immunosuppression (n=38, all at Hospital Universitario Vall d'Hebron Barcelona, with 2 MAC conditioning regimens TBI-TT-Cy or Bu-Mel-Flu); (ii) PTCy-Sir-MMF (cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg/d D+3,+4 + sirolimus from D+5 target 8-16 ng/mL until D+90 then tapered + MMF 1g q8h D+5 to D+35) (n=91, 2 centers in Valencia: Hospital Universitario y Politecnico La Fe and Hospital Clinico Universitario, with 3 MAC conditioning regimens TT-Bu-Flu, Bu-Flu, reduced TT-Bu-Flu). TCD donor mix 31% MSD/37% MUD/31% MMUD; PTCy donor mix 48% MSD/52% MUD/0% MMUD. PTCy-Sir-MMF subcohort may partially overlap with cohort 1038 (Chorao Hospital La Fe Valencia 2017-2022 PTCy-Sir-MMF) and TCD subcohort with related Hospital Vall d'Hebron Barcelona TCD experience. Pre-letermovir era; no CMV-specific prophylaxis used.
overlap_notes: PTCy-Sir-MMF subcohort (n=91 at HUPLF Valencia + HCU Valencia) may partially overlap with cohort 1038 (Chorao La Fe Valencia 2017-2022 all-donor PTCy-Sir-MMF). TCD subcohort (n=38 at HUVH Barcelona) is distinct from prior Vall d'Hebron Barcelona TCD reports (Barba 2017 BBMT).

cohort_description: EBMT Lymphoma Working Party (LWP) registry retrospective cohort of 446 adult (>=18 years) patients diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma who underwent first allogeneic HSCT from full HLA-matched sibling (MSD) or matched unrelated donor (MUD; 10/10 high-resolution HLA-A, -B, -C, -DRB1, -DQB1) between January 2015 and December 2022. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis: conventional CNI-based (n=270; CsA+MTX 51%, CsA+MMF 27%, CsA alone 8%, other 14%) vs PTCy-based (n=176; PTCy + 2 IS drugs 72% [CsA+MMF n=67, Tac+MMF n=34, Siro+MMF n=20, other n=5], PTCy + 1 IS drug 23%, PTCy alone 5%). Excluded patients receiving cord blood, ATG, alemtuzumab, or ex vivo graft manipulation. Donor distribution: CNI 74% MSD/26% MUD; PTCy 50% MSD/50% MUD. Graft predominantly PBSC (91% CNI, 86% PTCy). 75% PTCy and 69% CNI received RIC. Distinct from cohort 1011 (CIBMTR_HL_HaploPTCy_MSDCNI) which was haplo-PTCy vs MSD-CNI for HL 2008-2016, not HLA-matched-PTCy. Also distinct from Montoro 2024 TCT (LWP HL HLA-matched vs haplo with PTCy in both arms, ref 14 in this paper).
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with Montoro 2024 TCT EBMT LWP HL paper (ref 14, the prior LWP study comparing HLA-matched PTCy vs haplo PTCy in HL); the present paper extends the HLA-matched PTCy cohort and adds the conventional CNI comparator. No overlap with CIBMTR cohort 1011 (different registry).

cohort_description: Japanese Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (JSTCT) / Japanese Data Centre for Haematopoietic Cell Transplantation nationwide TRUMP registry retrospective cohort of 799 adult AML patients (age >=16) undergoing first PBSC allogeneic HCT between 2013 and 2021. Three arms: PTCy-haplo (n=489, 2 or 3 HLA-A/-B/-DR antigen mismatches, PTCy without ATG; ~50% received 100 mg/kg PTCy total, ~33% received 80 mg/kg total), ATG-free MUD (n=211, HLA-A/-B/-C/-DRB1 allele-matched unrelated PBSCT, CNI-based GVHD prophylaxis without ATG, predominantly TAC+MTX 85.3%), and ATG-administered MUD (n=99, allele-matched unrelated PBSCT, CNI-based GVHD prophylaxis with ATG, predominantly TAC+MTX 92.9%). PBSCT exclusively; ex vivo graft manipulation excluded. Distinct from cohort 1064 (JDCHCT_TRUMP2_UCBT_vs_PTCyHaplo, UCBT vs PTCy-haplo all-disease 2014-2020) and cohort 1070 (JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL_PTCyHaplo_UCB, ALL only 2013-2021) by disease (AML only) and donor strata (PTCy-haplo vs MUD; excludes UCB).
overlap_notes: Same registry source (JSTCT/TRUMP) as cohorts 1064 and 1070 but distinct disease/donor strata. Cohort overlap likely with Atsuta 2022 BMT (ref 21: comparable JSTCT haplo vs MUD BM) at the registry level but distinct PBSCT-only inclusion.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 92 consecutive patients aged 65 years and older diagnosed with myeloid malignancies (AML 71%, CMML 1-2 8%, atypical CML and MDS/MPN 9%, MDS no EB 3%, MDS-EB1 3%, MDS-EB2 7%) who underwent allogeneic SCT with PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis at University Medical Center Groningen (UMCG), The Netherlands, between February 2018 and December 2022. All received PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 (matched donor) or D+3,+5 (mismatched donor per Bacigalupo) plus tacrolimus (matched 10/10) or tacrolimus + MMF (MMUD/haplo). Novel strategy of very short duration immune suppression: tacrolimus stopped at D+28 for matched donors if upfront/active disease/MRD+, or D+70 if MRD-; for mismatched donors MMF stopped D+30 and tacrolimus D+56 if upfront/active/MRD+, otherwise tacrolimus continued to D+70. Donor mix: SIB 8%, MUD 10/10 73%, MUD 9/10 7%, HAPLO 13%. PBSC 92%. Single-arm cohort with no PTCy vs comparator contrast.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with existing cohorts. Author Hilberink/Hazenberg 2019 Leuk Res (355 AML patients aged 60+ at UMCG 2002-2017, ref [11]) is a different historical cohort at the same institution (Groningen, pre-PTCy era).

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry retrospective analysis of 266 adult patients (>=18 years) who underwent first allogeneic HCT for T cell prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL) between 2008 and 2018. 87 contributing centers worldwide. Eligible donors included HLA-identical sibling donors, 8/8 matched unrelated donors, 7/8 mismatched unrelated donors, haploidentical donors, and other related donors. Cord blood and ex vivo T cell-depleted graft recipients were excluded; in vivo TCD with ATG (n=47) or alemtuzumab (n=2) was permitted. Graft sources: PBSC (n=236, 89%) and bone marrow (n=30, 11%). Median age 59.1 yrs (range 25-76). 53% male. KPS >=90 in 58%. Disease status at HCT: CR 56%, PR 30%, no response/stable/PD 11%. Conditioning: MAC with TBI 17%, MAC without TBI 13%, RIC with TBI 28%, RIC without TBI 42%. GVHD prophylaxis: CNI+MMF+others (no PTCy) n=68, CNI+MTX+others (no PTCy/MMF) n=123, CNI+others (no MMF/MTX/PTCy) n=20, PTCy+others n=37, other prophylaxis n=18. NOTE: The PDF file was mislabeled as 'HIV' but its actual content is T cell prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL) - this is the Murthy 2022 TCT 28:187.e1-187.e10 T-PLL paper, not the Murthy HIV paper.
overlap_notes: First publication for this CIBMTR T-PLL cohort. Predecessor CIBMTR T-PLL analysis: Kalaycio 2010 BBMT (n=21 T-PLL within combined T-PLL+B-PLL cohort of n=47) - smaller, earlier era, distinct dataset.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 452 adult patients undergoing first allogeneic HCT at the University of Kansas Medical Center (KUMC), Division of Hematologic Malignancies and Cellular Therapeutics, between August 2016 and July 2021. Two arms by donor type: matched unrelated donor (MUD, 10/10 HLA-A/B/C/DRB1/DQB1, n=276) vs T-cell replete haploidentical (n=176, mismatched at >=2 HLA loci). Excluded: manipulated grafts (ex vivo or in vivo TCD, engineered T cells), MMUD, MRD, UCB. MUD GVHD prophylaxis predominantly tacrolimus + methotrexate (n=241, 87%); 35 (13%) MUD received PT-Cy-based prophylaxis on clinical trial or per physician discretion. All haplo received PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF. Diseases: AML 43%, MDS+MPN+CML 28.5%, ALL 11.5%, NHL 8%, HD 2%, other 7%. MAC 37%, RIC 63%. PBSC 50%, BM 50%. Median age 57 yrs (range 18-77). Median follow-up 24.4 months. May share patients with KUMC_Mohyuddin_haplo_EBV cohort (1097, n=63 haplo only EBV-focused) - but Mushtaq is the broader and larger institutional cohort.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with cohort 1097 (KUMC_Mohyuddin_haplo_EBV) on haplo arm; Mushtaq is broader MUD+haplo comparison.

cohort_description: Joint EBMT Lymphoma Working Party (LWP) and CIBMTR retrospective registry analysis of 2140 adult (>=18 years) Hodgkin (HL) and non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) patients undergoing first haploidentical (n=1830) or 8/8 matched unrelated donor (n=310) HCT using PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis between 2010 and 2019. 34% CIBMTR / 66% EBMT. 277 centers (haplo) and 103 centers (MUD). Donor restrictions: haplo mismatched at >=2 HLA loci; MUD allele-matched 8/8 at HLA-A,-B,-C,-DRB1. GVHD prophylaxis PTCy-based, predominantly PTCy+CNI+MMF (90% haplo / 54% MUD). Both peripheral blood and bone marrow grafts included; both MAC and RIC/NMA included (predominantly RIC/NMA: 77% haplo / 74% MUD). Lymphoma subtypes mix: HL 44%, NHL 56% in haplo vs HL 28%, NHL 72% in MUD. Distinct from EBMT_CIBMTR_DLBCL_LWP (cohort 1046, DLBCL only, 2008-2015, includes MSD/MUD-TCD strata) and EBMT_CIBMTR_TCL_LWP (cohort 1063, T-cell only, 2008-2018) and CIBMTR_HL_HaploPTCy_MSDCNI (cohort 1011, HL only, MSD comparator). Likely partially overlaps with Hamadani 2022 Blood Adv (T-cell lymphoma component reference 9) and Kanate 2016 Blood (haplo vs MUD lymphoma reference 6) for the haplo arm.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with cohort 1046 (DLBCL LWP 2008-2015) for DLBCL haplo PTCy patients, cohort 1063 (TCL LWP 2008-2018) for T-cell lymphoma haplo PTCy patients, and cohort 1011 (HL CIBMTR haplo PTCy 2008-2016) for HL haplo PTCy patients. This is the broader all-lymphoma 2010-2019 EBMT+CIBMTR LWP cohort with PTCy in both donor arms.

cohort_description: Japanese Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (JSTCT) / Japanese Data Center for Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (JDCHCT) nationwide retrospective cohort via the Transplant Registry Unified Management Program (TRUMP). 5161 patients aged 16-70 years undergoing first HSCT for AML, ALL, MDS, or CML between January 2016 and December 2021. Compares PTCY-haplo (PBSC graft, no in vivo TCD) vs single-unit cord blood transplantation (CBT, matched at >=4/6 antigen levels HLA-A,-B,-DR), with PTCY-haplo donors stratified into younger (<40 yrs) and older (>=40 yrs) categories, and patients stratified into younger (<50 yrs) and older (>=50 yrs) cohorts. Older patient cohort N=3246 (CBT 2675, younger-haplo 451, older-haplo 120); younger patient cohort N=1870 (CBT 1532, younger-haplo 171, older-haplo 167). Patients receiving in vivo T-cell depletion with ATG or alemtuzumab were excluded. Distinct from JDCHCT_TRUMP2_UCBT_vs_PTCyHaplo cohort 1064 (Harada 2025 TCT, all heme disease 2014-2020) and JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL_PTCyHaplo_UCB cohort 1070 (ALL only 2013-2021) by disease focus (AML/ALL/MDS/CML) and donor age stratification analysis.
overlap_notes: Likely partial overlap with JDCHCT TRUMP cohort 1064 (Harada 2025, 2014-2020, all heme disease, includes the same disease and donor populations within shared 2016-2020 enrollment window) and cohort 1070 (JSTCT TRUMP adult ALL 2013-2021). Distinct primary analysis focus on haplo-donor age effect. Likely also partial overlap with Sugita 2022 BMT (ref 7, comparable Japanese cohort) and Wada 2022 Transplantation (ref 4).

cohort_description: Japanese Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (JSTCT) / Japanese Data Center for Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (JDCHCT) nationwide retrospective cohort via the Transplant Registry Unified Management Program 2 (TRUMP2). 697 adult patients (age >=16 yrs) with de novo or therapy-related MDS undergoing first allo-HCT between 2014 and 2020. Three arms: HLA-haploidentical PBSCT with PTCy (haplo-PBSCT, n=136; defined as related PBSC donor with 2-3 HLA antigen mismatches at HLA-A/B/DR in GvH direction; all received PTCy-based prophylaxis without in vivo TCD); MUD bone marrow transplantation (MUD-BMT, n=465; allele-matched at HLA-A/B/C/DRB1; 95.9% no ATG, 4.1% ATG); MUD peripheral blood stem cell transplantation (MUD-PBSCT, n=96; 67.7% no ATG, 32.3% ATG). Patients with ex vivo graft manipulation excluded. None received ALG or alemtuzumab. Designed by the Adult MDS Working Group of JSTCT. Distinct from JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL_PTCyHaplo_UCB cohort 1070 (ALL only) and JDCHCT_TRUMP2_UCBT_vs_PTCyHaplo cohort 1064 (all heme disease, UCBT vs haplo). May partially overlap with Konuma 2022 AmJHem (JSTCT MDS Working Group, haplo PTCy vs single UCB) within shared 2014-2020 enrollment window for the haplo arm.
overlap_notes: Partial overlap likely with Konuma 2022 AmJHem (JSTCT Adult MDS Working Group, haplo-PTCy vs single-unit UCB for MDS, TRUMP2 registry) within shared 2014-2020 enrollment window for the haplo-PBSCT arm. Distinct primary analysis vs MUD (BM and PBSC) cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 279 adult patients (age >=18 yrs) with B-cell or T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) undergoing first RIC (n=110) or NMA (n=169) allogeneic HCT at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) between March 2008 and December 2019. RIC regimens: Flu-Mel (55%), Flu-Cy-TT-4Gy-TBI (38%), Flu-Bu-4 (6%), Flu-Cy-4Gy-TBI (1%). NMA regimen: Flu-Cy-2Gy-TBI in all cases. Eligible donors: HLA-matched related, HLA-matched URD, 4-7/8 HLA-mismatched URD, HLA-haploidentical. Graft sources: BM 7%, PB 93%. GVHD prophylaxis: CNI-MTX-based 89% (n=248), PTCy-based 11% (n=31, of which 22 NMA + 9 RIC); ATG 30% (predominantly NMA arm 45% vs RIC arm 6%, on phase 2 trial incorporating ATG/rituximab with NMA conditioning); peritransplant rituximab 30% (49% NMA vs 2.7% RIC). Ex vivo TCD and alemtuzumab excluded. Disease histology: DLBCL 22%, T-cell lymphoma 22%, FL 19%, CLL/LGL/T-PLL 18%, MCL 14%, other B-cell 5.4%. Median follow-up 64 months. Distinct from MSKCC_UMiami_MMUD_Jimenez cohort 1069 (MMUD-only, different time window/inclusion).
overlap_notes: Single-center MSKCC NHL retrospective cohort. PTCy used in only 11% of patients; paper does NOT stratify outcomes by PTCy use AND conditioning intensity simultaneously, so the within-PTCy RIC vs NMA contrast (Comparison 3) cannot be derived directly. Paper does NOT report IFI outcomes.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective sequential cohort at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center (MDACC), Houston, TX, of 204 patients age >=65 years undergoing first allogeneic HSCT. Two cohorts compared: (1) Enhanced Recovery Stem-Cell Transplantation (ER-SCT) program cohort of 64 consecutive eligible patients transplanted October 2017-September 2018 (89% enrolled in the multidisciplinary supportive care program comprising prehabilitation [PM&R/PT/OT], geriatric assessment, nutritional optimization, pharmacological/polypharmacy review, and inpatient nursing support); (2) 140 historical controls transplanted January 2015-September 2017 prior to ER-SCT program initiation. Diseases: AML/MDS 75%, CML/MPD 13%, ALL 4%, CLL 3%, lymphoma 3%, myeloma 1%, aplastic anemia 1%. Conditioning/GVHD prophylaxis heterogeneous, differing between cohorts (ER-SCT 73% PTCy-based [F-Bu/PTCy 27%, Mel/PTCy 44%, Other/PTCy 2%] vs controls 26% PTCy-based [F-Bu/PTCy 13%, Mel/PTCy 12%, Other/PTCy 1%]; remaining used Tac/MTX with Bu/Mel/other conditioning). Donor: MUD 62%, MRD 28%, haplo 10%. PBSC 66%, BM 34%. Median age 68 (ER-SCT) and 67 (controls); ~30% aged >=70.
overlap_notes: Same institution as MDACC cohorts 1014 (Alousi PTCy RIC phase II NCT00800839, 2008-2011), 1089 (Mehta MMUD PTCy 2009-2013), 1090 (Mehta PTCy 3-arm 2015-2020), 1091 (Mehta HLA-matched 2015-2020). Possible partial patient overlap with MDACC PTCy cohorts 1090/1091 during 2015-2018 era for the PTCy-treated subset; however, Ngo-Huang ER-SCT cohort is restricted to age >=65 years and is a supportive-care intervention study, not a GVHD prophylaxis comparison. Distinct from those cohorts by inclusion criteria (age >=65), study question (multidisciplinary supportive care), and arm definition (ER-SCT vs historical no-ER-SCT). Reference 2 (Szewczyk 2021 TCT) reports feasibility/implementation data on the same ER-SCT program.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective observational cohort of 421 consecutive adults undergoing their first allogeneic HCT at Geneva University Hospitals (HUG), Switzerland, between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2021. Mixed donor types: matched related (MRD 24%, n=103), matched unrelated (MUD 47%, n=199), haploidentical (22%, n=93), mismatched unrelated (MMUD 6%, n=26). Predominantly RIC conditioning (75%) and PBSC graft (88%). GVHD prophylaxis with post-HCT cyclophosphamide in 115 (27%). Distinctive feature: primary fluoroquinolone antibacterial prophylaxis is NOT routinely administered during pre-engraftment neutropenia at this center; instead, oral non-absorbable neomycin/polymyxin B decontamination is given from conditioning through engraftment, plus co-trimoxazole for PJP, acyclovir antiviral, fluconazole antifungal, and letermovir anti-CMV prophylaxis (starting May 2019). Patients are managed under strict surveillance including weekly surveillance blood cultures and prompt empirical antibiotic initiation for neutropenic fever.
overlap_notes: First publication for Geneva HUG BMT cohort 2015-2021 in this PTCy MA. May share patients with Royston 2021 (letermovir matched cohort, ref 23), Chavaz 2023 (CMV post-letermovir, ref 24), Roth 2022 (invasive mold infections, ref 22) — all from same Geneva HUG BMT program.

cohort_description: Japanese Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (JSTCT) Adult Lymphoma Working Group, nationwide registry analysis via the Transplant Registry Unified Management Program 2 (TRUMP2) of the Japanese Data Center for Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation (JDCHCT). 857 adult patients (age >=16) with relapsed/refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma (R/R NHL) undergoing first allo-HSCT between January 2013 and December 2021, either PTCY-haplo (n=169; 165 PBSC, 4 BM; no ex vivo T-cell manipulation, no in vivo ATG) or single-unit uCBT (n=688). Diseases include mature B-, T-, and NK-cell neoplasms per WHO 2017; B-cell lymphoma 60% (n=514), T/NK-cell 40%. Excludes Hodgkin lymphoma, aggressive NK-cell leukemia, chronic active EBV, systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood, ATL. Excludes upfront transplant indications (CR/PR after first-line). Approval number zn230805. Cohort distinct from 1064 (TRUMP2_UCBT_vs_PTCyHaplo, mixed hematologic disease 2014-2020) and 1070 (JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL_PTCyHaplo_UCB, adult ALL only 2013-2021) by disease focus (R/R NHL only) and time window; substantial patient overlap likely with 1064.
overlap_notes: Partial overlap likely with JDCHCT TRUMP2 cohort 1064 (Harada 2025 hematologic disease 2014-2020) at the patient level since both draw from JDCHCT TRUMP2 registry, but Nishikubo 2024 restricts to R/R NHL while 1064 includes mixed hematologic disease. Also overlapping registry source with JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL cohort 1070 (different disease).

cohort_description: Single-center prospective observational non-interventional cohort of 208 consecutive adult patients undergoing allogeneic HSCT for hematologic malignancies at IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele, Milan, Italy, between 2013 and 2015. AML 59%, MDS/MPN 15%, lymphoma/myeloma 26%; donors: MRD 19%, UD 30%, MMRD (haplo) 48%, CBU 3%; stem cell source PB 87%, BM 10%, CBU 3%; conditioning MAC 81%, RTC 19%. GVHD prophylaxis distributed as: PT-Cy-based 101 (49%), ATG-based 84 (40%), no in vivo T-cell depletion 23 (11%); additional immunosuppression sirolimus-based 78%, CsA-based 22%. All received acyclovir antiviral prophylaxis. HHV-6 weekly PCR monitoring to D+100 (commercial HSV6 Elite MGB ELITECH, target U67) plasma. 6 cases of chromosomally integrated HHV-6 excluded. Median follow-up 4 years (range 0.4-5.7). Study focus: HHV-6 reactivation, clinically relevant HHV-6 infection (ECIL classical EODs and possible HHV-6-related EODs), and HHV-6-specific T-cell immune reconstitution by IFN-gamma ELISpot. ALMON study, San Raffaele Ethical Committee 19 Oct 2007. Likely shares patients with cohort 1036 (SanRaffaele_Milan_MAP_PTCy) which covers 2015-2022 antifungal prophylaxis era; possible partial overlap at 2015 boundary. Related publications: Oltolini 2020 (Greco/Galli infections after PT-Cy), Greco 2016 (haplo HHV-6 immune recovery), Greco 2021 (PT-Cy + sirolimus GVHD prophylaxis).
primary_publication_overrides: primary for HHV-6 reactivation and HHV-6-specific T-cell immunity outcomes
overlap_notes: Possible patient overlap with cohort 1036 (SanRaffaele_Milan_MAP_PTCy 2015-2022 voriconazole/posaconazole antifungal cohort) and with Oltolini 2020 BBMT (Greco/Galli infections after PT-Cy at same center) and Greco 2021 TCT (PT-Cy + sirolimus); to be adjudicated at consolidation.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective historical comparison at Institut Paoli-Calmettes (IPC), Marseille, France of 62 consecutive adult patients undergoing first allo-HSCT for hematologic malignancies with HLA-mismatched unrelated donors (MMUD; 9/10 in 59 cases, 8/10 in 3 cases; class I mismatch in 85%) and PBSC graft. Two arms: PT-Cy group (n=22, enrolled Jan 2015-Nov 2018) received PT-Cy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CSA + MMF; ATG group (n=40, historical cohort Jan 2010-Dec 2014) received rabbit ATG (Thymoglobuline 2.5 mg/kg/day D-3,-2; total 5 mg/kg) + CSA + MMF. Distinct from cohort 1041 (IPC Marseille MUD 10/10 PBSC 2014-2021 PT-Cy vs ATG) by HLA mismatch grade (MMUD 9/10 or 8/10 vs MUD 10/10) and enrollment era; same IPC Marseille institution but different donor stratum.
overlap_notes: Same IPC Marseille institution as cohort 1041 (IPC_Marseille_MUD_PBSC; covers MUD 10/10 transplants 2014-2021). Distinct donor strata (MMUD here, MUD there). No expected patient overlap.

cohort_description: EBMT Chronic Malignancies Working Party (CMWP) registry retrospective cohort of 1341 adult (>=18 yrs) patients with chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) undergoing first allo-HCT between 2012 and 2019 from an unrelated donor (UD) with either PTCy or non-PTCy GVHD prophylaxis, or from a mismatched related donor (MMRD) with PTCy. 257 EBMT centers contributed. Three arms: non-PTCy UD (n=1094, 82%), PTCy UD (n=113, 8%), PTCy MMRD (n=134, 10%). Excludes patients undergoing HCT from MSD or using cord blood. Lead author Guillermo Orti (Vall d'Hebron Barcelona); EBMT CMWP multinational. Distinct from EBMT_CMWP_UD_MDS (cohort 1035, MDS) and EBMT_CMWP_myelofibrosis (cohort 1037, MF) by disease focus on CML.
overlap_notes: Distinct disease focus (CML) from other EBMT CMWP cohorts (1035 MDS, 1037 MF). Lead institution Vall d'Hebron Barcelona but multinational EBMT registry data.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 269 adult and adolescent ALL patients in CR1/CR2+ undergoing first FTBI-based myeloablative allo-HCT at City of Hope National Medical Center, Duarte CA, between January 2010 and December 2020. Two donor/conditioning/GVHD-prophylaxis packages: (1) ETOP-package (n=205) for matched donor (MD; 8/8 sibling or unrelated) HCT, comprising FTBI 13.2 Gy in 1.2 Gy fractions TID D-7 to D-4 + etoposide 60 mg/kg D-3 and tacrolimus 0.02 mg/kg IV D-2 + sirolimus (12 mg D-2 then 4 mg D-1) as GVHD prophylaxis; donor mix in this group: MUD 192 (93.7%, includes 8/8 matched siblings and 8/8 MUD), MMUD 13 (6.3%, off-protocol); (2) FLU-package (n=64) for HLA-mismatched related (HAPLO) or mismatched unrelated (MMUD) donor HCT, comprising FTBI 12 Gy in 1.5 Gy fractions BID D-4 to D-1 + fludarabine 30 mg/m2 IV D-7 to D-5 and PTCy 50 mg/kg IV D+3 and D+4 + MMF 1000 mg IV D+5 + tacrolimus 1 mg IV D+5 as GVHD prophylaxis; donor mix: Haplo 47 (73.4%), MMUD 13 (20.3%), MUD 4 (6.3%). All patients received PBSC graft. Median age 37 (range 9-68); 59.5% Hispanic; B-ALL 86.6%, T-ALL 13.4%; CR1 79.2%, CR2+ 20.8%. Median follow-up 4.6 years (range 1-12).
overlap_notes: City of Hope ALL cohort; may share patients with Agrawal 2023 (Blood abstract, ref 21) on MMUD outcomes and other City of Hope publications on ALL HCT.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at Institut Paoli-Calmettes (IPC), Marseille, France of 209 consecutive patients younger than 60 years undergoing first allo-HSCT for hematological malignancies, comparing haploidentical-related donor with PT-Cy (HRD, n=81) vs unrelated donor (UD, n=128; 98 10/10 + 30 9/10) with ATG-based GVHD prophylaxis. HRD arm: Baltimore NMAC (Cy/Flu/TBI2Gy, n=53 NMAC, 66%) or RIC (Cy-Flu-Bu or TT-Flu-Bu, n=14 RIC, 17%) or MAC (n=14, 17%); PT-Cy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CSA + MMF starting D+5; 73% PBSC, 27% BM. UD arm: Flu-Bu-ATG (Thymoglobulin 5 mg/kg total) + CSA alone for 10/10 or CSA+MMF for 9/10; 95% PBSC, 5% BM; 62% RIC, 38% MAC. Median age 50 yr (19-60). Median follow-up 38 (HRD) and 27 (UD) months. Possible overlap with IPC Marseille older-adult cohorts (1029 Marseille_IPC_Blaise_older_adults, 1041 IPC_Marseille_MUD_PBSC) but distinct by age window (<60) and Pagliardini 2019 is referenced as a separate paper by cohort 1041's description.
overlap_notes: Same institution (IPC Marseille) as cohorts 1029 (Blaise older >55 yr, 2011-2013) and 1041 (IPC MUD PBSC 2014-2021); possible patient overlap with older-patient subset of cohort 1029 and with UD subset of cohort 1041 but distinct cohort by age (<60 yr) and donor strata. Cohort 1041 description explicitly references this Pagliardini 2019 paper as ref 4.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 133 older patients (>=60 years, median age 65, range 60-74) who underwent allogeneic HCT for any indication at Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, Toronto, Canada, between December 2013 and July 2017. All received G-CSF-mobilized PBSC graft. Two GVHD prophylaxis groups: ATG-PTCY (n=62; ATG 0.5 mg/kg D-3 + 2 mg/kg D-2, -1 [total 4.5 mg/kg] + PTCY 50 mg/kg D+3, +4 + CsA) vs Other (n=71, comprising ATG-CsA-MTX 11, alemtuzumab-CsA 30, CsA alone 1, CsA-MMF 10, CsA-MTX 19). Diseases: acute leukemia 46%, MDS 28%, MPN 14%, other 12%. Donors: MRD 28%, MUD 63%, HID 9% (all HID in ATG-PTCY arm). 94% RIC. CMV IgG+ donor or recipient 85%. Median follow-up 12 months (range 1-56). Likely partial overlap with cohort 1013 (PrincessMargaret_Toronto_Michelis high-risk AML/MDS 2014-2017, 159 pts) at same institution but Pasic 2020 is restricted to age >=60 and broader indications.
overlap_notes: Same institution (Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, Hans Messner Allogeneic Transplant Program) as cohort 1013 (Michelis 2014-2017, high-risk AML/MDS 159 pts) with overlapping enrollment window (Dec 2013-Jul 2017 vs Jan 2014-Jul 2017). Pasic 2020 covers age >=60 only and all indications; cohort 1013 covers all ages but only high-risk AML/MDS. Partial overlap likely on older AML/MDS patients (median age 65 here). Group also includes Prem 2019 (ATG-PTCY MUD/MMUD), Deotare 2018 (ATG+PTCY MUD), Law 2018 (ATG+PTCY HID). Consolidator should adjudicate whether to merge with cohort 1013.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective 1:4 case-control study from Peking University People's Hospital, Peking University Institute of Hematology. Source cohort: 8160 patients undergoing allo-HSCT between January 2015 and September 2023; 843 with CNS symptoms underwent CSF testing. 54 PyV (BKV/JCV) encephalitis cases vs 216 propensity-score-matched non-PyV controls matched 1:4 on age, gender, underlying disease, and transplant type. All patients received standard Beijing protocol GVHD prophylaxis (ciclosporin + mycophenolate mofetil + short-term methotrexate) with rabbit ATG 10 mg/kg total (reduced to 4.5 mg/kg in 22 cases) in haploidentical/unrelated transplants and aplastic anaemia; ATG generally omitted for MSD except 12 patients >40 years old who received 4.5 mg/kg. Conditioning: MAC Ara-C/Bu/Cy/simustine for hematologic malignancies; Bu/Flu/Cy for aplastic anaemia. No PTCy used. Donor mix: HID 86.7%, MSD 9.6%, URD 3.7%. Diseases: myeloid 52.2%, lymphoid 36.7%, aplastic anaemia 11.1%. Median follow-up 39 months (IQR 23-62). Study is descriptive of PyV encephalitis outcomes; NO PTCy contrast available.
overlap_notes: Beijing protocol cohort (Peking University People's Hospital, Huang Xiao-Jun group). May overlap with other PUPH publications by Huang/Xu/Mo/Zhang covering 2015-2023 allo-HSCT recipients. NO PTCy use; entire cohort is ATG-based Beijing protocol.

cohort_description: EBMT Transplant Complications Working Party (TCWP) registry retrospective study of 8764 adult patients with hematologic malignancies (acute leukemia ~58%, MDS 19.7%, MPN 9.7%, lymphoma 9%, CLL ~1%, CML ~2%) undergoing first peripheral blood alloSCT from 10/10 antigen-matched unrelated donors (MUD) between January 2018 and June 2021 in the EBMT database. Two arms based on GVHD prophylaxis: rATG (n=7725, 88%) vs PTCy (n=1039, 12%). Excluded: more than one previous autologous transplant, ex vivo T-cell depletion, combined rATG+PTCy, Alemtuzumab (Campath). Conditioning: MAC 53.3% overall (PTCy 62.3%, ATG 52%). TBI use 14.5% ATG vs 24.7% PTCy. Median follow-up 2.1 years in both arms. Distinct from related EBMT TCWP publications: Penack 2024 Blood Cancer J/Leukemia (9/10 MMUD) and Moiseev 2025 BMT (8/10 MMUD, cohort 1098). All papers share same EBMT TCWP registry and overlapping authorship (Penack, Abouqateb, Peczynski) but are donor-strata-distinct.
overlap_notes: Conference precursor: Penack 2023 ASH abstract (study_id 309, excluded as conference_abstract). Distinct cohorts from EBMT TCWP 8/10 MMUD (cohort 1098, study 257 Moiseev 2025) and Penack 2024 Blood Cancer J 9/10 MMUD. Same EBMT registry; donor-strata-disjoint within the 2018-2021 enrollment window.

cohort_description: EBMT Transplant Complications Working Party (TCWP) registry retrospective study of 5,209 adult patients (>=18 yrs) with hematologic malignancies (AML, ALL, lymphoma, CLL, MDS, MPN; HL also included per Table 1) undergoing first alloHCT from a matched related donor (MRD, matched sibling) with peripheral blood or bone marrow stem cells between January 2017 and December 2021 in the EBMT database. Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: rATG (n=4140) vs PTCy (n=1069). Excluded: >1 prior auto, ex vivo T-cell depletion, combined rATG+PTCy, alemtuzumab use. Distinct from cohort 1098 (EBMT_TCWP_MD_PTCy_ATG 8/10 MMUD, Penack Blood Cancer J 2024), and Penack Leukemia 2024 (10/10 MUD, ref 18) and Penack Blood Cancer J 2024 (9/10 MMUD, ref 20). PBSC predominant (96.2% rATG, 87.7% PTCy); BM 3.8%/12.3%. MAC 54.5%/55.4%, RIC 45.5%/44.6%. AML 54.5%/42.8% predominant, then MDS, ALL, NHL, MPN, MDS/MPN, HL. Median follow up 2.2 yrs (rATG) and 2.0 yrs (PTCy).
overlap_notes: Distinct EBMT TCWP MRD cohort, separate from prior Penack TCWP papers on 10/10 MUD (Leukemia 2024), 9/10 MMUD (Blood Cancer J 2024), and 8/10 MMUD (cohort 1098). Potential partial overlap of donor/center with EBMT_ALWP (1024) for acute leukemia MRD subset.

cohort_description: CIBMTR registry analysis of 2089 patients aged >=2 years from 105 US/international centers who underwent first allo-HCT for AML (47%), ALL (22%), or MDS (31%) between 2008 and 2019, with available CD4 counts at days 100 and 180. Four predefined GVHD-prophylaxis cohorts: (1) ex vivo TCD/CD34-selection +/- ATG (n=207), (2) unmodified graft + PTCy (n=304; 94% PTCy + other, 6% PTCy alone), (3) unmodified graft + CNI-based prophylaxis without ATG (n=1203), (4) unmodified graft + CNI-based prophylaxis with ATG (n=375). Donor types: MSD, related mismatched, MUD, MMUD, UCB single/double. Conditioning MAC 66%, RIC 23%, NMA 11%. Median follow-up 33 mo (PTCy arm) to 60 mo (CNI/CNI+ATG/TCD arms). Patients dying before day 100 excluded by design. Distinct from CIBMTR cohorts 1001 (HaploCy/SibCy/SibCNI 2012-2017, excluded UCB and TCD/ATG), 1008 (MUD/MMUD 2017-2021), and 1011 (cHL 2008-2016).
overlap_notes: Distinct from prior CIBMTR PTCy-focused cohorts (1001 HaploCy/SibCy/SibCNI 2012-2017, 1008 MUD/MMUD 2017-2021, 1011 cHL 2008-2016) by inclusion criteria (requires CD4 at D+100 and D+180), broader donor types (includes UCB), and study aim (immune reconstitution biomarker analysis). Some patient overlap with these registry analyses is possible because the same CIBMTR data source is used. Flag for consolidator review.

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective Spanish (GETH-TC affiliated) Valencia CARV registry of consecutive adult allo-HCT recipients (aged >=16 years) at Hospital Clinico Universitario de Valencia (HCUV) and Hospital Universitario y Politecnico La Fe Valencia (HLF) between December 2013 and June 2023, who developed symptomatic community-acquired respiratory virus (CARV) infections during the peri-engraftment period (Day -8 to Day +36 after stem cell infusion). N=112 patients, 114 CARV episodes. Median age 51 years. Donors: HLA-identical sibling 30%, MUD 21%, MMUD 19%, haplo 29%, MM sibling 1%. PBSC 85%, UCB 14%, BM 1%. RIC 55%, MAC 45%. GVHD prophylaxis: Tac+Sir 52%, PTCy-based 44%, CNI-based 4%. ATG 13%. Overlapping with cohort 1038 (Chorao HLF Valencia 2017-2022) and 1057 (HCUV INCLIVA Valencia 2020-2024) at the institutional level; this is the CARV-specific registry capturing peri-engraftment respiratory viral episodes from both hospitals. Single-arm descriptive (CARV-focused); no PTCy vs comparator contrast.
overlap_notes: Two-center Valencia CARV registry HCUV+HLF. Institutional overlap with cohort 1038 (Chorao HLF Valencia 2017-2022) at HLF location and with cohort 1057 (HCUV/INCLIVA Valencia 2020-2024 AdV surveillance) at HCUV location. Patient overlap likely for the 2017-2023 transplant subset of HLF (in 1038) and 2020-2023 subset of HCUV (in 1057), but Pinana 2025 is restricted to patients with symptomatic peri-engraftment CARV episodes (n=112) which is a non-strict subset of both. Different study question (CARV epidemiology vs GVHD/AdV outcomes). Salas Barcelona cohort 1003 is Hospital Clinic Barcelona (different city/institution) - no overlap.

cohort_description: EBMT Chronic Malignancies Working Party (CMWP) registry retrospective cohort of 1829 adult patients with MDS who underwent first allo-HSCT from MSD (n=1414) or haploidentical family donors with PTCy (HD, n=415) between 2014 and 2017 across 270 centers. Inclusion: family donor >=2 Ag mismatch and at least haplotype (3/6) matched for HD arm; all HD received PTCy. MSD arm received mixed GVHD prophylaxis (95.9% non-PTCy: 37.9% ATG, 7.7% alemtuzumab, others; only 4.1% received PTCy). Distinct cohort from EBMT_CMWP_UD_MDS (cohort 1035, Battipaglia/Robin MUD/MMUD MDS PTCy vs ATG, 2012-2019) by donor strata (MSD/Haplo vs MUD/MMUD) and overlapping but distinct enrollment window.
overlap_notes: EBMT CMWP MDS registry source shared with cohort 1035 (MUD/MMUD strata) but non-overlapping donor categories. Family donor data (MSD + haploid family) reported here; unrelated donor data reported in cohort 1035.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 87 consecutive adult patients (<55 years old) with poor-prognosis acute leukemia (AML/ALL) or myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) who received an HLA-matched or single-allele mismatched (HLA A, B, C, DRB1, DQB1) related or unrelated allo-SCT with ablative TBI-based myeloablative conditioning at the Division of Adult Clinical Hematology, Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona, Spain, between January 2009 and December 2021. Two sequential era arms: (i) historical CyTBI (n=59, transplanted 2009-2015): cyclophosphamide 120 mg/kg (60 mg/kg D-6, D-5) plus TBI 13.5 Gy (hyperfractionated, 6 fractions over 3 days), CNI (tac or CsA) + short-course MTX, with ATG thymoglobulin 6 mg/kg added for 9/10 mismatch; (ii) prospective FluTBI-PTCy (n=28, 2016-2021, registered single-center protocol): fludarabine 120 mg/m2 PO or 90 mg/m2 IV + TBI 8.8 or 13.5 Gy (age-assigned: 13.5 Gy AML/MDS <41 yr or ALL <46 yr; 8.8 Gy AML/MDS 41-55 yr or ALL 46-55 yr), with PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + single-agent tacrolimus. PBSC graft predominant (97%). Institutional overlap with cohort 1048 (SantPau_Barcelona_Esquirol_UCBT_Haplo) by center but distinct patient population (matched/single-mismatch TBI-MAC vs UCBT/haplo).
overlap_notes: Same institution (Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona) as cohort 1048 (Esquirol UCBT/Haplo 2005-2017) but distinct patient population: matched/single-allele mismatched related/unrelated only, TBI-MAC only, AL/MDS only. Potential temporal overlap 2013-2017 with cohort 1048 but different donor strata. Likely also overlaps institutionally with Garcia-Cadenas 2020 single-center protocol publication (ref 12).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 226 consecutive adult patients undergoing allo-HCT from HLA-identical or single-allele mismatched (HLA A/B/C/DRB1/DQB1) MSD or VUD donor at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona, Spain, between January 2012 and June 2022. Three GvHD prophylaxis cohorts: Cohort-1 (n=58, 26%, 2012-2016) CNI+short-course MTX or MMF (predominantly MAC TBI-based, 79%); Cohort-2 (n=87, 38%, 2012-2016) TAC-SIRO within two clinical trials (100% RIC); Cohort-3 (n=81, 36%, Jan 2016-Jun 2022) PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + single-agent TAC (35% MAC TBI-based, 65% RIC). ATG (Thymoglobulin 6 mg/kg total) added for VUD mismatched donors in Cohorts 1-2. Includes 9/10 or 10/10 MSD or VUD. PBSC graft in all but 3. Distinct from cohort 1048 (SantPau_Barcelona_Esquirol_UCBT_Haplo) at same institution which covers UCBT vs haplo only.
overlap_notes: Distinct from cohort 1048 (Sant Pau UCBT/Haplo). The Redondo 2023 paper (study_id 20 per refs, TBI MAC sequencing) likely reports on a TBI-MAC subset of this Cohort-3 PTCy arm; partial overlap possible.

cohort_description: EBMT Pediatric Diseases Working Party (PDWP) retrospective multicenter cohort of pediatric patients (<18 years) with AML in CR1 or CR2 undergoing first allo-HCT from 10/10 MUD with ATG (n=420) or haploidentical family donor (>=2 HLA mismatches) with PT-Cy (n=96) between 2011 and 2021. Transplants performed in 117 EBMT centers. All received myeloablative conditioning (MAC). Graft source BM or PBSC. Patients with ex vivo T-cell depletion, alemtuzumab use, or ATG+PT-Cy combination excluded. Matched-pair analysis with exact match on disease status, cell source and age group at HCT, and nearest match on year of HCT, age at diagnosis, FtM, Lansky, CMV match: yielded 253 MUD : 95 haplo matched pairs (max 3 MUD per haplo). Distinct from EBMT_ALWP (cohort 1024) which is adult acute leukemia; this is pediatric AML through PDWP-EBMT.
overlap_notes: PDWP-EBMT pediatric AML registry. Distinct working party (PDWP) from cohort 1024 (ALWP). Possible overlap with prior Ruggeri PDWP-EBMT pediatric ALL paper (Ruggeri 2021 TCT, ref 19) but disease differs.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 409 consecutive allo-HCT recipients at Saint-Louis referral academic hospital (Paris, France) between January 2016 and January 2019. Adults and young adults (>=14 yrs); median age 47 (31-58); 60% male. Mixed donor types: matched related 130 (32%), matched unrelated 188 (46%), haploidentical 40 (10%), mismatched unrelated 43 (11%), UCB 9 (2%), other 8 (2%). Stem cell source: PBSC 80%, BM 18%, UCB 2%. Conditioning: MAC 28%, RIC/NMA 72%. Cyclophosphamide in conditioning 28% (115/409, 59 MAC + 56 RIC). GvHD prophylaxis groups: CsA 6%, CsA+MMF 44%, PTCy/CsA/MMF 13% (n=51), CsA+MTX 27%, other 11%. ATG 61%. Median follow-up 641 days. Primary aim: BKHC incidence and risk factors with competing-risk and Fine-Gray analysis. PTCy analyzed as risk-factor covariate, not as separately reported arm.
overlap_notes: Saint-Louis Paris is a high-volume French referral center; potential overlap with other Saint-Louis publications (Michonneau, Peffault de Latour, Socie group). Flag for consolidator.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of CMV seropositive recipients of allogeneic HCT at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center (Fred Hutch), Seattle, WA, who survived at least 100 days after HCT. Two enrollment eras: pre-emptive therapy (PET) cohort 2001-2017 (n=2155 day-100 survivors) and letermovir (LET) cohort 2018-2021 (n=314 day-100 survivors); total n=2469 day-100 survivors. Five GVHD prophylaxis strata: CNI+MMF (PET 38%, LET 18%), CNI+MTX (PET 45%, LET 36%), PT-Cy (PET 7% n=143, LET 22% n=68; total n=211), Sirolimus-based (PET 6%, LET 24%), Other (PET 4%, LET 1%). All patients underwent PCR monitoring and PET before day 100; high-risk patients had prolonged surveillance. Diseases: AML/MDS (PET 48%, LET 56%), CLL (PET 17%, LET 4%), CML (PET 12%, LET 18%), ALL (PET 13%, LET 16%), non-malignant (PET 8%, LET 6%). Donor types: cord blood, matched related, mismatched related, matched unrelated, mismatched unrelated. Despite first author Sadowska-Klasa's affiliation with Medical University of Gdansk Poland, this is a Fred Hutch institutional cohort (data, IRB, accrual, follow-up at Fred Hutch); A.S.-K. was a visiting fellow funded by Polish NAWA and FHCC Joel D. Meyers Scholarship. Distinct from PALG_Polish_registry (cohort 1047) which is a Polish multicenter cohort of haplo/MMUD patients 2015-2019.
overlap_notes: Subset overlaps with Ueda Oshima 2023 Blood Advances (HLA-matched PBSCT subset analyzing GVHD prophylaxis impact on CMV) and Boeckh 2003 Blood (earlier Fred Hutch late CMV cohort) — same institutional source population over different time windows. Patients pre-2001 (Boeckh 2003) not included here. Polish first authorship reflects A.S.-K.'s training fellowship, not Polish institutional cohort participation.

cohort_description: Joint EBMT/CIBMTR retrospective registry analysis of 96 adult patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma undergoing haploidentical allo-HCT as salvage treatment after recurrent disease between 2008 and 2016. All patients had failed at least 1 previous auto-HCT; 27.1% had failed 2 prior auto-HCTs and 4.2% had failed 3. EBMT contributed 56 patients and CIBMTR 40 patients. PT-Cy GVHD prophylaxis in 73 (81.1%); non-PT-Cy in 17 (18.9%). Stem cell source: PB 65.2%, BM 34.7%. Conditioning: RIC/NMAC 81.5%, MAC 18.4%. ATG used in 11 (11.7%). Outcomes analyzed only for the 93 patients with complete relapse information. MM-specific cohort distinct from EBMT_ALWP (1024, acute leukemia) and EBMT_CIBMTR_DLBCL_LWP (1046, lymphoma).
overlap_notes: EBMT/CIBMTR registry cohort, MM-specific. Distinct from EBMT_ALWP (acute leukemia) and EBMT_CIBMTR_DLBCL_LWP (lymphoma). May share institutions with other EBMT/CIBMTR MM publications.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 651 adults (median age 58 yrs, range 18-76) who underwent first allogeneic HCT at the Hans Messner Allogeneic Transplant Program, Princess Margaret Cancer Centre, University Health Network, Toronto, Canada, between January 2017 and December 2020. Stratified by transplant time period: Period 1 (Jan 2017-Dec 2018, N=322) and Period 2 (Jan 2019-Dec 2020, N=329). Dominant GVHD prophylaxis is dual T-cell depletion ATG-PTCy-CsA (ATG 4.5 mg/kg Jan 2017-May 2018, ATG 2 mg/kg May 2018-Dec 2019; PTCy 50 mg/kg/d D+3/+4; CsA target trough 200-400 ng/L Period 1 reduced to 150-250 ng/L Period 2); alternative regimens include ATG-MTX-CsA and PTCy-MMF-CsA (introduced for MRD PBSC by end 2019). Donors: MRD 23.4-24.5%, 10/10 MUD 46.3-49.2%, 9/10 MMUD 9.7-9.9%, haploidentical 17.6-19.3%. Stem cell source PBSC 94.8-96.6%, BM 3.4-5.2%. Conditioning RIC predominant (Period 1 98.7%, Period 2 61.9%); MAC use increased to 38.1% in Period 2. Standard infection prophylaxis ciprofloxacin (until engraftment), micafungin then posaconazole 3 months, acyclovir 12 months, TMP/SMX or pentamidine; CMV/EBV PCR monitored weekly for 6 months; routine letermovir prophylaxis introduced for high-risk patients during/after Period 2. Likely partial overlap with PrincessMargaret_Toronto_Michelis (cohort 1013, AML/MDS 2014-2017), PMH_CIBMTR_MUD_acute_leukemia_FtoM (cohort 1042, MUD AL 2015-2023), PrincessMargaret_Toronto_MSD_PBSC (cohort 1044, MSD PBSC 2010-2023), PrincessMargaret_Toronto_older_alloHCT (cohort 1119, age >=60, 2013-2017), and PrincessMargaret_Toronto_MDSMPN (cohort 1043, MDS/MPN 2010-2023). Cohort_label specified by lead reviewer as 'older_adults' though this paper includes all adults 18-76 yr.
overlap_notes: Partial overlap with multiple PMH/Princess Margaret cohorts (1013, 1042, 1043, 1044, 1119) at the same institution. Adjudicate at consolidation.

cohort_description: EBMT Chronic Malignancies Working Party (CMWP) registry retrospective study of 404 adult MDS patients undergoing first MSD allo-HCT using PB-derived stem cells between 2014 and 2020 across 52 participating centers (after MED-C follow-up data collection in 2023). Two GVHD prophylaxis arms: PTCy-based (n=66, 16.3%; 66.7% with 2+ additional IS agents, 31.8% with 1 agent, 1.5% PTCy alone; ATG given in only 4/66 (6.1%)) vs conventional 'other' (n=338, 83.7%; CNI-MTX/MMF only n=176 [52.1%], CNI-MTX/MMF+ATG n=162 [47.9%]). All MSD/PBSC. MDS only (de novo 86.8%, secondary 13.2%; AML transformation prior to allo-HCT in 21%). Disease coded by IPSS-R. Median follow-up 4.5 years (PTCy 3.8, Other 4.7). Distinct from cohort 1035 (EBMT_CMWP_UD_MDS, Chalandon 2024) which covers unrelated donors. Likely partial overlap at center level with Chalandon 2024, Robin 2019, Forcade 2022 CMWP MDS publications. Salas 2023 Blood ASH abstract is the conference abstract for the same cohort.
overlap_notes: EBMT CMWP cohort. Different donor stratum (MSD) than cohort 1035 (EBMT_CMWP_UD_MDS, Chalandon 2024). Salas 2023 ASH abstract (Blood 142 Supplement 1, 4938-4940) reports same data, conference abstract only - excluded per protocol.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 444 consecutive adults with hematologic malignancies undergoing first allo-HCT from 10/10 HLA-matched unrelated donor (MUD) with PBSC graft at Princess Margaret Cancer Centre / Hans Messner Allogeneic BMT Program, University Health Network, University of Toronto, between January 2011 and December 2021. No 9/10 MMUD included. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis era: (i) ATG-based without PTCy (n=84, 2011-2015): 4.5 mg/kg rabbit-ATG (Thymoglobulin) D-3/-2/-1 + CsA + MMF; (ii) ATG(4.5)/PTCy (n=127, Oct 2015-May 2018): 4.5 mg/kg ATG D-3/-2/-1 + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CsA from D+5; (iii) ATG(2)/PTCy (n=233, May 2018-2021): 2 mg/kg ATG D-2/-1 + PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + CsA from D+5. AML 53%, MDS 14%. 26% MAC. Likely partial institutional overlap with Princess Margaret PMH cohorts 1013 (Michelis high-risk AML/MDS 2014-2017, mixed donors), 1042 (PMH+CIBMTR MUD acute leukemia 2015-2023), 1043 (PMH MDS/MPN), 1044 (PMH MSD PBSC), and 1119 (PMH older alloHCT). Distinct by MUD-only restriction, broader timeframe (2011-2021), and 3-arm ATG-dose contrast.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with PMH cohorts 1013, 1042, 1043, 1044, 1119 by institution and overlapping enrollment windows. Patients in this MUD-only cohort may appear in cohort 1042 (PMH MUD acute leukemia 2015-2023, ATG-PTCy uniform prophylaxis) and 1119 (PMH older alloHCT 2013-2017). Adjudication required at consolidation.

cohort_description: CIBMTR retrospective registry analysis of adult (>=18 yrs) recipients of first T-cell-replete unmanipulated BM or PBSC allo-HCT for AML/ALL/CML/MDS performed 2013-2017. Compares Haploidentical donor + PTCy/CNI/MMF (Haplo/PTCy) vs HLA-matched unrelated donor (allele-level matched at HLA-A/B/C/DRB1) with conventional CNI+MTX or MMF +/- ATG (MUD/conventional). Parent population: 758 Haplo/PTCy and 2,586 MUD/conventional. Primary analytic cohorts are conditional on GVHD development: (1) grade 2-4 aGVHD subcohort (264 Haplo/PTCy + 1,163 MUD/conv [380 with ATG, 779 without ATG]); (2) cGVHD subcohort (206 Haplo/PTCy + 1,018 MUD/conv [254 ATG, 764 no ATG]). Outcome focus: GVHD organ distribution/severity and post-GVHD NRM/OS. NOT mutually exclusive of CIBMTR cohort 1001 (HaploCy_SibCy_SibCNI, 2012-2017 AML/ALL/MDS center-restricted) or 1011 (HL haplo) - different donor strata (this includes MUD which 1001 excludes; 1001 excludes CML which is included here).
overlap_notes: Overlap likely with other CIBMTR 2013-2017 AML/ALL/MDS adult cohorts (e.g., cohort 1001 HaploCy_SibCy_SibCNI). This study INCLUDES MUD which 1001 excludes; includes CML which 1001 excludes. Patient-level overlap of Haplo/PTCy arm with cohort 1001 HaploCy arm is plausible since both draw from same CIBMTR years. Flagged for consolidator adjudication. NOTE: prompt suggested MDACC PTCy vs conv = Comp 1, but full text of this paper is CIBMTR registry, not single-center MDACC; first author MDACC affiliation only.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort at the Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation Program, Red de Salud Christus UC - Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile, Santiago, Chile (LATAM). 52 adult patients with AML (n=37) or MDS (n=15) in CR1 or beyond undergoing first allo-HSCT with reduced-intensity conditioning between 2012 and 2022. Three RIC arms (assignment based on era/availability and physician choice; melphalan-based became more common since 2018 due to busulfan shortages): Flu-Cy-TBI (n=15; Fludarabine 150 mg/m2 + Cyclophosphamide 29 mg/kg + TBI 200 cGy), Flu-Mel (n=30; Fludarabine 150 mg/m2 + Melphalan 100-140 mg/m2), Flu-Bu2 (n=7; Fludarabine 150 mg/m2 + Busulfan 6.4 mg/kg). 450 total allo-HSCT performed at the program over the period; this paper restricts to the 52 RIC AML/MDS subset. GVHD prophylaxis platform changed in 2017: before 2016, donor-dependent (CsA+MTX for MRD; PTCy+Tac+MMF for haploidentical; ATG-based for MUD); since 2017, all patients received uniform PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + tacrolimus (6 months) + MMF (30 days). Donor mix heterogeneous within arms: haploidentical predominant (33/52, 63%; significant p=0.001 across arms with more haplo in TBI and Mel arms), MRD (10/52), MUD/MMUD (10/52). 99% PBSC. Median age 50 yrs. From 2012-2023 inclusive (Methods state 2012-2023; Results/Abstract state 2012-2022).
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with Sarmiento 2020 (Hematol Transfus Cell Ther, ref 9 in this paper) which reported on Chilean haploidentical vs HLA-identical allo-HSCT outcomes from the same PUC Chile program. Same institutional center; broader Sarmiento 2020 publication included benign and malignant hemopathies. Time windows may overlap; check at consolidation.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 960 consecutive adults undergoing first allogeneic HCT at Princess Margaret Hospital, Toronto, between January 2015 and June 2021. Focus on hemorrhagic cystitis (HC) incidence and interaction between high-dose IV busulfan (HD Bu) and PTCy-based prophylaxis (PTCY-ATG-CsA standard since Oct 2015). 252 (26.5%) MAC, 708 (73.5%) RIC; 695 (72.4%) received PTCy-based prophylaxis (635 PTCY-ATG-CsA + 60 PTCy-based without ATG); 176 (18.4%) ATG-based; 89 (9.3%) other (MTX-CsA/TK or MMF-CsA/TK). PBSC 96.5%. Donors: MSD 27%, 10/10 MUD 46%, 9/10 MMURD 12%, Haplo 16%. Median age 58 yrs. Overlaps with PrincessMargaret_Toronto_Michelis cohort 1013 (Michelis 2014-2017 high-risk AML/MDS), PMH_CIBMTR_MUD_acute_leukemia_FtoM cohort 1042 (PMH MUD 2015-2023 acute leukemia), PrincessMargaret_Toronto_MDSMPN cohort 1043 (2010-2023 MDS/MPN overlap), and PrincessMargaret_Toronto_MSD_PBSC cohort 1044 (2010-2023 MSD PBSC). This is the broadest PMH institutional cohort covering all allo-HCT 2015-2021 with HC outcomes.
overlap_notes: Substantial overlap with PMH cohorts 1013, 1042, 1043, 1044. Same Hans Messner program. Salas/Mattsson/Michelis group. HC outcomes are unique to this paper (index publication for HC endpoint at PMH).

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective cohort across three hematopoietic stem cell transplantation centers in Ankara, Turkey (Gulhane Education and Research Hospital; Ankara Memorial Hospital; Bayindir Sogutozu Hospital) of 90 adult patients (>=18 yrs) with hematologic malignancies (AML 53.4%, ALL ~26.7%, MDS ~12.2%, lymphoma ~7.8%) transplanted between 2016 and 2022. Two arms with 45 patients each: (1) PTCy arm = 9/10 HLA single-antigen mismatched unrelated donor (MMUD) ASCT after myeloablative conditioning (Flu/TBI 800-1200 cGy or Cy/TBI), with GVHD prophylaxis = PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4 + methotrexate 15 mg/m2 D+1 then 10 mg/m2 D+3 and D+6 + tacrolimus (5-15 ng/mL) or cyclosporine A 3 mg/kg/day from D+5; (2) Control arm = matched related donor (MRD) ASCT after MAC with conventional CsA-based prophylaxis from D-1 to D+90-180 + methotrexate D+1/+3/+6/+11. ATG, ex vivo TCD, in vivo TCD excluded. Predominantly PBSC graft (88.9% PTCy, 93.4% control). Levofloxacin, valacyclovir, fluconazole, and TMP-SMX given for prophylaxis. CMV PCR and galactomannan twice weekly to D+30 then weekly. Possible duplicate of study 349 (same PDF).
overlap_notes: Studies 348 and 349 appear to reference the same Sayin 2024 Mediterr J Hematol Infect Dis paper (identical PDF file size, identical Paperpile filename minus initial 'S'). Consolidator should reconcile as duplicate.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective registry cohort of 595 Brazilian adult and pediatric patients (n=595) undergoing first allogeneic HCT for acute leukemia (AML or ALL) in Brazil between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2018, reported to the CIBMTR through the Brazilian Society for Bone Marrow Transplantation and Cellular Therapy (SBTMO)/CIBMTR collaboration (the Brazilian HCT Registry framework). Three donor arms: MSD n=338 (57%; 248 CR1 + 90 CR2+), Haplo with PTCy n=116 (19%; 60 CR1 + 56 CR2+), and 8/8 MUD n=141 (24%; 79 CR1 + 62 CR2+). ATG predominantly used in MUD (>92%) and not in Haplo (PTCy-based). Acute GVHD data largely unavailable and not analyzed. Authors include Brazilian centers (Hospital Samaritano, Albert Einstein, Hospital Amaral Carvalho, Hospital Sirio-Libanes, UFPR, INCA, Bio Sana's, UFRGS, Beneficencia Portuguesa, UFC, UFRN, Hospital DF Star, HPM-MG, Oncoclinicas, Centro Hemato SC, A.C. Camargo, UNICAMP, AMEO-SP) and CIBMTR (MCW, Duke, Fred Hutch).
overlap_notes: Likely shares patients with several single-center Brazilian publications (e.g., Kerbauy 2021 Transplant Infect Dis from Albert Einstein, cohort 1076 AlbertEinstein_SaoPaulo_Kerbauy_haplo_UD; Arcuri 2021 systematic review) for overlapping institutions/time windows. The SBTMO-CIBMTR registry construct is a federated registry; this study covers only acute leukemias 2014-2018 in CR/CRi at HCT.

cohort_description: Two-center retrospective real-life observational cohort of 40 consecutive adult patients with hematological malignancies (AML 67.5%, ALL 22.5%, MM 7.5%, other 2.5%) who underwent haploidentical (n=38) or matched unrelated donor (MUD, n=2) allogeneic HSCT at the Hematology Units of University Hospital San Giovanni di Dio e Ruggi d'Aragona (Salerno) and Hospital S. Giuseppe Moscati (Avellino), Italy, between 2009 and 2021. Stratified by GVHD prophylaxis: PTCY (n=24; cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg D+3 and D+4 + CSA + MMF) vs ATG (n=16; cumulative ATG 7.5-10 mg/kg pre-stem cell infusion + MTX + CSA or tacrolimus). All in hematological complete remission at transplant. Two MUD HSCTs were in PTCy arm. Conditioning predominantly TBF (PTCy 92%) or BU-FLU (ATG 56%).
overlap_notes: No known overlap with existing cohorts. Italian two-center retrospective (Salerno + Avellino).

cohort_description: Single-center observational cohort (prospective from 1 Jan 2019; retrospective before) of adult AML patients (age 18-60) in CR or nadir undergoing HLA 10/10 fully matched donor (not necessarily sibling) allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation at the Nasser Institute Hospital for Research and Treatment, Cairo, Egypt, between 4 April 2015 and 1 April 2021. Two arms based on GVHD prophylaxis platform: PT-CY/CSA (n=89, PT-CY 50 mg/kg/day IV D+3 and D+4 total 100 mg/kg [76.4%] or 80 mg/kg [23.6%] + CSA 3 mg/kg IV q12h from D+5; protocol introduced at center on 8 Sept 2017) vs MTX/CSA historical/concurrent control (n=90; MTX 15 mg/m2 D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3,+6,+11 + CSA 3 mg/kg IV q12h from D-1). All patients received PBSC. No ATG used in either arm. Conditioning: PT-CY arm 100% Flu/Bu (Flu 160 mg/m2 + Bu 16 mg/kg); MTX arm 18.9% Flu(120 mg/m2)/Bu(16 mg/kg), 73.3% Bu(16 mg/kg)/Cy(120 mg/kg), 7.8% Bu(16 mg/kg)/Cy(200 mg/kg). Median age PT-CY 34 yr vs MTX 29 yr (p<0.001). G-CSF mobilized PBSC graft for all patients. 1-year follow-up.
overlap_notes: New single-center Egyptian cohort; no prior overlap detected with existing cohorts 1001-1122.

cohort_description: Comparative analysis of two Japan Study Group for Cell Therapy and Transplantation (JSCT) multicenter single-arm prospective phase II studies in PBSCT. JSCT-ATG15 (jRCTs011180012, enrolled Jan 2016-Oct 2018) administered low-dose rabbit ATG/thymoglobulin total 2 mg/kg (1 mg/kg/d D-2,-1) + calcineurin inhibitor (CsA or tacrolimus) + short-term MTX after MAC for HLA-matched PBSCT (n=67). JSCT-PTCY19 (jRCTs011190009, enrolled Mar 2020-Jul 2021) administered cyclophosphamide 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + tacrolimus + MMF after MAC or RIC for HLA-matched or 1-2 allele mismatched PBSCT (n=41). Adults with AML, ALL, MDS, or malignant lymphoma. Multicenter contributing institutions include Hokkaido University Hospital, Sapporo Hokuyu Hospital, Osaka International Cancer Institute, Nagaoka Red Cross Hospital, Kyushu University Hospital, Hamanomachi Hospital, Gifu Municipal Hospital, Osaka University Hospital, and Karatsu Higashimatsuura Medical Center. Primary endpoint of comparative analysis: 2-year GRFS.
overlap_notes: JSCT-ATG15 phase II results previously reported (Shiratori et al. Bone Marrow Transpl 2021;56:129-136). JSCT-PTCY19 phase II results previously reported (Sugita et al. Bone Marrow Transpl 2024;59:344-349). Current Shiratori 2025 Scientific Reports paper is the formal head-to-head comparative analysis of the two non-overlapping prospective cohorts.

cohort_description: Two-center comparative cohort of 150 adult patients (age 18-60 yrs) with advanced hematologic malignancies in CR1/CR2 undergoing PBSCT from HLA-matched related donor (MRD) at the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Cairo University and Nasser Institute, Cairo, Egypt. Therapeutic group (n=75, transplanted prospectively December 2017-June 2019) received PTCy 50 mg/kg D+3,+4 + cyclosporine-A (CsA, target trough 200-400 mcg/L, tapered from D+90) after intravenous fludarabine 40 mg/m2 + oral busulfan 16 mg/kg total dose D-5 to D-2 conditioning, with no G-CSF support. Historical control group (n=75, transplanted September 2015-August 2019) received methotrexate (15 mg/m2 D+1, 10 mg/m2 D+3,+6,+11) + CsA (same target/taper) with three MAC regimens: BuCy 64%, BuFlu 24%, TBI/Cy 12%.
