Two patients in the PTCy arm had a single-antigen mismatched related donor; remainder fully MRD. PBSC only graft source in both arms. Diseases: AML predominant (70.7% PTCy, 57.3% MTX), CML, MDS, ALL, others. Median age 34 PTCy vs 28 MTX (P=.017). Median follow-up 12.5 mo PTCy vs 19 mo MTX.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other cohorts in this MA. Egyptian single-country two-center collaboration (NCI Cairo + Nasser Institute).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort, University Hospital Basel, 80 adults receiving 9/10 MMUD allogeneic HCT for hematologic disorders, 2010-2018; 22 received reduced-dose PTCy (40 mg/kg x 2)+CyA+MMF (2016-2018), 58 received ATG (Grafalon)+CyA+MTX/MMF (2010-2017).
overlap_notes: Control ATG group overlaps with Binkert 2015 (ref 17) lower-dose ATG cohort from same center; PTCy arm is novel.

cohort_description: Multicenter retrospective cohort of 109 consecutive adult (>=18 yr) ALL patients receiving haploidentical HSCT with PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis at 5 centers (MD Anderson Cancer Center Houston; City of Hope Duarte; Washington University St. Louis; Northside Hospital Atlanta; Instituto de Cancerologia Medellin Colombia)
overlap_notes: Centers overlap with several existing cohorts (MDACC, City of Hope, Northside Atlanta, Wash U) but this is a unique disease-specific multicenter ALL cohort; no overlap declared with existing cohort_ids in map

cohort_description: Chinese Bone Marrow Transplantation Registry Group (CBMTRG) multicenter registry of patients with hematologic malignancies undergoing myeloablative haploidentical HSCT, comparing G-CSF/ATG (Beijing Protocol) and PTCy (Baltimore Protocol) GVHD prophylaxis platforms. Nested case-pair 1:4 matching.
overlap_notes: CBMTRG registry; participating centers include Peking University People's Hospital, Xiangya Hospital, PLA Army General Hospital, Nanfang Hospital, First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University. New cohort; not in existing 7 cohorts or 9 known clusters. Distinct from Beijing Protocol single-center series.

cohort_description: Italian multicenter retrospective collaborative study of 285 allo-HSCT procedures in 281 R/R B-cell NHL patients (indolent, aggressive, mantle-cell) from six Italian transplant centers, with data shared in the GITMO/EBMT registry.
overlap_notes: Possible partial overlap with EBMT_ALWP (cohort 1024) and GITMO datasets given centers report to GITMO/EBMT registries; centers: INT Milan, S. Martino Genova, Tor Vergata Rome, Papa Giovanni XXIII Bergamo, IEO Milan, Policlinico Gemelli Rome.

cohort_description: LMU Munich-Grosshadern single-center retrospective comparison of two HLA-haploidentical HSCT approaches (cTCR/TCD with ATG 2006-2007 vs TCR/PTCY 2009-2011), focused on virus infection and immune reconstitution outcomes
overlap_notes: Distinct from LMU_Munich_Augsburg_hrAML_sequential (cohort 1045) and LMU_Munich_NHL_matched_pair (cohort 1062); this is the LMU-Grosshadern haplo virus infection cohort 2006-2011

cohort_description: CMV-seropositive patients undergoing first HLA-matched unrelated or HLA-identical sibling donor PBSC transplantation for hematologic malignancies with calcineurin inhibitor-based GVHD prophylaxis (PTCy, MMF, or MTX) at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center; pre-letermovir era
overlap_notes: FHCRC Seattle HLA-matched PBSC cohort, July 2007-Sept 2018; letermovir prophylaxis implemented Oct 2018 (excluded). Possible overlap with other FHCRC cohorts but distinct period and population focus.

cohort_description: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center single-center randomized phase II trial (NCT03246906) of HLA-matched (10/10) or mismatched (9/10) unrelated donor mobilized blood HCT in adults with hematologic malignancies ineligible for myeloablative conditioning; randomized 1:1 to SIR/CSP/PTCy vs SIR/CSP/MMF; 145 patients in primary analysis (PTCy n=72, non-PTCy n=73).
overlap_notes: Single-center phase II RCT at Fred Hutch; distinct from FHCC_Seattle_letermovir_era_HHV6 (cohort 1072) and FredHutch_lateCMV_PET_LET (cohort 1130) which are observational FHCRC cohorts. NCT03246906.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective case series of 5 patients with chemotherapy-sensitive relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma after auto-HSCT who underwent allo-HSCT at PGIMER Chandigarh, January 2017 to December 2023. Heterogeneous donor types (haplo n=3, MUD n=1, MSD n=1) and conditioning (RIC, RTC, MAC); PT-Cy used in 4/5.
overlap_notes: Single-center series from PGIMER Chandigarh; no known overlap with other cohorts in this MA.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective Chinese study of haploidentical HSCT comparing Flu+BUCY+PTCy vs BUCY+ATG conditioning/GVHD prophylaxis at Affiliated People's Hospital of Ningbo University, 2014-2020
overlap_notes: Single-center cohort; no known overlap with other studies in this MA

cohort_description: Chinese 3-center prospective trial (Peking University People's Hospital, First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, Nanfang Hospital Southern Medical University) of haplo-HCT recipients receiving Beijing protocol MAC + ATG/G-CSF from maternal donors (MD) or collateral relative donors (CRD); ATG-PTCy cohort received added low-dose PTCy 14.5 mg/kg on d+3 and d+4; contemporary control received Beijing ATG only without PTCy. Trial registered NCT02412423.
overlap_notes: 40 patients in the ATG-PTCy arm were previously reported in Wang Y et al. Oncoimmunology 2017 (ref 18); further followed in this larger extended trial. Distinct from CBMTR-Peking_Beijing_protocol cohorts as patients here are exclusively from MD or CRD donors.

cohort_description: Single-center cohort of SAA patients undergoing alternative donor HSCT (HID or URD) at Guangzhou First People's Hospital. Prospective mPTCy cohort (ChiCTR2000038297, n=101, plus 1-year extension n=56) combined with historical retrospective G-CSF/ATG cohort (n=140). Total 297 AD-HSCT patients (205 HID, 92 URD).
overlap_notes: Prospective mPTCy arm previously reported in Wu 2023 (TCT, HID-HSCT, n=71) and Chen 2024 (TCT, URD-HSCT, n=30); current paper extends enrollment by 1 year and pools with historical G-CSF/ATG comparator.

cohort_description: Chinese Bone Marrow Transplantation Registry Group (CBMTRG) multicenter retrospective registry; patients with hematologic malignancies (acute leukemia, MDS, others) undergoing first haplo-HSCT between January 2020 and December 2022; 818 patients with complete medical records enrolled for propensity score matching analysis. Compares three TCR haploidentical protocols: G-CSF/ATG (Beijing protocol), PTCy (Baltimore-based), and PTCy+ATGlow.
overlap_notes: Distinct from prior Beijing single-center Tang 2020 CBMTRG paper (transplants 2013-2018, only G-CSF/ATG vs PTCy). PSM creates 4 analytical groups: G-CSF/ATG group 1 (n=230) matched to PTCy (n=122); G-CSF/ATG group 2 (n=226) matched to PTCy+ATGlow (n=123). The two G-CSF/ATG matched subsets are non-independent subsamples drawn from the same source registry.

cohort_description: Open-label phase III RCT at Peking University People's Hospital comparing G-CSF/ATG-based haploidentical PBSCT with vs without low-dose PTCy (14.5 mg/kg D+3 and D+4) in non-maternal, non-collateral haplo donors (fathers/children/siblings); enrolled Nov 2023-Aug 2024, stopped for futility at 1st interim (N=66); MAC Bu-Cy regimen; acute leukemia in CR or MDS
overlap_notes: NCT06108739; single-center RCT; distinct from CBMTRG registry cohorts (e.g., Xu ZL 2025 CBMTRG, cohort 1034 etc.) — this is a prospective RCT at PUPH only

cohort_description: Japanese registry cohort of adults (>=16y) with AML (excluding APL) in CR1 receiving single-unit UCBT or PTCY-based haplo-HCT between 2017 and 2021. Data from Transplant Registry Unified Management Program (TRUMP) managed by JDCHCT and JSTCT.
overlap_notes: Japanese TRUMP/JDCHCT registry cohort. Likely partial overlap with other JSTCT TRUMP-based studies (e.g., cohort 1064 JDCHCT_TRUMP2_UCBT_vs_PTCyHaplo, 1070 JSTCT_TRUMP_ALL_PTCyHaplo_UCB, 1103 JSTCT_TRUMP_AML_PBSCT_PTCyHaplo_vs_MUD, 1108 JSTCT_TRUMP_AML_ALL_MDS_CML_haploDonorAge, 1109 JSTCT_TRUMP2_MDS_haploPTCy_vs_MUD, 1113 JSTCT_TRUMP2_NHL_PTCyHaplo_uCBT) but this is a distinct AML-CR1-restricted cohort with overlap_subset_of TRUMP registry.

cohort_description: Single-center SAA AD-HSCT cohort at Guangzhou First People's Hospital combining prospective mPTCy patients (ChiCTR2000038297, n=101 + 56 extension) with retrospective G-CSF/ATG historical control (n=140); 297 patients receiving HID-HSCT (n=205) or URD-HSCT (n=92).
overlap_notes: mPTCy patients overlap with prior single-arm prospective reports (Wu 2023, Chen 2024). G-CSF/ATG retrospective cohort partially overlaps with Zhang 2019 single-center retrospective if same institution timeframe. No direct overlap with EBMT/CIBMTR cohorts.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 430 adult (>=16 yrs) first alloHCT recipients at Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre / Royal Melbourne Hospital 2015-2019, evaluating incidence and outcomes of multiple viral infections in the first 12 months post-alloHCT. Mixed donor types (52% MUD, 38% related, 10% haploidentical with PTCy). PTCy used only in the haploidentical subgroup (n=44, 10%).
overlap_notes: Single-center Australian cohort; potential overlap with prior PeterMac/RMH viral infection publications (e.g., Lindsay 2021 EBV/ATG, Sim 2022 review by same group). PTCy subset (n=44 haplo) is a minority of cohort; outcomes not separately stratified for PTCy arm.

cohort_description: Japanese nationwide TRUMP (Transplant Registry Unified Management Program) registry of 700 adult patients with adult T-cell leukaemia/lymphoma (ATLL) who underwent first allo-HCT from HLA-matched related donor (MRD), HLA 8/8 matched unrelated donor (MUD), cord blood (CBT), or HLA-haploidentical-related donor with PTCY GVHD prophylaxis between 2016 and 2021. ATL Working Group of JSTCT.
overlap_notes: TRUMP-based ATLL-specific cohort; disease-specific subset distinct from other JSTCT TRUMP cohorts (1064 UCBT, 1070 ALL, 1103 AML, 1108 AML/ALL/MDS/CML, 1109 MDS, 1113 NHL). No prior PTCY MA cohort covers this ATLL subset.

cohort_description: Pavlov First St. Petersburg State Medical University (Gorbacheva Institute) prospective clinical study NCT02294552 of PTCy + tacrolimus + MMF vs historical ATG-based control after unrelated donor allo-HSCT with PBSC graft. Adult patients (18-62 yr) with acute leukemias, CML, MDS. PTCy arm 2013-2015 (n=110); ATG historical control March 2010 - Aug 2013 (n=160).
overlap_notes: Distinct from cohort 1007 (Pavlov RCT in MPN/MDS) and cohort 1099 (Pavlov MRD-BMT). This is the unrelated-donor PBSC PTCy-vs-ATG comparison from the same Pavlov/Gorbacheva center. NCT02294552.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of all consecutive patients >=15 years undergoing allo-HSCT for hematologic malignancy from January 2013 to June 2018 at Saint Antoine Hospital, AP-HP, Paris, France. UCB recipients excluded. Total 331 patients (136 PT-Cy, 195 no PT-Cy). All received systematic cardiac monitoring (TTE + ECG pre-conditioning and at D90).
overlap_notes: Single-center Saint-Antoine Hospital Paris (Mohty group). Possible overlap with other Saint-Antoine/Mohty publications including Picod 2018 (defibrotide VOD prophylaxis), Dulery 2018 BBMT (sequential thiotepa), Dulery 2019 BBMT (thiotepa-busulfan-fludarabine haplo), and Dulery 2023 (reduced PTCy + ATG in haplo PBSC). Block 9 also includes Dulery 2023 PDF (file: 'Duléry et al. 2023 - Reduced post-transplant cyclophosphamide dose with ... globulin in peripheral blood stem cell haploidentical transplantation.pdf') which likely shares some of these patients. Consolidator to reconcile.

cohort_description: Single-center Saint-Antoine Hospital (Sorbonne University, AP-HP, Paris) retrospective cohort of consecutive patients age >=65 years OR with a history of a cardiac event, undergoing haploidentical PBSC HCT with thiotepa-based conditioning (RIC: thiotepa-busulfan-fludarabine, or sequential Flamsa-like thiotepa-etoposide-cyclophosphamide+fludarabine-busulfan), low-dose ATG (2.5 mg/kg RIC or 5 mg/kg sequential), CSA+MMF+PT-Cy. Comparison of standard PT-Cy 100 mg/kg total (2014-2019, all PBSC haplo) vs reduced PT-Cy 70 mg/kg total (since 2020, in age>=65 or prior cardiac event).
overlap_notes: Saint-Antoine Paris (Mohty/Duléry/Brissot/Malard group) is a high-volume French haploidentical PTCy center; possible patient overlap with other Saint-Antoine publications (Mohty R 2019 BJH infectious complications post-PTCy ref 19, Duléry R 2021 JACC CardioOncol early cardiac toxicity ref 16, Duléry 2018 BBMT sequential thiotepa ref 8, Duléry 2019 BBMT TBF ref 26, Stocker 2020 Clin Transl Immunol ref 14, Ruggeri 2015 Transpl Infect Dis ref 18). Distinct from Duléry R 2023 BMT 58:386-92 (ref 32; cited herein) which is a Marseille IPC cohort (Duléry visiting/collaborator) comparing PT-Cy 80 mg/kg vs 100 mg/kg in haploidentical HCT - different center, different dose contrast. Consolidator should adjudicate whether any subset patients from this Saint-Antoine 100 mg/kg arm (2014-2019) were already counted in other Saint-Antoine-led publications already extracted.

cohort_description: Single-center University of Minnesota cohort combining prospective phase II PTCy/Tac/MMF trial (NCT03314974, 2018-2022, n=125) with historical CSA/MTX phase II trial (NCT00176930, 2005-2018, n=344) in MAC HCT for 8/8 or 7/8 matched MRD/URD with BM or PBSC grafts; pediatric and adult patients up to age 60 (PTCy) or 55 (CSA/MTX) with hematologic malignancies
overlap_notes: Possible patient overlap with other University of Minnesota PTCy or MAC HCT publications by Holtan/Weisdorf/MacMillan groups. PTCy cohort N=125 from NCT03314974 (2018-2022), historical CSA/MTX cohort N=344 from NCT00176930 (2005-2018). Some patients in CSA/MTX historical cohort may overlap with prior Minnesota MAC HCT publications. medRxiv preprint not yet peer-reviewed at time of extraction.

cohort_description: Single-center, all consecutive adult RIC alloHSCT recipients (HLA-identical sibling or 10/10 or 9/10 matched unrelated donor) at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau (Barcelona) from 1999 to 2020 (N=484). Conditioning fludarabine-melphalan (lymphoid) or fludarabine-busulfan (myeloid); low-dose thiotepa added when PTCy was used. Three sequential GVHD prophylaxis cohorts: CsA-MTX/MMF (1999-2008, n=271), Tac-Siro (2009-2016, n=145), PTCy-Tac (2016-2020, n=68). Excludes haploSCT, UCBT, aplastic anemia and non-hematological malignancies.
overlap_notes: Same institution as cohort 1048 (Esquirol 2020 study_id 133, Sant Pau UCBT vs Haplo PBSC) but distinct patient population: this paper excludes haploSCT and UCBT and includes only HLA-identical sibling and matched/9-10 mismatched unrelated donors. Possible partial patient overlap at center level with cohort 1049 (Esquirol 2021 GETH haplo PTCy) only if any patients dual-enrolled - unlikely as donor strata differ. Same Sant Pau institution; cohort_id to be confirmed by consolidator.

cohort_description: Prospective non-randomized phase 2 clinical trial with two parallel arms (haploidentical and 9/10 MUD) at MD Anderson Cancer Center using melphalan-based RIC (FM140 or FM100) with PTCy/tacrolimus/MMF GVHD prophylaxis. Total N=106 (HAPLO=60, 9/10 MUD=46). NCT01010217.
overlap_notes: NCT01010217 parent trial. The 9/10 MUD arm (n=46) is the PTCy arm subset reported separately in Mehta RS 2016 (study_id 242, cohort 1089 MDACC_Mehta_MMUD_PTCy_vs_conventional) which compared 36-41 PTCy MMUD patients vs conventional controls. Gaballa 2016 is the parent index publication reporting both HAPLO and 9/10 MUD arms together. Distinct from cohort 1014 (Alousi 2015 NCT00800839 RIC Bu/Flu MUD/MRD, 2008-2011) and from cohort 1090/1091 (Mehta MDACC 2015-2020 era cohorts). Cohort_overlap_status with study 242 = overlap_superset_of (Gaballa contains the 9/10 MUD subset that Mehta 2016 reports).

cohort_description: Single-institutional NCI/NIH prospective phase 1/2 trial of reduced-dose PTCy after myeloablative busulfan/fludarabine conditioning and HLA-haploidentical bone marrow HCT, using PTCy + sirolimus + MMF. Three PTCy dose levels tested: DL1 (HD-PTCy 50 mg/kg days +3/+4, pilot, n=5), DL2 (ID-PTCy 25 mg/kg days +3/+4, phase 2, n=23), DL3 (25 mg/kg day +4 only, n=7). NCT03983850.
overlap_notes: Single NCI/NIH trial NCT03983850. Reference 42 (McCurdy SR et al. 2024 TCT abstract) describes a related but distinct two-institutional reduced-intensity trial (NCT04959175 / NCT05436418) that overlaps in personnel but enrolls different patients. Reference 41 (Kanakry CG 2014 JCO) is the multi-institutional myeloablative single-agent PTCy trial, distinct cohort.

cohort_description: 117 consecutive adults receiving first PTCy-based alloSCT at Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona; HaploSCT (n=40), MRD (n=22), 10/10 VUD (n=23), 9/10 MMUD (n=32). PTCy + tacrolimus (or sirolimus) GVHD prophylaxis. MAC TBF (haplo) or low-dose thiotepa + Flu-Bu or Flu-Mel RIC (non-haplo).
overlap_notes: Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau, Barcelona institutional PTCy cohort. Partial overlap with cohort 1048 (Esquirol UCBT/Haplo 2005-2017, haplo subset shared 2013-2017), cohort 1049 (GETH Esquirol haplo PTCy 2013-2018, Sant Pau center is one of 6 GETH centers), cohort 1126 (SantPau Redondo TBI MAC AL/MDS 2009-2021, matched/MMUD AL/MDS subset shared), cohort 1127 (SantPau Redondo HLA-matched 2012-2022, MRD/VUD/MMUD subset shared 2013-2020). Reference 19 (Garcia-Cadenas BMT 2020) is precursor publication of same Sant Pau non-haplo PTCy series. Reference 15 (Esquirol Ann Hematol 2020) is precursor of Sant Pau Haplo PTCy series.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective cohort of consecutive patients undergoing first allogeneic HSCT from unrelated donors at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, Sao Paulo, Brazil, receiving either ATG or PTCy immunosuppression. Choice of strategy based on allocation in concurrent RCT (NCT03818334) or clinical team decision. Excluded if both patient and donor CMV serology were negative.
overlap_notes: Same institution as cohort 1076 (AlbertEinstein_SaoPaulo_Kerbauy_haplo_UD, primary study 201 Kerbauy 2021 DNA virus infections) but distinct patient population: 1076 enrolled 2010-2018 and included haplo+UD; this cohort enrolled 2019-2021 and is UD-only. Same lead author (M.N. Kerbauy) and same Hamerschlak group. Possible partial overlap with NCT03818334 trial cohort (concurrent RCT at same institution). Consolidator may opt to merge into cohort 1076 if reviewing as institutional cohort.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of adults (>=18yr) with acute leukemia (AML, ALL, MPAL) or MDS who underwent haploidentical PBSC HSCT with identical busulfan/fludarabine conditioning at Seoul National University Hospital, comparing dual T-cell depletion (individually tailored ATG by day -3 ALC + attenuated PTCy 80 mg/kg) versus ATG (7.5 mg/kg) alone for GVHD prophylaxis.
overlap_notes: Seoul National University Hospital (SNUH), Seoul, South Korea. Distinct from CatholicKorea_SeoulStMary_ALL_HIDT (cohort 1012, Ahn J 2025) - different Korean institution. Possible patient overlap with Woo G-U et al. 2020 Biol Blood Marrow Transplant (ref 18, same group, matched related ATG dosing study) but different donor stratum (haplo vs matched related).

cohort_description: Single-center phase 2 randomized open-label trial at University of California San Diego comparing PTCy + Abatacept (no CNI) vs methotrexate/tacrolimus SOC for GVHD prophylaxis in patients undergoing 8/8 matched related or unrelated PBSC allo-HSCT for hematologic malignancies. Trial amended in Dec 2021 after FDA approved Abatacept; only PTCy+Aba arm enrolled thereafter. NCT03680092.
overlap_notes: Single-center UCSD prospective RCT. No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts. Note: lead author Koura previously published Koura DT et al. 2013 BBMT first-in-disease Aba trial (ref 5) - separate Emory trial cohort; D.K. is now at UCSD.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective study at Attikon General University Hospital, Athens, Greece, of 9/10 HLA-MMUD PBSC transplants. Study group (n=63) received low-dose PTCy (15 or 25 mg/kg on d+3,+4) + low-dose alemtuzumab (5 mg d-2,-1) + CsA between 2019 and 2024. Historical control (n=31) received alemtuzumab 10 mg d-2,-1 + CsA + MMF between 2015 and 2019.
overlap_notes: First publication for this Attikon Athens single-center MMUD PBSCT cohort with low-dose PTCy + low-dose alemtuzumab. No known overlap with other extracted cohorts.

cohort_description: Retrospective single-center series of 58 consecutive adults receiving RIC PBSC haploidentical HSCT at Nantes University Hospital with PTCY+CsA+MMF (n=32, 08/2014-05/2017) or PTCY+ATG (n=26, 05/2017-03/2019) GVHD prophylaxis. Focus on early T and NK cell immune reconstitution and outcomes.
overlap_notes: PTCY group (n=32) overlaps with the cohort reported by Willem et al. 2019 J Immunol 202:2141-2152 (ref 8), which described 30 of these PTCy patients for KIR/HLA NK cell reconstitution analysis. The PTCy patient outcomes are updated here. Also overlaps with Retiere et al. 2018 Oncotarget (ref 7) describing PTCy vs ATG immune reconstitution at Nantes. No overlap with other identified cohorts in the cohort map. New cohort: consolidator to assign final integer cohort_id >= 1162.

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective cohort of 33 adult patients undergoing haploidentical HSCT at Erciyes University Faculty of Medicine, Kayseri, Türkiye (Jan 2015 - Jan 2024); compared PTCy-only (n=16) vs low-dose ATG/PTCy (n=17) for GVHD prophylaxis.
overlap_notes: No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts. Single-center Erciyes University BMT Center, Kayseri, Türkiye. Other Turkish single-center cohorts in the corpus (Hacettepe Malkan 231; Kara/Elibol 198; Kahraman/Ozdemir 192) are at different institutions.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective observational study at Osaka City University Hospital comparing immune reconstitution after 4 graft types: HLA-matched related (MRD), HLA-matched unrelated (MUD), cord blood (CBT), and HLA-haploidentical PBSCT with reduced-dose PTCy (25 mg/kg x 2). 110 adult patients with hematological disease analyzed.
overlap_notes: Single-center Osaka City University Hospital cohort. Distinct from JSTCT/TRUMP national registry cohorts (1064, 1070, 1103, 1108, 1109, 1113, 1131, 1137) which are JDCHCT/JSHCT national registry studies. The Nakamae group has a prior pilot Nakamae 2015 Exp Hematol publication (ref 13 in the paper) on the reduced-dose PTCy 25 mg/kg x 2 protocol; the PTCy-haplo arm here may partially overlap with that earlier pilot cohort (some patients enrolled 2013 onwards). Consolidator to verify any overlap with other Osaka City University publications.

cohort_description: GITMO multicenter, prospective, phase 2, single-arm, open-label study (PHYLOS trial, NCT03270748, EURODRACT 2017-003530-85) evaluating PTCy-based GVHD prophylaxis (PTCy + CSA/Tac + MMF) after MAC (Bu4Flu) for HSCT from 7/8 mismatched unrelated donors in patients with AML (CR1/CR2) or MDS. 77 evaluable patients enrolled across 26 Italian transplant centers between Jan 2020 and Nov 2022.
overlap_notes: PHYLOS trial GITMO multicenter prospective phase 2; 26 Italian centers including San Martino Genova, Torino, Avellino, Bolzano, Milan (Fatebenefratelli-Sacco, Ca' Granda), Udine, Tricase, Rome Gemelli, Reggio Calabria, Foggia, Brescia, Pavia, Monza, Cuneo, Vicenza, Alessandria, Modena, Bergamo, Ancona, Cagliari, Bologna. Possible partial overlap with EBMT registry datasets (cohorts 1024 EBMT_ALWP, 1035 EBMT_CMWP_UD_MDS) since participating Italian centers report to EBMT, but PHYLOS is a discrete protocol-enrolled prospective cohort and not an EBMT registry analysis. Possible partial Genova San Martino contribution shared institutionally with the Raiola/Bacigalupo Genova haplo-PTCy program referenced in cohorts 1071 (Metafuni 2018) and others, but PHYLOS patients are MMUD (not haplo) and enrolled to a specific trial. Single Italian centers may also contribute to CYTOALLO_GITMO_AMCLI (cohort 1058, 2021-2022 CMV survey) for patients transplanted during the overlapping window but cohort 1058 is broader (1310 patients all donor types) and includes screening overlap only; PHYLOS is a discrete trial population. Consolidator to verify if any patients are counted in EBMT MMUD analyses (Battipaglia 2019, Penack 2024).

cohort_description: Penn State Cancer Institute (Hershey, PA) consecutive case series of 11 patients receiving intermediate-dose PTCy (25-30 mg/kg/day on Days 3 and 4) for GVHD prophylaxis between February 2023 and November 2024, with historical comparator cohort of 57 patients receiving standard-dose PTCy (50 mg/kg/day Days 3 and 4) from prior published study (Cioccio et al. 2023).
overlap_notes: Standard-dose PTCy historical cohort (n=57) derived from Cioccio J et al. 2023 Ann Hematol (ref [4] in this paper), which represents Penn State PTCy cohort with RIC and post-transplant cyclophosphamide. Possible overlap with Zulch E et al. 2024 Leuk Res (ref [5] same group, splenomegaly/GF/PGF analysis). Consolidator to verify whether Cioccio 2023 is already represented in the corpus.

cohort_description: Single-center prospective phase II trial (NCT01435447) at Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, enrolling 31 adult patients with lymphoid malignancies (ALL or lymphomas) undergoing first allo-HSCT with PBSC graft from MSD, MUD, or haploidentical donor after Flu-Bu4 MAC conditioning, with PTCy+CsA GVHD prophylaxis. Historical comparator group of 48 lymphoid malignancy patients transplanted before January 2013 with BuCy conditioning and CsA+MTX+MMF (MSD) or CsA+MTX+MMF+ATG (MUD) standard GVHD prophylaxis. Both groups same institution.
overlap_notes: Single-center Ruijin Hospital Shanghai cohort. No known overlap with other PTCy MA cohorts. Distinct from Shanghai General Hospital cohort (cohort 1135) which is a different institution. Historical comparator is from the same institution but earlier time period (pre-2013, no overlap).

cohort_description: Single-center retrospective landmark analysis at Ruijin Hospital (Shanghai Institute of Hematology), Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Patients with myeloid malignancies undergoing first allo-HSCT with MAC and PBSC grafts. PTCy-ATG group (MUD/haplo donors, Jan 2020-Dec 2021, n=77 enrolled, n=71 in D+100 landmark). Two historical controls (2015-2020): CNI group (MSD, n=48 landmark) and CNI-ATG group (MUD/haplo, n=35 landmark). NCT04269811 / NCT04897139.
overlap_notes: Related prior publications from same group: Jiang JL 2021 Front Med (MSD PTCy-tacrolimus single-arm phase II) and Gao WH 2023 Front Med (haploidentical PTCy-Tac-low dose ATG single center analysis). Historical CNI/CNI-ATG controls (2015-2020) may overlap with earlier Ruijin Hospital cohorts. Consolidator should adjudicate against any other Ruijin/Hu J/Jiang JL publications in corpus.

cohort_description: Multicentre randomized controlled phase II trial (ChiCTR2200058591) at 4 centers in Henan Province, China (Henan Cancer Hospital/Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Zhengzhou University; Third People's Hospital of Zhengzhou; Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University; Xinxiang Central Hospital) comparing reduced-dose PTCy (40 mg/kg x2) + low-dose post-transplant ATG (2.5 mg/kg d+8) with FBA conditioning vs standard-dose ATG ('Beijing Protocol') in haplo-PBSCT for hematologic malignancies. 122 patients enrolled 2018-2022, randomized 1:1.
overlap_notes: Distinct from cohort 1061 (Luoyang_Central_Hospital_haplo_BuCy, 2019-2024 single-arm BuCy series) although Luoyang Central is one of the four participating centers; the present RCT used FBA conditioning and enrolled 2018-2022 with 1:1 randomization. No other known overlap with corpus cohorts.

cohort_description: Multicenter randomized controlled trial (ChiCTR2200056979) conducted at 3 transplant centers in Henan, China (Henan Cancer Hospital/Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Zhengzhou University; Central Hospital of Xinxiang; Third People's Hospital of Zhengzhou) enrolling patients with hematological malignancies in CR1 undergoing first 10/10 HLA-MUD PBSCT. Patients randomized 1:1 to low-dose PTCy (20 mg/kg D+3,+4) + low-dose ATG (6 mg/kg) + CsA + MMF vs standard-dose ATG (10 mg/kg) + CsA + MMF + short-course MTX.
overlap_notes: New cohort; no known overlap with existing cohorts in the cohort_overlap_map. Single trial (ChiCTR2200056979), first publication.

cohort_description: Prospective multicenter randomized controlled trial enrolling 160 patients with hematological malignancies undergoing UD-PBSCT at 3 institutions in Henan, China (Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Zhengzhou University/Henan Cancer Hospital, Central Hospital of Xinxiang, Third People's Hospital of Zhengzhou). Patients age 14-62 randomized 1:1 to low-dose PTCy + low-dose ATG vs quadruplet ATG-based prophylaxis. ChiCTR2200056979.
overlap_notes: New cohort, not present in the existing 160 cohort map. Trial registered ChiCTR2200056979. No known overlap with other cohorts in the corpus.
